如前所述，BRD4–CDK9 在全基因组范围调控启动子近端 RNA Pol II 释放，而 SEC 的作用似乎具有基因选择性。例如，快速耗竭 BRD4 会使新生转录本普遍下调，符合全基因组 RNA Pol II 暂停的表型。<sup>41</sup> 而敲低 SEC 支架亚基 AFF1/4，则只使特定一组基因下调。<sup>51,61</sup> 目前尚不清楚 SEC 如何实现这种选择性，也不清楚 BRD4–CDK9 与 SEC 是否具有不同的 CDK9 磷酸化底物。Mediator<sup>62</sup> 和 MYC<sup>61</sup> 介导的基因特异性 SEC 招募，可能有助于解释其表现出的基因选择性。

Distinct transcriptional elongation kinases: CDK12 and CDK13｜不同的转录延伸激酶：CDK12 和 CDK13

In addition to CDK9, the human genome contains two other elongation-related kinase genes: CDK12 and its paralog CDK13. The functions of CDK12 and CDK13 in transcriptional elongation have been extensively studied since their initial identification as CDK-related kinases.<sup>63,64</sup> CDK12 and CDK13 share an exceptionally large size among CDKs and a unique sequence feature. With extended N termini and C termini, the human CDK12 (1,490 aa) and CDK13 (1,512 aa) are approximately 4 times as large as CDK9 (372 aa). The sequences of CDK12 and CDK13 both contain the arginine/serine-rich (RS) domain, which is widely conserved in splicing factors.<sup>63,64</sup> CDK12 and CDK13 localize at nuclear speckles, where splicing factors are predominantly enriched,<sup>63,64</sup> and they physically interact with splicing factors.<sup>65,66</sup> CDK12 and CDK13 also regulate the expression of splicing factor genes.<sup>65</sup> Depletion of CDK12 or CDK13 results in splicing defects.<sup>65,66</sup> These results suggest that CDK12 and CDK13 function to facilitate splicing not only via direct interaction with splicing factors but also via regulation of expression for splicing factor genes.

除 CDK9 外，人类基因组还编码另外两种与延伸相关的激酶：CDK12 及其旁系同源物 CDK13。自最初被鉴定为 CDK 相关激酶以来，<sup>63,64</sup> 两者在转录延伸中的功能已得到广泛研究。它们在 CDK 家族中体积格外大，并具有独特序列特征。由于 N 端和 C 端均延长，人 CDK12（1,490 aa）和 CDK13（1,512 aa）的长度约为 CDK9（372 aa）的 4 倍。CDK12 和 CDK13 均含有在剪接因子中广泛保守的富精氨酸/丝氨酸（RS）结构域。<sup>63,64</sup> 两者定位于剪接因子富集的核斑，<sup>63,64</sup> 并与剪接因子发生物理相互作用。<sup>65,66</sup> 它们还调控剪接因子基因的表达。<sup>65</sup> 耗竭 CDK12 或 CDK13 均会引起剪接缺陷。<sup>65,66</sup> 这些结果提示，两者不仅通过直接结合剪接因子，也通过调控剪接因子基因的表达来促进剪接。

While CDK9 regulates transcriptional elongation genome-wide, CDK12 shows a unique gene specificity. CDK12 is required for the expression of DNA damage response genes,<sup>65,67,68</sup> and CDK12-depleted cells are sensitive to DNA damage agents.<sup>67</sup> Thus, CDK12 functions to protect cells from genomic instability by facilitating DNA damage response. Inhibition of CDK12/13 kinase activity using the covalent inhibitor THZ531<sup>69</sup> results in a gene-length-dependent elongation defect, in which long genes are preferentially downregulated due to premature termination that results from premature cleavage and polyadenylation of nascent RNA at the middle of genes.<sup>70</sup> Interestingly, DNA damage response genes are enriched among these long, CDK12/13-dependent transcripts.<sup>70</sup> Together, the dependency of long transcripts on CDK12/13 and the enrichment of DNA damage response genes among these transcripts may explain how CDK12/13 achieves its apparent gene specificity. PAF1C-mediated recruitment of CDK12<sup>71</sup> may also be involved in the mechanism of CDK12’s gene specificity.

CDK9 在全基因组范围调控转录延伸，而 CDK12 则表现出独特的基因选择性。DNA 损伤应答基因的表达需要 CDK12，<sup>65,67,68</sup> 耗竭 CDK12 的细胞对 DNA 损伤剂敏感。<sup>67</sup> 因此，CDK12 通过促进 DNA 损伤应答保护基因组稳定性。用共价抑制剂 THZ531<sup>69</sup> 抑制 CDK12/13 激酶活性，会产生依赖基因长度的延伸缺陷：长基因的新生 RNA 在基因内部提前发生切割和多聚腺苷酸化，引起过早终止，因此长基因优先下调。<sup>70</sup> DNA 损伤应答基因恰好富集于这些依赖 CDK12/13 的长转录本中。<sup>70</sup> 长转录本对 CDK12/13 的依赖，以及 DNA 损伤应答基因在其中的富集，可能共同解释其表现出的基因选择性。PAF1C 介导的 CDK12 招募<sup>71</sup> 也可能参与这一机制。

Immunoprecipitation of cyclin K from human cell extracts led to the identification of CDK12 and CDK13 as its partner kinases.<sup>67</sup> While cyclin K forms the two distinct complexes CDK12/cyclin K and CDK13/cyclin K, it does not interact with the other elongation kinase CDK9 in human cells.<sup>67</sup> This suggests specificity of the CDK/cyclin interaction, with the following elongation kinase complexes present in vivo: CDK12/cyclin K, CDK13/cyclin K, and CDK9/cyclin T. Human CDK12 phosphorylates Ser2 CTD,<sup>67</sup> and depletion of CDK12 or cyclin K results in a limited decrease in the bulk levels of Ser2P (phospho-Ser2) CTD, but depletion of CDK13 has no effect.<sup>65,67,72</sup> In fly, CDK12 (a homolog of human CDK12/13) also interacts with cyclin K and phosphorylates Ser2 CTD.<sup>72</sup> A complementation assay revealed that human CDK9 is a functional homolog of the yeast kinase Bur1, whereas human CDK12/13 is a functional homolog of the yeast kinase Ctk1.<sup>72,73</sup> Ctk1 phosphorylates Ser2 CTD and Ctk1 knockout affects the recruitment of polyadenylation factors in yeast.<sup>74</sup> In human, CDK12 depletion results in loss of Ser2P toward the 3′ end of genes, with concomitant loss of 3′ end processing factor recruitment.<sup>75</sup> These results suggest that CDK12 has a conserved function in Ser2 phosphorylation and recruitment of 3′ end processing machinery. Phosphoproteomics analysis using the inhibitor THZ531 revealed that CDK12/ 13 also phosphorylate splicing and 3′ end processing factors.<sup>70</sup> This supports the idea that regulation of RNA processing involves CDK12/13-dependent phosphorylation of RNA processing factors.

通过从人细胞提取物中免疫沉淀细胞周期蛋白 K（细胞周期蛋白 K），研究者鉴定出其配对激酶 CDK12 和 CDK13。<sup>67</sup> 细胞周期蛋白 K 分别形成 CDK12/细胞周期蛋白 K 和 CDK13/细胞周期蛋白 K 两种复合物，但在人细胞中不与另一种延伸激酶 CDK9 相互作用。<sup>67</sup> 这提示 CDK 与细胞周期蛋白的配对具有特异性，体内存在 CDK12/细胞周期蛋白 K、CDK13/细胞周期蛋白 K 和 CDK9/细胞周期蛋白 T 三种延伸激酶复合物。人 CDK12 可磷酸化 CTD 的 Ser2，<sup>67</sup> 耗竭 CDK12 或细胞周期蛋白 K 只会使 CTD Ser2P（磷酸化 Ser2）的总体水平有限下降，而耗竭 CDK13 则没有影响。<sup>65,67,72</sup> 果蝇 CDK12 是人 CDK12/13 的同源物，它同样与细胞周期蛋白 K 相互作用，并磷酸化 CTD Ser2。<sup>72</sup> 互补实验表明，人 CDK9 是酵母激酶 Bur1 的功能同源物，而人 CDK12/13 是酵母激酶 Ctk1 的功能同源物。<sup>72,73</sup> 在酵母中，Ctk1 磷酸化 CTD Ser2，敲除 Ctk1 会影响多聚腺苷酸化因子的招募。<sup>74</sup> 在人细胞中，耗竭 CDK12 会使基因 3′ 端附近的 Ser2P 丢失，并伴随 3′ 端加工因子招募减少。<sup>75</sup> 这些结果提示，CDK12 在 Ser2 磷酸化和 3′ 端加工机器招募中具有保守功能。采用抑制剂 THZ531 的磷酸化蛋白质组学分析显示，CDK12/13 也会磷酸化剪接因子和 3′ 端加工因子，<sup>70</sup> 支持 RNA 加工调控涉及 CDK12/13 依赖的 RNA 加工因子磷酸化。

NELF—NOT JUST A NEGATIVE FACTOR｜NELF：不仅仅是负性因子

NELF has been recognized as a ‘‘negative’’ elongation factor since its biochemical purification following in vitro transcription assay systems by Hiroshi Handa and colleagues.<sup>76</sup> However, in vivo studies have shown that the depletion of NELF from cells impairs RNA Pol II elongation, suggesting a ‘‘positive’’ elongation factor role for NELF in cells. This discrepancy between in vitro and in vivo studies indicates the need for a careful reconsideration of roles for NELF. In this section, we discuss our current understanding of how NELF regulates RNA Pol II elongation in vitro and in vivo.

自 Hiroshi Handa 及其同事结合体外转录实验进行生化纯化、鉴定出 NELF 以来，它一直被视为“负性”延伸因子。<sup>76</sup> 然而，体内研究发现，从细胞中耗竭 NELF 会损害 RNA Pol II 延伸，提示它在细胞中还发挥“正性”延伸因子的作用。这种体外和体内结果的差异，要求我们重新审视 NELF 的功能。本节讨论目前对 NELF 在体外和体内调控 RNA Pol II 延伸机制的认识。

The discrepancy between in vitro and in vivo studies regarding NELF’s role in RNA Pol II elongation｜NELF 对 RNA Pol II 延伸的作用：体外与体内研究的差异

The in vitro inhibitory function of NELF in transcription was first demonstrated through biochemical analyses of reconstituted transcriptional activity on a naked DNA template.<sup>76</sup> An in vitro structural study suggested that NELF inhibits the catalytic activity of RNA Pol II in an allosteric manner.<sup>77</sup> The interaction of NELF with RNA Pol II leads to a tilted DNA-RNA hybrid that impairs the addition of nucleotides to nascent transcripts.<sup>77</sup> A functional connection between the inhibitory function of NELF in vitro and promoter-proximal pausing in vivo has been proposed, as organisms that possess NELF genes show more widespread pausing.<sup>78</sup>

NELF 在体外抑制转录的功能，最初通过在裸 DNA 模板上重构转录活性的生化分析得到证实。<sup>76</sup> 一项体外结构研究提示，NELF 通过变构方式抑制 RNA Pol II 的催化活性。<sup>77</sup> NELF 与 RNA Pol II 结合后，使 DNA–RNA 杂交体倾斜，从而妨碍核苷酸添加至新生转录本。<sup>77</sup> 由于具有 NELF 基因的生物表现出更广泛的暂停，研究者提出 NELF 的体外抑制功能与体内启动子近端暂停之间存在功能联系。<sup>78</sup>

One might expect that NELF depletion in cells would function as though brakes had been disengaged on RNA Pol II, releasing it into gene bodies. However, the tests of this model using knockdown approaches have suggested that NELF may not just act as brakes. Most genes largely retain promoter-proximal RNA Pol II after NELF depletion.<sup>22,79–82</sup> An exception is the hsp70 gene in Drosophila, where promoter-proximal RNA Pol II is lost upon NELF depletion.<sup>83,84</sup> At many genes, NELF-depleted cells exhibit decreased expression.<sup>80,82</sup> Mechanisms underlying these phenotypes in NELF-depleted cells had been unclear.

按照这一模型，细胞中耗竭 NELF 应如同松开 RNA Pol II 的刹车，使其释放进入基因体。然而，敲低实验提示 NELF 可能不仅充当刹车：大多数基因在 NELF 耗竭后，仍基本保留启动子近端 RNA Pol II。<sup>22,79–82</sup> 果蝇 hsp70 基因是一个例外，其启动子近端 RNA Pol II 在 NELF 耗竭后丢失。<sup>83,84</sup> 许多基因在 NELF 耗竭细胞中表达下降，<sup>80,82</sup> 但这些表型的机制一度并不清楚。

Recently, studies using targeted degradation approaches have provided new insights into the biological role of NELF. Upon rapid depletion of NELF, promoter-proximal RNA Pol II fails to be released, as shown by a reduction of elongating RNA Pol II at gene bodies.<sup>85,86</sup> While promoter-proximal RNA Pol II is retained upon NELF loss, the pause sites are shifted slightly downstream.<sup>85,86</sup> Notably, NELF-depleted cells exhibit inhibition waves of RNA Pol II elongation at gene bodies, representing a block of RNA Pol II release.<sup>86</sup> Similar inhibition waves have been observed upon the inhibition of CDK9, a positive elongation factor kinase.<sup>21</sup> We propose that NELF is not just a negative factor, but a ‘‘positive’’ elongation factor that regulates the efficient release of RNA Pol II into gene bodies. Consistent with this idea, the forced addition of NELF to transcribing polymerase does not negatively affect RNA Pol II elongation and does not force pausing, suggesting that pausing of RNA Pol II can take place independently of NELF.<sup>87</sup>

近期的靶向降解研究为 NELF 的生物学功能提供了新认识。快速耗竭 NELF 后，启动子近端 RNA Pol II 未能正常释放，表现为基因体内延伸中的 RNA Pol II 减少。<sup>85,86</sup> 启动子近端 RNA Pol II 虽然仍被保留，暂停位点却略向下游移动。<sup>85,86</sup> NELF 耗竭细胞的基因体内还出现 RNA Pol II 延伸抑制波，反映出 RNA Pol II 释放受阻。<sup>86</sup> 抑制正性延伸因子激酶 CDK9 时，也观察到类似的抑制波。<sup>21</sup> 我们因此提出，NELF 不仅是负性因子，也是一种促进 RNA Pol II 高效释放进入基因体的“正性”延伸因子。与这一观点一致，将 NELF 强制加入正在转录的聚合酶，并不抑制 RNA Pol II 延伸，也不强迫其暂停，提示 RNA Pol II 暂停能够独立于 NELF 发生。<sup>87</sup>

The transition to the downstream pause sites upon NELF loss<sup>85,86</sup> may be a key observation for reconciling the inhibitory function of NELF in vitro with an elongation-allowing mechanism in vivo. In the presence of NELF, RNA Pol II pause sites (denoted the 1<sup>st</sup> pause sites) are associated with the entrance to the +1 nucleosome,<sup>85</sup> which is ∼70 bp upstream of the dyad position. This position has also been shown to be a physical barrier to RNA Pol II as a cause of RNA Pol II stalling.<sup>88</sup> These results suggest that NELF arrests RNA Pol II at the 1<sup>st</sup> pause sites, likely through an allosteric inhibition of RNA Pol II.<sup>77</sup> Consistent with this idea, NELF was shown to be required for accumulation of the 1<sup>st</sup> pause site-associated RNA Pol II accumulation upon CDK9 inhibition.<sup>85,89</sup> Secondary pause sites observed in NELFdepleted cells are associated instead with the dyad region of the +1 nucleosome,<sup>85</sup> which physically blocks RNA Pol II elonga- tion. Disruption of the +1 nucleosome results in the promotion of RNA Pol II release, supporting the idea that the +1 nucleosome functions in RNA Pol II pausing.<sup>90</sup>

NELF 丢失后，暂停位点向下游转移，<sup>85,86</sup> 可能是协调其体外抑制功能与体内支持延伸作用的关键。存在 NELF 时，RNA Pol II 的暂停位点（称为第一暂停位点）位于 +1 核小体的入口附近，<sup>85</sup> 距核小体二重对称轴约 70 bp。这一位置也被证实构成使 RNA Pol II 停滞的物理屏障。<sup>88</sup> 这些结果提示，NELF 可能通过变构抑制 RNA Pol II，使其停留在第一暂停位点。<sup>77</sup> 与此一致，CDK9 受抑制时，RNA Pol II 在第一暂停位点的积累需要 NELF。<sup>85,89</sup> NELF 耗竭细胞中的第二暂停位点则位于 +1 核小体的二重对称轴区域，<sup>85</sup> 该区域会从物理上阻碍 RNA Pol II 延伸。破坏 +1 核小体可促进 RNA Pol II 释放，支持其参与 RNA Pol II 暂停的观点。<sup>90</sup>

Stabilizing 5′ end of transcripts by NELF｜NELF 稳定转录本的 5′ 端

How NELF plays a positive role in elongation is an important open question. Stabilization of nascent transcripts is crucial for proper control of elongation, as degradation of nascent transcripts has been linked to transcription termination.<sup>91</sup> Notably, it has been suggested that XRN2 (5′-3′ exoribonuclease 2)-dependent degradation at promoter-proximal regions triggers premature termination.<sup>92</sup> NELF is required for the long half-life of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II, suggesting a role for NELF in blocking premature termination.<sup>22</sup> Interestingly, a series of studies has suggested a role for NELF in 5′ capping, a co-transcriptional modification of nascent transcripts. Biochemical studies have found that NELF interacts with the cap-binding protein complex (CBC).<sup>93,94</sup> CBC interacts with 5′ capped RNA, stabilizing nascent transcripts by blocking decapping that would lead to degradation from the 5′ end.<sup>95</sup> A recent study demonstrated that NELF recruits CBC to promoter-proximal regions in vivo.<sup>85</sup> Upon NELF depletion, the 5′ cap is subsequently lost at a subset of genes.<sup>85</sup> This coincides with an increased occupancy of the mRNA-decapping enzyme 2 (DCP2) and the 5′-3′ exonuclease XRN2 at promoter-proximal regions.<sup>85</sup> It appears that NELF stabilizes nascent transcripts via CBC recruitment. The C-terminal ‘‘tentacle’’ of the NELF-E subunit binds to CBC<sup>93,94</sup> but also to promoter-proximal transcripts through the RNA recognition motif (RRM) domain of NELF-E.<sup>96</sup> It is thus possible that the interaction of the NELFE RRM with nascent transcripts assists in the recruitment of CBC. Interestingly, this RRM is dispensable for the inhibitory function of NELF in vitro,<sup>77</sup> suggesting a specific role for the RRM in elongation in vivo, such as CBC recruitment. The NELF-E tentacle is also involved in condensate formation at stress conditions.<sup>97</sup> This suggests that partitioning of NELF may alter the interaction with CBC and nascent transcripts. Collectively, these studies support the idea that NELF plays a positive role in elongation via CBC recruitment and subsequent stabilization of transcripts, thereby suppressing premature termination and promoting an efficient release of RNA Pol II into gene bodies (Figure 2).

NELF 如何在延伸中发挥正性作用，是一个重要的未解问题。新生转录本的稳定对正常控制延伸至关重要，因为其降解与转录终止有关。<sup>91</sup> 研究提示，启动子近端区域依赖 XRN2（5′–3′ 核糖核酸外切酶 2）的降解，可触发过早终止。<sup>92</sup> 启动子近端 RNA Pol II 较长的半衰期需要 NELF，提示 NELF 参与阻止过早终止。<sup>22</sup> 一系列研究还提示 NELF 参与新生转录本的共转录修饰——5′ 端加帽。生化研究发现，NELF 与帽结合复合物（CBC）相互作用。<sup>93,94</sup> CBC 结合具有 5′ 帽的 RNA，通过阻止去帽及随后的 5′ 端降解，稳定新生转录本。<sup>95</sup> 近期研究证实，NELF 在体内将 CBC 招募至启动子近端区域。<sup>85</sup> NELF 耗竭后，一部分基因的新生 RNA 丢失 5′ 帽，<sup>85</sup> 同时，mRNA 去帽酶 2（DCP2）和 5′–3′ 核酸外切酶 XRN2 在启动子近端区域的占据增加。<sup>85</sup> 因此，NELF 似乎通过招募 CBC 稳定新生转录本。NELF-E 亚基的 C 端“触手”可结合 CBC，<sup>93,94</sup> 也可通过 NELF-E 的 RNA 识别基序（RRM）结构域结合启动子近端转录本。<sup>96</sup> 因此，NELF-E RRM 与新生转录本的相互作用可能有助于 CBC 招募。NELF 的体外抑制功能并不需要这一 RRM，<sup>77</sup> 提示它可能在体内延伸中发挥 CBC 招募等特定作用。NELF-E 的触手也参与应激条件下的凝聚体形成，<sup>97</sup> 提示 NELF 的空间分配可能改变其与 CBC 及新生转录本的相互作用。总体上，这些研究支持 NELF 通过招募 CBC 并稳定转录本发挥正性延伸作用，从而抑制过早终止，促进 RNA Pol II 高效释放进入基因体（图 2）。

Figure 2. Promoter-proximal regulation by NELF (A) NELF recruits CBC to the 5′ end of a nascent transcript. NELF-CBC stabilizes a nascent transcript via (1) prevention of decapping by DCP2 and 5′ degradation by XRN2, (2) recruitment of U1 snRNA to block PAS-mediated cleavage by CPSF and CstF, and (3) suppression of Integrator-mediated cleavage. Stabilization of a nascent transcript facilitates efficient release of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II. (B) In the absence of NELF, promoter-proximal RNA Pol II at the +1 nucleosomal dyad is prone to premature termination due to destabilization of a nascent transcript by (1) decapping by DCP2 and 5′ degradation by XRN2, (2) PAS-mediated cleavage by CPSF and CstF, and (3) Integrator-mediated cleavage.

图 2｜NELF 在启动子近端的调控作用。（A）NELF 将 CBC 招募至新生转录本的 5′ 端。NELF–CBC 通过三种方式稳定新生转录本：（1）阻止 DCP2 去帽及 XRN2 从 5′ 端降解 RNA；（2）招募 U1 snRNA，阻断 CPSF 和 CstF 介导的、依赖多聚腺苷酸化信号（PAS）的切割；（3）抑制 Integrator 介导的切割。新生转录本的稳定有助于启动子近端 RNA Pol II 高效释放。（B）缺少 NELF 时，位于 +1 核小体二重对称轴处的启动子近端 RNA Pol II 更容易过早终止，因为以下过程使新生转录本不稳定：（1）DCP2 去帽及 XRN2 从 5′ 端降解 RNA；（2）CPSF 和 CstF 介导的 PAS 依赖性切割；（3）Integrator 介导的切割。

Stabilizing 3′ end of transcripts by NELF｜NELF 稳定转录本的 3′ 端

In addition to 5′ end capping regulation, NELF has also been shown to regulate 3′ end processing. A study in human cells demonstrated that NELF is required for cleavage of the 3′ end of snRNA transcripts by Integrator endonuclease and proper processing without polyadenylation.<sup>98</sup> Knockdown of NELF resulted in polyadenylation of snRNA transcripts and enhanced recruitment of the cleavage stimulation factor (CstF), which stimulates polyadenylation signal (PAS)-mediated cleavage and polyadenylation.<sup>98</sup> While NELF was shown to directly interacts with Integrator, NELF was dispensable for the recruitment of Integrator, and vice versa.<sup>98</sup> These results suggest that NELF facilitates Integrator-mediated 3′ end snRNA processing by preventing CstF recruitment. Notably, CstF recruitment to 5′ end of coding genes was also enhanced upon NELF knockdown,<sup>98</sup> suggesting that NELF functions to block 3′ end processing at promoter-proximal regions. It remains largely unclear how NELF prevents CstF recruitment, but CBC-NELF interaction might be key to this process. CBC has been shown to recruit the splicing factor U1 snRNP to 5′ splice sites.<sup>99</sup> Once U1 snRNP recognizes 5′ splice sites, it functions to hinder PAS-mediated cleavage.<sup>100</sup> Thus, CBC recruited by NELF is likely to be associated with inhibition of PAS-mediated cleavage through U1 recognition. This idea is further supported by the findings that NELF loss and U1 inhibition exhibit a similar phenotype of RNA Pol II elongation: NELF loss results in 2<sup>nd</sup> pause around the +1 nucleosomal dyad,<sup>85</sup> whereas U1 inhibition also causes accumulation of cleaved transcripts around the +1 nucleosomal dyad.<sup>101</sup> Apart from PAS-mediated cleavage, it is also unclear whether Integrator function is regulated by NELF at promoterproximal regions. Given the remarkably stable state of RNA Pol II pausing,<sup>22,79</sup> NELF might function to inhibit, but not stimulate, Integrator at promoter-proximal regions for stabilization of nascent transcripts. Because the forced addition of NELF to transcribing polymerase does not change the elongation properties of RNA Pol II,<sup>85</sup> NELF is unlikely to stimulate transcript cleavage that leads to premature termination.

除调控 5′ 端加帽外，NELF 还参与 3′ 端加工。一项人细胞研究表明，NELF 是 Integrator 内切酶切割 snRNA 转录本 3′ 端、使其正确加工而不发生多聚腺苷酸化所必需的。<sup>98</sup> 敲低 NELF 会导致 snRNA 转录本发生多聚腺苷酸化，并增强切割刺激因子（CstF）的招募；CstF 可促进多聚腺苷酸化信号（PAS）介导的切割和多聚腺苷酸化。<sup>98</sup> 尽管 NELF 与 Integrator 直接相互作用，但招募 Integrator 不需要 NELF，反过来也一样。<sup>98</sup> 这些结果提示，NELF 通过阻止 CstF 招募，促进 Integrator 介导的 snRNA 3′ 端加工。敲低 NELF 后，编码基因 5′ 端的 CstF 招募也增强，<sup>98</sup> 提示 NELF 可阻止启动子近端区域的 3′ 端加工。目前仍不清楚 NELF 如何阻止 CstF 招募，但 CBC–NELF 相互作用可能是关键。CBC 可将剪接因子 U1 snRNP 招募至 5′ 剪接位点。<sup>99</sup> U1 snRNP 识别这些位点后，可抑制 PAS 介导的切割。<sup>100</sup> 因此，NELF 招募的 CBC 很可能通过 U1 识别抑制 PAS 介导的切割。NELF 丢失与抑制 U1 引起相似的延伸表型，也支持这一观点：NELF 丢失导致 +1 核小体二重对称轴附近的第二次暂停，<sup>85</sup> 而 U1 抑制会使被切割的转录本在同一区域积累。<sup>101</sup> 除 PAS 介导的切割外，启动子近端 Integrator 的功能是否受 NELF 调控，目前也不清楚。考虑到 RNA Pol II 暂停状态相当稳定，<sup>22,79</sup> NELF 在此处可能通过抑制而非促进 Integrator 活性来稳定新生转录本。由于将 NELF 强制加入正在转录的聚合酶，并不改变 RNA Pol II 的延伸特性，<sup>85</sup> 因此 NELF 不太可能促进引起过早终止的转录本切割。

THE UNIVERSAL ELONGATION FACTOR DSIF CONTAINING SPT4/5｜含 SPT4/5 的通用延伸因子 DSIF

The role of the elongation factor SPT5 in eukaryotic transcription has been extensively studied over the last two decades. SPT5 is one of the most widely conserved ‘‘universal’’ elongation factors, as prokaryotic homologs of SPT5 (bacterial NusG and archaeal SPT5) show sequence and functional similarities to eukaryotic SPT5.<sup>102</sup> Early biochemical and genetic studies strongly suggested that SPT5 functions to regulate the elongation rate, promoter-proximal pausing and co-transcriptional processes. Recently, rapid depletion studies have demonstrated that SPT5 also functions to stabilize the RNA Pol II complex. In this section, we discuss various functions of the elongation factor SPT5 in eukaryotic transcription.

在过去二十年中，真核生物转录延伸因子 SPT5 的作用已被广泛研究。SPT5 是最广泛保守的“通用”延伸因子之一，因为 SPT5 的原核同源物（细菌 NusG 和古菌 SPT5）在序列和功能上与真核生物 SPT5 显示出相似性。<sup>102</sup> 早期的生化和遗传研究表明，SPT5 的功能在于调节延伸速率、启动子近端暂停以及共转录过程。最近的快速耗竭研究证明，SPT5 还参与稳定 RNA Pol II 复合物。在本节中，我们将讨论真核生物转录中延伸因子 SPT5 的各种功能。

Roles for SPT5 in the regulation of promoter-proximal pausing and processive elongation｜SPT5 在启动子近端暂停和过程性延伸调控中的作用

More than 25 years ago, the elongation factor SPT5 was initially identified and characterized in two independent studies. First, a genetic screening in S. cerevisiae isolated a series of transcription regulators, called SPT genes, including SPT5 and SPT4.<sup>103,104</sup> Yeast cells with SPT5 mutations or SPT4 gene deletion exhibited sensitivity to the nucleotide-depleting drug 6-azauracil, suggesting a role for SPT5 and SPT4 in transcription elongation in vivo.<sup>104</sup> Second, a biochemical study using human nuclear extracts identified the protein complex DRB sensitivity-inducing factor (DSIF), which consists of the human homologs of yeast SPT5 and SPT4, to be required for RNA Pol II pausing in vitro.<sup>105</sup> Notably, this study also found that, while DSIF is required for RNA Pol II pausing when CDK9 is inactive, when CDK9 is active DSIF is also required for stimulating the rate and speed of transcription elongation.<sup>105</sup> These genetic and biochemical observations led to the notion that SPT5-containing DSIF is involved in the regulation of at least two distinct transcriptional processes: promoterproximal pausing and processive elongation.

25 年多以前，延伸因子 SPT5 就在两项独立的研究中被首次鉴定和表征。首先，在酿酒酵母中进行的遗传筛选分离出一系列转录调节因子，称为 SPT 基因，包括 SPT5 和 SPT4。<sup>103,104</sup> 具有 SPT5 突变或 SPT4 基因缺失的酵母细胞对核苷酸耗竭药物 6-氮杂尿嘧啶敏感，这表明 SPT5 和 SPT4 在体内转录延伸中发挥作用。<sup>104</sup> 其次，使用人核提取物进行的生化研究鉴定出蛋白复合物 DRB 敏感性诱导因子（DSIF），该复合物由酵母 SPT5 和 SPT4 的人类同源物组成，被证明在体外对 RNA Pol II 暂停是必需的。<sup>105</sup> 值得注意的是，该研究还发现，当 CDK9 处于非活性状态时，DSIF 对于 RNA Pol II 暂停是必需的；而当 CDK9 处于活性状态时，DSIF 也参与刺激转录延伸速率和速度。<sup>105</sup> 这些遗传和生化观察结果促使人们认为，含有 SPT5 的 DSIF 参与调控至少两种不同的转录过程：启动子近端暂停和过程性延伸。

The formation of the DSIF/NELF/RNA Pol II complex is a characteristic feature of promoter-proximal pausing. Biochemical experiments have shown that NELF preferentially interacts with the preformed DSIF/RNA Pol II complex, rather than with RNA Pol II alone.<sup>106,107</sup> In agreement with this in vitro result, SPT5 was shown to be globally required for recruitment of NELF to the first promoter-proximal pause sites in human cells.<sup>108</sup> A recent cryoelectron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure has revealed that formation of the DSIF/NELF/RNA Pol II complex involves direct interaction between the unstructured tentacle of NELF-A and DSIF on the surface of RNA Pol II.<sup>77</sup> The significance of this interaction is supported by the finding that deletion of the NELF-A tentacle results in loss of RNA Pol II pausing in vitro,<sup>77</sup> although whether or not the NELF-A tentacle functions in this manner in vivo remains to be answered. Collectively, these observations suggest that SPT5-containing DSIF facilitates the formation of the DSIF/NELF/RNA Pol II complex at promoter-proximal regions.

形成 DSIF/NELF/RNA Pol II 复合物，是启动子近端暂停的一个特征。生化实验表明，相比单独的 RNA Pol II，NELF 更倾向于结合预先形成的 DSIF/RNA Pol II 复合物。<sup>106,107</sup> 与此一致，在人细胞中，将 NELF 招募至启动子近端第一暂停位点，普遍需要 SPT5。<sup>108</sup> 近期冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）结构显示，该复合物的形成涉及 NELF-A 无序“触手”与 RNA Pol II 表面 DSIF 的直接相互作用。<sup>77</sup> 删除 NELF-A 触手会使体外 RNA Pol II 暂停消失，<sup>77</sup> 支持这一相互作用的重要性；但它在体内是否以相同方式发挥作用，仍有待回答。这些观察共同提示，含 SPT5 的 DSIF 促进了启动子近端 DSIF/NELF/RNA Pol II 复合物的形成。

Efficient gene transcription requires proper regulation of the rate of transcript elongation. SPT5 boosts the rate of elongation on naked template DNA in vitro.<sup>105,109</sup> The dual interactions of SPT5 observed with both the DNA upstream of transcribing RNA Pol II and the exiting RNA transcript<sup>110,111</sup> suggest that SPT5 maintains the proper relative orientations of DNA and RNA, thereby facilitating productive elongation. SPT5 also colocalizes with actively transcribed genes and with high levels of the CTD Ser2P in cells,<sup>112–114</sup> supporting the idea that SPT5 similarly regulates the elongation rate in vivo. Consistent with this, a study in S. pombe has shown that rapid depletion of SPT5 results in a globally reduced elongation rate and decreased levels of mRNA expression.<sup>115</sup> Intriguingly, SPT5 depletion also increased the levels of antisense transcripts due to the activation of non-canonical, antisense transcription start site (TSS) proximal to canonical TSS,<sup>115</sup> suggesting that SPT5 not only stimulates the rate of elongation but also suppresses antisense transcription in S. pombe.

高效基因转录需要恰当调控转录本延伸速率。SPT5 可在体外提高裸 DNA 模板上的延伸速率。<sup>105,109</sup> 结构研究发现，SPT5 同时结合正在转录的 RNA Pol II 上游的 DNA 和从聚合酶伸出的 RNA 转录本，<sup>110,111</sup> 提示它可维持 DNA 与 RNA 的适当相对取向，从而促进有效延伸。细胞中的 SPT5 与活跃转录基因及高水平 CTD Ser2P 共定位，<sup>112–114</sup> 支持其在体内同样调控延伸速率。与此一致，裂殖酵母研究表明，快速耗竭 SPT5 会使全基因组延伸速率降低，并使 mRNA 表达水平下降。<sup>115</sup> SPT5 耗竭还会激活典型转录起始位点（TSS）附近的非典型反义 TSS，使反义转录本增加。<sup>115</sup> 这提示，SPT5 在裂殖酵母中既促进延伸速率，也抑制反义转录。

A newly recognized, conserved role for SPT5 in RNA Pol II stabilization｜SPT5 稳定 RNA Pol II 的新发现保守功能

Rapid depletion strategies have delivered a breakthrough in our understanding of how SPT5 functions in mammalian cells. Recent work revealed that SPT5 loss results in degradation of the largest RNA Pol II subunit B1 (RPB1),<sup>108,116</sup> for which the catalytic activity of the unfoldase VCP (valosin containing protein)/p97 is required.<sup>108</sup> Because SPT5 functions to stabilize RNA Pol II, it was crucial to determine whether transcriptional defects observed in SPT5-depleted cells result from RNA Pol II degradation directly or from degradation-independent changes in RNA Pol II function. Blocking RNA Pol II degradation with the VCP inhibitor NMS-873 revealed a significant reduction in the elongation rate upon SPT5 depletion, decoupled from the effects of RNA Pol II destabilization.<sup>108</sup> This result suggests that in addition to stabilizing RNA Pol II, SPT5 also independently functions to stimulate its elongation rate in vivo. Because SPT5 depletion from the nucleus also causes VCP-dependent degradation of RNA Pol II in S. cerevisiae,<sup>108</sup> SPT5’s function in stabilizing RNA Pol II may be broadly conserved in eukaryotic cells.

快速耗竭策略为理解 SPT5 在哺乳动物细胞中的功能带来了突破。近期研究发现，SPT5 丢失会导致 RNA Pol II 最大亚基 RPB1 降解，<sup>108,116</sup> 这一过程需要蛋白解折叠酶 VCP（valosin-containing protein）/p97 的催化活性。<sup>108</sup> 由于 SPT5 能稳定 RNA Pol II，因此必须确定：SPT5 耗竭细胞中的转录缺陷，究竟直接源于 RNA Pol II 降解，还是源于不依赖降解的 RNA Pol II 功能变化。使用 VCP 抑制剂 NMS-873 阻断 RNA Pol II 降解后，SPT5 耗竭仍使延伸速率显著下降，从而将这一效应与 RNA Pol II 不稳定的影响区分开来。<sup>108</sup> 该结果提示，SPT5 除稳定 RNA Pol II 外，还可在体内独立促进其延伸速率。酿酒酵母中，从细胞核耗竭 SPT5 同样会引起 VCP 依赖的 RNA Pol II 降解，<sup>108</sup> 因此 SPT5 稳定 RNA Pol II 的功能可能在真核细胞中广泛保守。

In human cells, the E3 ubiquitin ligase cullin 3 (CUL3) is required for RNA Pol II degradation upon SPT5 depletion.<sup>108</sup> CUL3, which is localized in both cytoplasm and nucleus, is recruited to chromatin and interacts with RNA Pol II in the absence of SPT5,<sup>108</sup> suggesting that SPT5 prevents CUL3 interaction with RNA Pol II. Direct substrates of the CUL3 ubiquitin ligase and the mechanism by which CUL3 recognizes the SPT5-depleted RNA Pol II complex remain to be determined. Transcription-coupled DNA repair and subsequent transcriptional recovery involve ubiquitylation and degradation of RPB1 mediated by cullin-RING ubiquitin ligases in mammalian cells.<sup>117,118</sup> While both cullin ligases including cullin 5 (CUL5) and non-cullin ligases including NEDD4 (neural precursor cell expressed developmentally downregulated protein 4) have been reported to be responsible for RPB1 ubiquitylation in mammalian cells,<sup>119</sup> a biochemical study showed that the cullin 4 (CUL4) ubiquitin ligase ubiquitylates the RPB1 subunit of the RNA Pol II elongation complex via its substrate receptor Cockayne syndrome A (CSA).<sup>120</sup> Notably, neither CUL5 nor NEDD4 was required for RPB1 degradation in SPT5-depleted cells,<sup>108</sup> suggesting a specific role for CUL3 in RNA Pol II degradation in the absence of SPT5. How each ubiquitin ligase contributes to RNA Pol II degradation remains an open question. Intriguingly, structural studies showed that SPT5 is displaced by Cockayne syndrome B (CSB) upon DNA damage,<sup>120,121</sup> suggesting a physiological significance for SPT5 removal from RNA Pol II during transcription-coupled DNA repair. However, whether SPT5 depletion without DNA damage results in CSB recruitment remains unclear. CDK9 kinase activity is also required for RNA Pol II degradation upon SPT5 depletion,<sup>108</sup> but no known CDK9 activators appear to regulate this activity: neither degradation of BRD4 by the PROTAC (proteolysis-targeting chimera) dBET6 nor inhibition of the SEC by KL2 impedes RNA Pol II degradation upon SPT5 depletion.<sup>108</sup> This result suggests either that CDK9 mediates RNA Pol II degradation without any activators or that it uses uncharacterized activators to trigger RNA Pol II degradation. Consistent with this result, early studies showed that in vitro ubiquitylation of RNA Pol II requires nuclear kinase activity and RNA Pol II CTD.<sup>122,123</sup>

在人类细胞中，E3 泛素连接酶 cullin 3（CUL3）对于 SPT5 耗竭后 RNA Pol II 的降解是必需的。<sup>108</sup> CUL3 定位于细胞质和细胞核，在没有 SPT5 的情况下被招募到染色质并与 RNA Pol II 相互作用，<sup>108</sup> 这表明 SPT5 阻止了 CUL3 与 RNA Pol II 的相互作用。CUL3 泛素连接酶的直接底物以及 CUL3 如何识别 SPT5 耗竭的 RNA Pol II 复合物的机制仍有待确定。转录耦联 DNA 修复及随后的转录恢复涉及由 cullin-RING 泛素连接酶介导的 RPB1 的泛素化和降解。<sup>117,118</sup> 虽然包括 cullin 5（CUL5）在内的 cullin 连接酶以及包括 NEDD4（神经前体细胞表达发育下调蛋白 4）在内的非 cullin 连接酶都被报道负责哺乳动物细胞中 RPB1 的泛素化，<sup>119</sup> 但一项生化研究表明，cullin 4（CUL4）泛素连接酶通过其底物受体 Cockayne 综合征 A（CSA）对 RNA Pol II 延伸复合物中的 RPB1 亚基进行泛素化。<sup>120</sup> 值得注意的是，CUL5 和 NEDD4 均不参与 SPT5 耗竭细胞中 RPB1 的降解，<sup>108</sup> 这表明 CUL3 在没有 SPT5 的情况下对 RNA Pol II 降解具有特异性作用。每个泛素连接酶如何贡献于 RNA Pol II 的降解仍然是一个开放性问题。有趣的是，结构研究表明，在 DNA 损伤时 SPT5 被 Cockayne 综合征 B（CSB）取代，<sup>120,121</sup> 这表明在转录耦联 DNA 修复过程中将 SPT5 从 RNA Pol II 上移除具有生理学意义。然而，SPT5 耗竭而无 DNA 损伤是否导致 CSB 招募尚不清楚。CDK9 激酶活性对于 SPT5 耗竭后 RNA Pol II 的降解也是必需的，<sup>108</sup> 但目前尚未发现已知的 CDK9 激活剂调节这一活性：无论是由 PROTAC（蛋白水解靶向嵌合体）dBET6 介导的 BRD4 降解，还是 KL2 对 SEC 的抑制均不能阻止 SPT5 耗竭后 RNA Pol II 的降解。<sup>108</sup> 这一结果表明，CDK9 可能在没有激活剂的情况下介导 RNA Pol II 的降解，或者它使用未表征的激活剂来触发 RNA Pol II 的降解。与此一致的是，早期研究表明，在体外 RNA Pol II 的泛素化需要核激酶活性和 RNA Pol II CTD。<sup>122,123</sup>

Phosphorylation regulates SPT5’s functions｜磷酸化调节 SPT5 的功能

Given that SPT5 functions in multiple steps of RNA Pol II elongation, it is important to understand how these distinct functions are regulated. It has been shown that phosphorylation of the threonine residues within SPT5’s C-terminal repeat (CTR) regions by CDK9 is required for SPT5 to stimulate the elongation rate both in vitro and in vivo.<sup>124</sup> To understand the function of SPT5 phosphorylation in living cells, it is useful to deplete wildtype (WT) SPT5 and complement with a transgene containing either WT SPT5 or SPT5 mutants in which the CTR threonine residues are substituted with alanine (CTR-TA) or glutamate (CTR-TE, a phospho-mimic). Human cells expressing the SPT5 CTR-TE mutant exhibit an increased release of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II and increased levels of mRNA expression at thousands of genes,<sup>125</sup> supporting the model that phosphorylation of its CTR threonine residues switches SPT5 from a pausing factor to a productive elongation factor.<sup>124</sup> In contrast, cells expressing the SPT5 CTR-TA mutant exhibit normal RNA Pol II distribution around the 5′ end of genes that is nearly identical to the distribution seen upon WT SPT5 expression,<sup>116,125</sup> suggesting that SPT5 CTR phosphorylation is not required for RNA Pol II release in normal conditions but rather promotes RNA Pol II release upon signaling induced by extracellular stimuli including epidermal growth factor (EGF) treatment.<sup>124</sup> Notably, CTR-TA mutations also result in early termination at the 3′ end of genes.<sup>116,125</sup> The levels of endogenous SPT5 CTR phosphorylation diminish downstream of poly(A) sites, and dephosphorylation of the CTR by protein phosphatase 1 (PP1) is required for proper termination in S. pombe and human cells.<sup>113,126</sup> These observations suggest that (1) in response to extracellular stimulus, SPT5 CTR phosphorylation at 5′ end of genes promotes the release of RNA Pol II into productive elongation, (2) increased levels of CTR phosphorylation within gene bodies may stimulate the elongation rate, and (3) CTR dephosphorylation at the 3′ end of genes slows down RNA Pol II, facilitating termination.

SPT5 在 RNA Pol II 延伸的多个步骤中发挥作用，因此理解这些不同功能如何受到调控十分重要。研究表明，CDK9 磷酸化 SPT5 C 端重复区（CTR）中的苏氨酸残基，是 SPT5 在体外和体内提高延伸速率所必需的。<sup>124</sup> 为研究这种磷酸化在活细胞中的作用，可先耗竭野生型（WT）SPT5，再用转基因表达 WT SPT5，或表达将 CTR 苏氨酸残基替换为丙氨酸（CTR-TA）或谷氨酸（CTR-TE，磷酸化模拟突变）的 SPT5。表达 CTR-TE 突变体的人细胞，表现为启动子近端 RNA Pol II 释放增加，以及数千个基因的 mRNA 表达升高，<sup>125</sup> 支持 CTR 苏氨酸磷酸化可使 SPT5 从暂停因子转为有效延伸因子的模型。<sup>124</sup> 相比之下，表达 CTR-TA 突变体的细胞，在基因 5′ 端附近的 RNA Pol II 分布几乎与表达 WT SPT5 时相同。<sup>116,125</sup> 这提示，正常条件下 SPT5 CTR 磷酸化并非 RNA Pol II 释放所必需，而可能主要在表皮生长因子（EGF）处理等细胞外刺激诱导的信号作用下促进释放。<sup>124</sup> CTR-TA 突变还会导致基因 3′ 端过早终止。<sup>116,125</sup> 内源性 SPT5 CTR 的磷酸化水平在 poly(A) 位点下游下降；在裂殖酵母和人细胞中，蛋白磷酸酶 1（PP1）对 CTR 的去磷酸化，是正常终止所必需的。<sup>113,126</sup> 这些观察提示：（1）响应细胞外刺激时，基因 5′ 端的 SPT5 CTR 磷酸化促进 RNA Pol II 释放并进入有效延伸；（2）基因体内 CTR 磷酸化水平升高可能提高延伸速率；（3）基因 3′ 端的 CTR 去磷酸化使 RNA Pol II 减速，从而促进终止。

It has also been shown that interaction between the SPT5 CTR and the RNA-capping enzyme increases capping efficiency and that CTR phosphorylation inhibits this interaction in vitro.<sup>127–131</sup> SPT5 CTR is positioned close to the RNA transcript exiting RNA Pol II,<sup>110,111</sup> supporting the idea that the capping enzyme contacts the 5′ end of newly synthesized RNA via interaction with the SPT5 CTR and that CTR phosphorylation releases the capping enzyme from the RNA exit tunnel to facilitate efficient release of RNA Pol II into productive elongation (Figure 3).

研究还表明，SPT5 CTR 与 RNA 加帽酶的相互作用可提高加帽效率，而 CTR 磷酸化在体外会抑制这种相互作用。<sup>127–131</sup> SPT5 CTR 位于从 RNA Pol II 伸出的 RNA 转录本附近，<sup>110,111</sup> 支持如下观点：加帽酶通过结合 SPT5 CTR 接触新生 RNA 的 5′ 端；CTR 磷酸化随后使加帽酶从 RNA 出口通道附近释放，促进 RNA Pol II 高效进入有效延伸（图 3）。

Figure 3. Functions of distinct SPT5 phosphorylation sites during transcriptional elongation Location of the KOWw4-5 linker and CTR phosphorylation sites are indicated in the 3D structure model of the RNA Pol II/SPT4/SPT5/NELF complex (PDB: 6GML<sup>77</sup>). RNA Pol II is colored in gray. Both the KOWw4-5 linker and CTR domains are positioned close to the nascent RNA exiting RNA Pol II. The RNA Pol II elongation-related phenotypes of phospho-mimic/phospho-deficient SPT5 mutants in these phosphorylation sites are also indicated.

图 3｜转录延伸中 SPT5 不同磷酸化位点的功能。RNA Pol II/SPT4/SPT5/NELF 复合物的三维结构模型（PDB：6GML<sup>77</sup>）标出了 KOWw4–5 连接区及 CTR 磷酸化位点的位置。RNA Pol II 为灰色。KOWw4–5 连接区和 CTR 结构域均邻近从 RNA Pol II 伸出的新生 RNA。图中还展示了这些位点的磷酸化模拟型或磷酸化缺失型 SPT5 突变体所引起的 RNA Pol II 延伸相关表型。

CDK9 phosphorylation of the serine residues within the SPT5 KOWx4-KOW5 linker domain<sup>20</sup> has also been shown to regulate RNA Pol II elongation at the 5′ end of genes.<sup>116,125</sup> Human cells with the SPT5 S666A mutation, where serine 666 within the KOWx4-KOW5 linker domain is substituted with alanine, exhibit high levels of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II.<sup>116,125</sup> Notably, the increased RNA Pol II release in CTR-TE mutants can be rescued by this phospho-deficient KOWx4-KOW5 linker mutation, resulting in the accumulation of paused RNA Pol II.<sup>125</sup> These observations indicate that phosphorylation of the KOWx4-KOW5 linker is essential for RNA Pol II release and that CTR phosphorylation may function to stimulate phosphorylation of the KOWx4-KOW5 linker in turn to increase the rate of RNA Pol II release. Integrator-type 2A protein phosphatase (PP2A) has been shown to dephosphorylate phospho-S666 both in vitro and in vivo,<sup>132</sup> suggesting that a balance between CDK9 phosphorylation and Integrator-PP2A dephosphorylation of the SPT5 KOWx4-KOW5 linker domain determines whether RNA Pol II is ultimately paused or released at promoter-proximal regions. However, whether SPT5 phosphorylation allosterically affects RNA Pol II processivity or whether it may recruit other elongation factors to modulate RNA Pol II pause release remains unclear.

CDK9 对 SPT5 KOWx4–KOW5 连接区内丝氨酸残基的磷酸化，<sup>20</sup> 也被证实参与调控基因 5′ 端的 RNA Pol II 延伸。<sup>116,125</sup> 携带 SPT5 S666A 突变的人细胞，即连接区中的第 666 位丝氨酸被丙氨酸替代时，启动子近端 RNA Pol II 水平升高。<sup>116,125</sup> 这一不能被磷酸化的连接区突变，还可逆转 CTR-TE 突变体中 RNA Pol II 释放增加的表型，使暂停的 RNA Pol II 积累。<sup>125</sup> 这些观察表明，KOWx4–KOW5 连接区的磷酸化是 RNA Pol II 释放所必需的，而 CTR 磷酸化可能先促进该连接区的磷酸化，继而提高 RNA Pol II 释放速率。与 Integrator 结合的 2A 型蛋白磷酸酶（PP2A），能够在体外和体内去除 S666 的磷酸化。<sup>132</sup> 这提示，CDK9 对 SPT5 连接区的磷酸化与 Integrator–PP2A 对其去磷酸化之间的平衡，决定 RNA Pol II 最终是在启动子近端暂停，还是释放。不过，目前仍不清楚 SPT5 磷酸化是通过变构作用影响 RNA Pol II 的过程性，还是通过招募其他延伸因子来调控暂停释放。

THE POLYMERASE-ASSOCIATED FACTOR, PAF1C｜聚合酶相关因子复合物 PAF1C

The elongation factor PAF1C, which is associated with both developmental processes and disease states, regulates multiple aspects of RNA Pol II elongation including promoter-proximal pausing, the rate of elongation and 3′ end co-transcriptional processes. PAF1C was initially identified by affinity purification of RNA-Pol-II-interacting proteins from cell extracts and its composition was characterized by biochemical experiments, from which we know that PAF1C consists of PAF1, CDC73 (cell division cycle 73), LEO1 (left open reading frame 1), CTR9 (cyclin three requiring 9), RTF1 (restores TBP function 1),<sup>133–136</sup> and a higher eukaryotic-specific subunit WDR61 (WD repeat-containing protein 61)/superkiller (SKI)8.<sup>137</sup> Cancer genetic studies also independently identified the PAF1 and CDC73 genes. The oncogene encoding PAF1/PD2 is located in an amplified chromosomal region (19q13 amplicon) that is frequently observed in pancreatic cancers.<sup>138</sup> The tumor-suppressor gene encoding CDC73/parafibromin/HRPT2 (hyperparathyroidism 2) is associated with hyperparathyroidism-jaw tumor syndrome.<sup>139</sup> In this section, we discuss the functions of metazoan PAF1C in the regulation of RNA Pol II elongation. Please refer to the recent review<sup>140</sup> for the functions of yeast PAF1C and for PAF1C’s functions in other regulatory processes including 3′ end processing.

延伸因子 PAF1C 与发育过程和疾病状态相关，调控 RNA Pol II 延伸的多个方面，包括启动子近端暂停、延伸速率以及 3′ 端共转录过程。PAF1C 最初通过从细胞提取物中亲和纯化 RNA Pol II 相互作用蛋白而被鉴定出来，并通过生化实验对其组成进行了表征，由此我们知道 PAF1C 由 PAF1、CDC73（细胞分裂周期 73）、LEO1（左开阅读框 1）、CTR9（cyclin three requiring 9）、RTF1（restores TBP function 1）<sup>133–136</sup>以及一个高等真核生物特异性的亚基 WDR61（WD 重复蛋白 61）/superkiller（SKI）8 组成。<sup>137</sup> 癌症遗传学研究也独立地鉴定出了 PAF1 和 CDC73 基因。编码 PAF1/PD2 的癌基因位于一个扩增的染色体区域（19q13 扩增子），该区域在胰腺癌中经常出现。<sup>138</sup> 编码 CDC73/parafibromin/HRPT2（甲状旁腺功能亢进症 2）的肿瘤抑制基因与甲状旁腺功能亢进-颌骨肿瘤综合征相关。<sup>139</sup> 在本节中，我们讨论了后生动物 PAF1C 在调控 RNA Pol II 延伸中的功能。请参阅最近的综述<sup>140</sup> 了解酵母 PAF1C 的功能及其在其他调控过程中的作用，包括 3′ 端加工。

Histone modifications mediated by PAF1C｜由 PAF1C 介导的组蛋白修饰

PAF1C has been shown to stimulate the transcription-coupled post-translational modification of histones. Early yeast studies revealed that PAF1C is required for monoubiquitination at histone H2B lysine 123 (K123ub), an epigenetic mark associated with active transcription.<sup>141–143</sup> In yeast, PAF1C stimulates the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme Rad6 and the E3 ubiquitin ligase Bre1, which are both responsible for deposition of H2B K123ub.<sup>141,144–148</sup> PAF1C/Rad6/Bre1-mediated deposition of H2B K123ub was further shown to be required for H3 lysine 4 (K4) methylation by COMPASS (complex of proteins associated with Set1) and for H3 lysine 79 (K79) methylation by Dot1, in a process of modification-dependent modification called histone cross talk.<sup>149–153</sup> H2B monoubiquitination recruits COMPASS to chromatin to promote H3 K4 methylation<sup>154</sup> and stimulates the methyltransferase activity of Dot1L.<sup>155</sup> Yeast studies also showed that the BUR1/BUR2 kinase complex (yeast homolog of CDK9/cyclin T) is required for H2B K123ub and H3 methylation, via recruitment of PAF1C.<sup>156,157</sup> Human PAF1C was later shown to mediate deposition of H2B K120ub (equivalent to yeast K123ub), catalyzed by the E2 enzyme RAD6 and the E3 ligase BRE1A/B,<sup>158–162</sup> suggesting a conserved role for PAF1C in stimulating transcription-coupled histone modifications.

PAF1C 可促进与转录耦联的组蛋白翻译后修饰。早期酵母研究发现，PAF1C 是组蛋白 H2B 第 123 位赖氨酸单泛素化（K123ub）所必需的；这一表观遗传标记与活跃转录有关。<sup>141–143</sup> 在酵母中，PAF1C 促进 E2 泛素结合酶 Rad6 和 E3 泛素连接酶 Bre1 的作用，两者共同负责建立 H2B K123ub。<sup>141,144–148</sup> 后续研究表明，PAF1C/Rad6/Bre1 介导的 H2B K123ub，是 COMPASS（与 Set1 相关的蛋白质复合物）催化 H3 第 4 位赖氨酸（K4）甲基化、以及 Dot1 催化 H3 第 79 位赖氨酸（K79）甲基化所必需的。这种一种修饰依赖另一种修饰的过程，称为组蛋白修饰串扰（histone cross talk）。<sup>149–153</sup> H2B 单泛素化将 COMPASS 招募至染色质，促进 H3 K4 甲基化，<sup>154</sup> 并增强 Dot1L 的甲基转移酶活性。<sup>155</sup> 酵母研究还显示，BUR1/BUR2 激酶复合物——CDK9/细胞周期蛋白 T 的酵母同源物——通过招募 PAF1C，参与 H2B K123ub 及 H3 甲基化。<sup>156,157</sup> 后来发现，人 PAF1C 同样介导由 E2 酶 RAD6 和 E3 连接酶 BRE1A/B 催化的 H2B K120ub；人 K120ub 对应于酵母 K123ub。<sup>158–162</sup> 这提示 PAF1C 在促进转录耦联的组蛋白修饰中具有保守作用。

PAF1C regulates promoter-proximal pausing｜PAF1C 调控启动子近端暂停

Initial evidence in human cells suggested that PAF1C can potentially inhibit and/or stimulate RNA Pol II release at promoter-proximal regions.<sup>56,71</sup> The inhibitory role for PAF1C in RNA Pol II release has been strongly supported by various in vivo findings.

最初在人类细胞中的证据表明，PAF1C 可能抑制和/或刺激 RNA Pol II 在启动子近端区域的释放。<sup>56,71</sup> 关于 PAF1C 在 RNA Pol II 释放中起抑制作用的观点已被多种体内研究结果强有力地支持。

A key finding is that rapid depletion of PAF1 in human cells results in an increase in RNA Pol II occupancy at gene bodies, and importantly, an increase in the levels of mRNA transcripts from short genes.<sup>87,163,164</sup> While the accumulation of RNA Pol II downstream of TSS could be explained by the reduced elongation rate in PAF1-depleted cells,<sup>165</sup> the elevated polyadenylated mRNA levels in short genes<sup>87,164</sup> strongly suggest the induction of RNA Pol II release upon PAF1 depletion. These observations support the notion that PAF1 depletion causes release of paused RNA Pol II and concomitantly leads to defects in processive transcription elongation. Indeed, PAF1 depletion results in premature termination due to loss of processivity, especially at >30-kb-long genes,<sup>165</sup> consistent with the observation that PAF1 loss leads to reduction of mRNA transcripts from long genes.<sup>87,164</sup>

一个关键发现是，快速耗竭人细胞中的 PAF1，会使基因体内 RNA Pol II 的占据增加，同时使短基因的 mRNA 转录本水平升高。<sup>87,163,164</sup> 尽管 PAF1 耗竭后延伸速率降低，可以解释 TSS 下游 RNA Pol II 的积累，<sup>165</sup> 短基因多聚腺苷酸化 mRNA 水平的升高，<sup>87,164</sup> 却强烈提示 PAF1 耗竭促进了 RNA Pol II 释放。这些观察支持：PAF1 耗竭既引起暂停的 RNA Pol II 释放，也同时导致过程性延伸缺陷。事实上，PAF1 耗竭会因过程性下降导致过早终止，在长度大于 30 kb 的基因中尤为明显；<sup>165</sup> 这与 PAF1 丢失使长基因 mRNA 减少的观察一致。<sup>87,164</sup>

The induction of RNA Pol II release in PAF1-depleted cells was shown to involve stimulation of the CDK9-containing complex SEC<sup>56</sup> and activation of enhancer transcription.<sup>163</sup> In addition, PAF1C also appears to inhibit RNA Pol II release through recruitment of Integrator-PP2A.<sup>164</sup> The loss of Integrator-PP2A recruitment in PAF1-depleted cells is correlated with the hyperphosphorylation of SPT5<sup>164</sup> (Figure 4). Phosphorylation of SPT5 S666 by CDK9, which is required for RNA Pol II release in human cells,<sup>116,125</sup> can be removed by Integrator-PP2A both in vivo and in vitro.<sup>132</sup> Thus, SPT5 S666 dephosphorylation by Integrator-PP2A may play a role in the PAF1C-mediated inhibition of RNA Pol II release (Figure 4; please also refer to the SPT5 section of this review). An alternative possibility is that the endonuclease activity of Integrator is involved in this process. RNA Pol II release in PAF1-depleted cells could then be explained by the lack of endonuclease-mediated transcription attenuation due to loss of Integrator recruitment.

PAF1 耗竭细胞中的 RNA Pol II 释放增加，涉及含 CDK9 的 SEC 活性增强<sup>56</sup> 及增强子转录激活。<sup>163</sup> 此外，PAF1C 似乎还通过招募 Integrator–PP2A 抑制 RNA Pol II 释放。<sup>164</sup> PAF1 耗竭后，Integrator–PP2A 招募减少与 SPT5 高磷酸化相关（图 4）。<sup>164</sup> CDK9 对 SPT5 S666 的磷酸化，是人细胞中 RNA Pol II 释放所必需的；<sup>116,125</sup> Integrator–PP2A 可在体内和体外去除这一磷酸化。<sup>132</sup> 因而，Integrator–PP2A 介导的 SPT5 S666 去磷酸化，可能参与 PAF1C 对 RNA Pol II 释放的抑制（图 4；另参见 SPT5 一节）。另一种可能是 Integrator 的内切酶活性参与这一过程：PAF1 耗竭使 Integrator 招募减少，导致内切酶介导的转录衰减不足，从而促进 RNA Pol II 释放。

Figure 4. PAF1 regulation in promoter-proximal pause release (A) With PAF1C, phospho-SPT5 is slowly increased because PAF1C recruits Integrator-PP2A to counteract SPT5 phosphorylation by CDK9, which is required for release of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II. (B) Without PAF1C, phospho-SPT5 is rapidly increased due to loss of Integrator-PP2A recruitment, resulting in stimulation of RNA Pol II release. Integrator-PP2A can associate with RNA Pol II through CTD binding even when PAF1C is lost (indicated as the dashed line). With PAF1C (A), after RNA Pol II release, PAF1C provides high processivity and stimulates elongation rate. Without PAF1C (B), RNA Pol II shows low processivity and slow elongation.

图 4｜PAF1 对启动子近端暂停释放的调控。（A）存在 PAF1C 时，SPT5 磷酸化水平缓慢升高，因为 PAF1C 招募 Integrator–PP2A，对抗 CDK9 介导的 SPT5 磷酸化；而这种磷酸化是启动子近端 RNA Pol II 释放所必需的。（B）缺少 PAF1C 时，由于 Integrator–PP2A 招募减少，SPT5 磷酸化水平迅速升高，从而促进 RNA Pol II 释放。即使失去 PAF1C，Integrator–PP2A 仍可通过结合 CTD 与 RNA Pol II 相互作用（虚线所示）。在存在 PAF1C 的条件下（A），RNA Pol II 释放后，PAF1C 维持其高过程性并提高延伸速率；缺少 PAF1C 时（B），RNA Pol II 的过程性较低，延伸也较慢。

In support of a role for the PAF1C in negatively regulating RNA Pol II pause/release, it was demonstrated that PAF1C transiently forms a PAF1C-MYC complex, which inhibits RNA Pol II release at MYC-targeted genes, and that depletion of the PAF1C subunit CDC73 stimulates the expression of these genes.<sup>166</sup> Furthermore, genetic evidence in zebrafish also supports the idea that PAF1C negatively regulates release of RNA Pol II. A loss of erythroid gene expression observed in the zebrafish tif1g mutant moonshine was rescued by depletion of PAF1C subunits.<sup>167</sup> Notably, the foggy/spt5 V1012D mutation, which exhibits induced release of RNA Pol II with normal elongation rates in vitro, also rescued moonshine.<sup>167</sup> These results in zebrafish suggest that depletion of PAF1C results in induced release of RNA Pol II, thereby restoring lost erythroid gene expression in moonshine. Finally, depletion of SPT6 causes loss of PAF1C recruitment and stimulates RNA Pol II release in human cells,<sup>87</sup> which further supports the inhibitory role for PAF1C in RNA Pol II release.

支持 PAF1C 负向调控暂停/释放的另一证据是，PAF1C 可短暂形成 PAF1C–MYC 复合物，抑制 MYC 靶基因处的 RNA Pol II 释放；耗竭 PAF1C 亚基 CDC73 则促进这些基因表达。<sup>166</sup> 斑马鱼遗传学证据同样支持这一观点：tif1g 突变体 moonshine 中红系基因表达的缺失，可通过耗竭 PAF1C 亚基挽救。<sup>167</sup> foggy/spt5 V1012D 突变在体外可促进 RNA Pol II 释放而不改变延伸速率，也能挽救 moonshine 表型。<sup>167</sup> 这些结果提示，耗竭 PAF1C 促进 RNA Pol II 释放，从而恢复 moonshine 中丢失的红系基因表达。最后，在人细胞中，耗竭 SPT6 会使 PAF1C 招募减少并促进 RNA Pol II 释放，<sup>87</sup> 进一步支持 PAF1C 在这一过程中的抑制作用。

Accumulation of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II observed in PAF1-depleted cells can also be explained by RNA Pol II pausing, suggesting a stimulatory role for PAF1 in RNA Pol II release.<sup>71</sup> This stimulation model was strongly supported by the finding that PAF1C is required for CDK9-mediated RNA Pol II release in vitro.<sup>20</sup> It remains unclear how PAF1C stimulates RNA Pol II release, but PAF1C recruitment or conformational changes on RNA Pol II may be an important mechanism for this stimulation. The recruitment of PAF1C to RNA Pol II requires the removal of NELF, as PAF1C and NELF are sterically incompatible with simultaneous binding to RNA Pol II.<sup>20</sup> The removal of NELF from RNA Pol II results in RNA Pol II release in vitro.<sup>76</sup> Therefore, the displacement of NELF by PAF1C may be a part of mechanism of RNA Pol II release in vitro. However, it should be noted that NELF depletion in human cells is not sufficient for RNA Pol II release<sup>85</sup> and that NELF-bound RNA Pol II can also be released into gene bodies.<sup>87</sup> The key question here is what causes accumulation of RNA Pol II downstream of TSS upon PAF1 depletion. RNA Pol II release, elongation defects, or RNA Pol II pausing may each be a cause of this accumulation, as we discussed above. Importantly, these mechanisms are not mutually exclusive; for example, RNA Pol II release and elongation defects can occur simultaneously. Additionally, the balance of kinase and phosphatase activities appears to be a crucial aspect of the PAF1C-dependent mechanism (Figure 4). Nucleosomes, chromatin remodeling and co-transcriptional processes may also be involved. Therefore, dissecting the functions of PAF1C inside the cells within the complex context of transcriptional elongation through native chromatin will be an important direction toward a better understanding of pause/release mechanisms.

在 PAF1 缺失细胞中观察到的启动子近端 RNA Pol II 积累也可以通过 RNA Pol II 暂停来解释，这表明 PAF1 对 RNA Pol II 释放具有促进作用。<sup>71</sup> 这一促进模型得到了以下发现的强有力支持：PAF1C 对 CDK9 介导的 RNA Pol II 释放是必需的。<sup>20</sup> 目前尚不清楚 PAF1C 如何促进 RNA Pol II 的释放，但 PAF1C 在 RNA Pol II 上的招募或构象变化可能是这种促进的重要机制。PAF1C 招募到 RNA Pol II 需要 NELF 的去除，因为 PAF1C 和 NELF 不能同时结合到 RNA Pol II 上。<sup>20</sup> 从 RNA Pol II 上移除 NELF 会导致 RNA Pol II 在体外释放。<sup>76</sup> 因此，PAF1C 对 NELF 的置换可能是 RNA Pol II 在体外释放机制的一部分。然而，需要注意的是，在人类细胞中，NELF 的缺失不足以引起 RNA Pol II 的释放<sup>85</sup>，并且 NELF 结合的 RNA Pol II 也可以被释放到基因体中。<sup>87</sup> 这里的关键问题是，PAF1 缺失后在 TSS 下游 RNA Pol II 积累的原因是什么。RNA Pol II 的释放、延伸缺陷或 RNA Pol II 暂停都可能是这种积累的原因，如我们上面所讨论的那样。重要的是，这些机制并非互斥；例如，RNA Pol II 的释放和延伸缺陷可以同时发生。此外，激酶和磷酸酶活性之间的平衡似乎是 PAF1C 依赖机制的关键方面（图 4）。核小体、染色质重塑和共转录过程也可能参与其中。因此，在复杂的转录延伸背景下通过天然染色质来解析 PAF1C 在细胞内的功能，将是更好地理解暂停/释放机制的重要方向。

PAF1C regulates the rate of elongation｜PAF1C 调节延伸速率

A large number of in vitro and in vivo studies have shown that PAF1C positively regulates elongation by stimulating the rate of elongation and maintaining processivity. In vitro, PAF1C is required for promoting elongation on a biochemically prepared chromatin template.<sup>168</sup> This function is distinct from the earlier described histone ubiquitylation- and methylation-dependent chromatin transcription activities of PAF1C,<sup>168</sup> suggesting that PAF1C directly regulates RNA Pol II processivity without modulating histone modifications. The dissociable PAF1C subunit RTF1<sup>137,169</sup> allosterically stimulates the elongation rate on a naked DNA template in vitro.<sup>170</sup> The localization pattern of RTF1 within gene bodies is distinct from that of other PAF1C subunits: RTF1 is dissociated from chromatin earlier than other PAF1C subunits toward the 3′ end of genes,<sup>87</sup> suggesting an RTF1-specific role in the regulation of the elongation rate within gene bodies. Depletion of either PAF1 or RTF1 in mammalian cells significantly lowers the rate of elongation.<sup>165,171</sup> The slowed RNA Pol II found in PAF1-depleted cells also exhibits premature termination at the middle of genes,<sup>164,165</sup> which indicates low processivity. These observations all suggest that PAF1C is required to complete elongation in long genes. Consistent with this notion, rapid depletion of PAF1 in human cells results in the specific downregulation of mRNA transcribed from long genes.<sup>87,164</sup>

大量体外和体内研究表明，PAF1C 通过刺激延伸速率并维持延伸过程性来正向调节延伸。在体外，PAF1C 对于在生化制备的染色质模板上促进延伸是必需的。<sup>168</sup> 这一功能不同于之前描述的依赖组蛋白泛素化和甲基化的染色质转录活性<sup>168</sup>，表明 PAF1C 直接调节 RNA Pol II 的过程性而不调节组蛋白修饰。可分离的 PAF1C 亚基 RTF1<sup>137,169</sup>在体外能够变构地刺激裸露 DNA 模板上的延伸速率。<sup>170</sup> RTF1 在基因体内的定位模式不同于其他 PAF1C 亚基：RTF1 在基因 3′ 端方向上比其他 PAF1C 亚基更早地从染色质上解离<sup>87</sup>，这表明 RTF1 在基因体内延伸速率调节中具有特异性作用。在哺乳动物细胞中耗竭 PAF1 或 RTF1 会显著降低延伸速率。<sup>165,171</sup> 在 PAF1 耗竭的细胞中发现的延伸缓慢的 RNA Pol II 还表现出在基因中间部位的过早终止<sup>164,165</sup>，这表明其过程性较低。这些观察结果都表明，PAF1C 对于长基因完成延伸是必需的。与此一致的是，在人类细胞中快速耗竭 PAF1 会导致长基因转录的 mRNA 特异性下调。<sup>87,164</sup>

It should be noted that, while promoter-proximal RNA Pol II is globally released upon PAF1 depletion in these studies, whether this release increases the levels of mRNA transcribed from a gene depends on its length, as mRNA levels are increased for short genes but decreased for long genes.<sup>87,164</sup> Given that elongation defects can depend on gene length in this way, researchers need to be cautious when analyzing genome-wide RNA Pol II distribution data using ‘‘meta-gene,’’ which assumes a single hypothetical gene length. Instead, an analysis using actual gene lengths can provide more informative and reproducible conclusions. Such analyses also help to distinguish the functional regulation of elongation rate from that of RNA Pol II pause release.

需要注意的是，在这些研究中，尽管在 PAF1 耗竭后启动子近端的 RNA Pol II 总体上被释放，但这种释放是否增加某个基因转录的 mRNA 水平取决于该基因的长度：对于短基因 mRNA 水平升高，而对于长基因则降低。<sup>87,164</sup> 鉴于延伸缺陷可能以这种方式依赖于基因长度，研究人员在使用“元基因”分析全基因组 RNA Pol II 分布数据时需要谨慎，因为“元基因”假设了一个单一的假想基因长度。相反，使用实际基因长度进行分析可以提供更有信息量和可重现的结论。这样的分析还有助于区分延伸速率的功能调节与 RNA Pol II 暂停释放的功能调节。

eRNAs and PROMPTs｜eRNAs 和 PROMPTs

In addition to its role in the transcription of coding genes, pause/ release during elongation is involved in the transcription of enhancer RNAs (eRNAs) and promoter upstream transcripts (PROMPTs) by RNA Pol II.<sup>172</sup> These transcripts are short and unstable compared with coding transcripts. PAF1C was shown to inhibit activation of enhancer transcription in human cells.<sup>163</sup> A recent study revealed that PAF1C also functions in the transcriptional termination eRNAs and PROMPTs.<sup>173</sup> PAF1 depletion in mouse cells results in the accumulation of length-extended eRNAs and PROMPTs and the loss of Integrator recruitment to these transcription units.<sup>173</sup> These results suggest that PAF1C promotes 3′ end processing of eRNAs and PROMPTs by recruiting Integrator endonuclease activity.

除了在编码基因转录中的作用外，延伸过程中的暂停/释放也参与了增强子 RNA（eRNAs）和启动子上游转录本（PROMPTs）的转录。<sup>172</sup> 与编码转录本相比，这些转录本更短且不稳定。已显示 PAF1C 在人类细胞中抑制增强子转录的激活。<sup>163</sup> 最近的一项研究揭示了 PAF1C 还在 eRNAs 和 PROMPTs 的转录终止中发挥作用。<sup>173</sup> 在小鼠细胞中耗竭 PAF1 会导致长度延伸的 eRNAs 和 PROMPTs 积累，并且这些转录单元失去 Integrator 的招募。<sup>173</sup> 这些结果表明，PAF1C 通过招募 Integrator 内切酶活性促进 eRNAs 和 PROMPTs 的 3′ 端加工。

PAF1C interaction with other factors｜PAF1C 与其他因子的相互作用

PAF1C has been shown to physically interact with a large number of proteins. As we discussed above, interaction of PAF1C and Integrator facilitates not only the regulation of promoterproximal pausing through Integrator-PP2A activity<sup>164</sup> but also the cleavage of non-coding RNA transcripts through the endonuclease activity of Integrator.<sup>173</sup> In addition, transcription through nucleosomes involves interaction between the PAF1C subunit RTF1 and the FACT (facilitates chromatin transcription) complex in vitro,<sup>174</sup> although the functional significance of this interaction remains unclear.

PAF1C 已被证明能与大量蛋白质发生物理相互作用。如上所述，PAF1C 与 Integrator 的相互作用不仅通过 Integrator-PP2A 活性促进启动子近端暂停的调控<sup>164</sup>，而且通过 Integrator 的内切酶活性促进非编码 RNA 转录本的切割<sup>173</sup>。此外，在核小体上进行的转录涉及 PAF1C 亚基 RTF1 与 FACT（促进染色质转录）复合物在体外的相互作用<sup>174</sup>，尽管这种相互作用的功能意义尚不清楚。

Of note, little data are available regarding the function of the higher eukaryote-specific PAF1C subunit WDR61/SKI8 in transcriptional regulation. Along with SKI2 and SKI3, WDR61/SKI8 forms the SKI complex, a conserved cytoplasmic cofactor of the exosomal RNA degradation machinery, and SKI2 helicase subunit has been shown to channel RNA into the exosome, thereby stimulating exosomal exoribonuclease activity.<sup>175,176</sup> Although PAF1C-dependent recruitment of SKI3 and WDR61/SKI8 to chromatin has been reported,<sup>137</sup> whether the WDR61/SKI8 subunit of PAF1C functions to facilitate exosomal activity via the SKI complex will require further investigation. There is a notable difference in the stoichiometry of WDR61/SKI8 relative to other subunits in PAF1C and the SKI complex. RNA-Pol-II-bound PAF1C contains one copy of each individual subunit, including WDR61/SKI8, whereas SKI is a tetrameric complex with 1:1:2 stoichiometry between SKI2:SKI3:WDR61/SKI8.<sup>177</sup> Structural studies of RNA-PolII-bound PAF1C revealed that CTR9 within PAF1C interacts with the top surface of the WDR61/SKI8 beta-propeller structure,<sup>20,170</sup> the same surface that interacts with SKI3 within the SKI complex.<sup>175,176</sup> Though WDR61/SKI8 participates in both the PAF1C and SKI complexes, these structural observations support a model in which the participation of WDR61/SKI8 in either complex is mutually exclusive.

目前，关于高等真核生物特有的 PAF1C 亚基 WDR61/SKI8 在转录调控中的作用，数据仍然很少。WDR61/SKI8 与 SKI2、SKI3 一起组成 SKI 复合物，后者是 RNA 外切体降解机器的一种保守的细胞质辅助因子。SKI2 解旋酶亚基可将 RNA 引导进入 RNA 外切体，增强其核糖核酸外切酶活性。<sup>175,176</sup> 尽管已有研究报道，SKI3 和 WDR61/SKI8 以依赖 PAF1C 的方式被招募至染色质，<sup>137</sup> PAF1C 中的 WDR61/SKI8 是否通过 SKI 复合物促进 RNA 外切体活性，仍有待研究。WDR61/SKI8 在 PAF1C 和 SKI 复合物中相对于其他亚基的化学计量比明显不同：与 RNA Pol II 结合的 PAF1C 中，每个亚基均为一个拷贝，包括 WDR61/SKI8；SKI 则是一个四聚体复合物，SKI2:SKI3:WDR61/SKI8 的比例为 1:1:2。<sup>177</sup> RNA Pol II 结合态 PAF1C 的结构研究表明，CTR9 与 WDR61/SKI8 的 β-螺旋桨结构顶面相互作用；<sup>20,170</sup> 而在 SKI 复合物中，同一表面与 SKI3 相互作用。<sup>175,176</sup> 因此，虽然 WDR61/SKI8 可参与两种复合物，但结构证据支持其结合 PAF1C 或 SKI 复合物是相互排斥的。

PAF1C recruitment｜PAF1C 的招募

Recruitment of PAF1C to RNA Pol II has been shown to require the presence of another elongation factor, SPT6, in living cells.<sup>87,178</sup> Rapid depletion of SPT6 results in the loss of PAF1C recruitment in yeast and human cells,<sup>87,178</sup> suggesting a conserved mechanism for PAF1C recruitment by SPT6. The interaction between the PAF1C subunit CDC73 and SPT6 is required to direct PAF1C to RNA Pol II in S. cerevisiae.<sup>178</sup> The structurally determined interaction between CTR9 and SPT6<sup>20</sup> may also be involved in PAF1C recruitment. As SPT6 itself is recruited to RNA Pol II in a CDK9-dependent manner (please refer to the SPT6 section of this review), PAF1C recruitment must therefore also be regulated by CDK9. Consistently, CDK9 has been shown to be required for PAF1C recruitment in human cells<sup>71</sup> and for the replacement of PAF1C with NELF in vitro.<sup>20</sup> SPT6 is required for PAF1C’s function in pause/release, elongation rate modulation, and regulation of chromatin modifications.<sup>87,178</sup> Thus, recruitment of PAF1C by SPT6 and CDK9 is a key initializing step required for PAF1C to functionally regulate multiple steps of the RNA Pol II elongation process.

已有研究表明，PAF1C 在活细胞中向 RNA Pol II 的招募需要另一种延伸因子 SPT6 的存在<sup>87,178</sup>。快速耗竭 SPT6 会导致酵母和人类细胞中 PAF1C 招募的丧失<sup>87,178</sup>，这表明 SPT6 介导 PAF1C 招募的机制是保守的。在酿酒酵母中，PAF1C 亚基 CDC73 与 SPT6 的相互作用对于将 PAF1C 定向至 RNA Pol II 是必需的<sup>178</sup>。结构确定的 CTR9 与 SPT6 之间的相互作用<sup>20</sup>也可能参与了 PAF1C 的招募过程。由于 SPT6 本身是以 CDK9 依赖的方式被招募到 RNA Pol II 上的（请参见本综述中 SPT6 部分），因此 PAF1C 的招募也必须受到 CDK9 的调控。一致地，CDK9 已被证明在人类细胞中是 PAF1C 招募所必需的<sup>71</sup>，并且在体外对于 PAF1C 被 NELF 替换也是必需的<sup>20</sup>。SPT6 对于 PAF1C 在暂停/释放、延伸速率调节和染色质修饰调控中的功能是必需的<sup>87,178</sup>。因此，由 SPT6 和 CDK9 介导的 PAF1C 招募是 PAF1C 功能性调控 RNA Pol II 延伸过程多个步骤的关键初始化步骤。

译注：本段原文写作“replacement of PAF1C with NELF”，方向与本节前文及后文所述的“以 PAF1C 置换 NELF”相反，可能为原文笔误；英文原句予以保留。

MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS OF ELONGATION FACTOR SPT6｜延伸因子 SPT6 的多重功能

Among the known transcription elongation factors, SPT6 is one of the largest polypeptides (∼200 kDa in human), comprising multiple domains, with many protein interactants identified. Here, we summarize the multiple functions of SPT6 in transcription elongation.

在已知的转录延伸因子中，SPT6 是最大的多肽之一（人类中约 200 kDa），包含多个结构域，并且已鉴定出许多蛋白质相互作用伙伴。在此，我们总结了 SPT6 在转录延伸中的多重功能。

Identification of SPT6 as an elongation factor｜SPT6 作为延伸因子的鉴定

The SPT6 gene was initially identified through yeast genetic screening by Fred Winston and colleagues.<sup>103,179</sup> This gene is widely conserved among eukaryotic cells, from yeast to human. In yeast, spt6 mutant cells are sensitive to the nucleotidedepleting agent 6-azauracil and show conditional lethality upon gene deletion of TFIIS, suggesting a role for SPT6 in transcription elongation.<sup>104</sup> Consistently, SPT6 localizes to active transcription sites of RNA Pol II in fly.<sup>112</sup> Recent studies utilizing rapid depletion of SPT6 have confirmed that SPT6 regulates transcription elongation genome-wide in human cells.<sup>87,171,180</sup> SPT6 has been shown to regulate the rate of elongation both in vitro<sup>181</sup> and in vivo.<sup>180,182</sup>

SPT6 基因最初通过 Fred Winston 及其同事进行的酵母遗传筛选被鉴定出来。<sup>103,179</sup> 该基因在真核细胞中广泛保守，从酵母到人类均有分布。在酵母中，spt6 突变体细胞对核苷酸耗竭剂 6-氮杂尿嘧啶敏感，并且在删除 TFIIS 基因时表现出条件致死性，这表明 SPT6 在转录延伸中发挥作用。<sup>104</sup> 一致地，SPT6 定位于果蝇 RNA Pol II 的活跃转录位点。<sup>112</sup> 最近利用快速耗竭 SPT6 的研究已证实，SPT6 在人类细胞中广泛调控转录延伸。<sup>87,171,180</sup> SPT6 已被证明在体外<sup>181</sup>和体内<sup>180,182</sup>均能调节延伸速率。

Function of the SPT6 C-terminal region｜SPT6 C 端区域的功能

The C-terminal region of SPT6 contains the tandem SH2 (tSH2) domain, which is required for the SPT6-RNA Pol II interaction.<sup>183,184</sup> The SPT6 tSH2 domain directly binds to the RNA Pol II CTD linker region that tethers the CTD to the RNA Pol II core.<sup>20,185</sup> Phosphorylation of the CTD linker significantly increases the affinity for the SPT6 tSH2 domain in vitro.<sup>20,185</sup> These results suggest that the phosphorylation of the CTD linker by P-TEFb<sup>20,186</sup> or other kinases is likely to stimulate the SPT6-RNA Pol II interaction. Interestingly, deletion or mutation of the SPT6 tSH2 domain causes only a partial reduction of SPT6 occupancy at RNA Pol-II-transcribed genes in yeast.<sup>185,187–189</sup> Thus, there is a tSH2-independent mechanism of SPT6 recruitment to gene regions.

SPT6 的 C 端含有串联 SH2（tSH2）结构域，是 SPT6 与 RNA Pol II 相互作用所必需的。<sup>183,184</sup> 该结构域直接结合 RNA Pol II 的 CTD 连接区，后者将 CTD 与 RNA Pol II 核心相连。<sup>20,185</sup> 体外实验显示，CTD 连接区磷酸化可显著提高其对 SPT6 tSH2 结构域的亲和力。<sup>20,185</sup> 因此，P-TEFb<sup>20,186</sup> 或其他激酶磷酸化 CTD 连接区，可能促进 SPT6–RNA Pol II 相互作用。有趣的是，在酵母中删除或突变 tSH2 结构域，只会部分降低 SPT6 在 RNA Pol II 转录基因上的占据。<sup>185,187–189</sup> 这说明 SPT6 招募至基因区域还存在不依赖 tSH2 的机制。

Function of the SPT6 N-terminal region｜SPT6 N 端区域的功能

The N-terminal region of SPT6 has been shown to interact with IWS1 (interacts with Spt6)/Spn1 (suppresses postrecruitment functions gene number 1).<sup>130,183,190–193</sup> IWS1 is conserved among eukaryotic cells and essential for viability.<sup>194</sup> In addition to binding the RNA export factor (REF)/Aly,<sup>183</sup> it forms a multivalent interaction with transcription elongation regulators including ELOA (elongin A), PPP1R10 (PP1 regulatory subunit 10), LEDGF (lens epithelium-derived growth factor), HRP2 (hepatoma-derived growth factor-related protein 2), and TFIIS (transcription factor IIS) through conserved modules of disordered protein interaction.<sup>195,196</sup> A mutation of IWS1 that disrupts binding to LEDGF and HRP2 causes defects in transcription elongation.<sup>195</sup> The IWS1-RNA Pol II interaction is also dependent on SPT6,<sup>197</sup> suggesting that SPT6 recruits IWS1 to RNA Pol II. These results suggest that the SPT6-IWS1 interaction provides a central hub for recruiting a host of factors regulating transcription elongation and mRNA transport (Figure 5). A recent study revealed that SPT6, IWS1, PAF1C, and RNA Pol II form a nuclear condensate that facilitates gene activation,<sup>198</sup> suggesting that functions of SPT6 IWS1 hub involve spatial partitioning of elongation factors.

SPT6 的 N 端区域可与 IWS1（interacts with Spt6）/Spn1（suppresses postrecruitment functions gene number 1）相互作用。<sup>130,183,190–193</sup> IWS1 在真核细胞中保守，并且是细胞存活所必需的。<sup>194</sup> 除与 RNA 输出因子 REF/Aly 结合外，<sup>183</sup> IWS1 还通过保守的无序蛋白相互作用模块，与多种转录延伸调控因子形成多价相互作用，包括 ELOA（延伸素 A）、PPP1R10（PP1 调节亚基 10）、LEDGF（晶状体上皮来源生长因子）、HRP2（肝癌来源生长因子相关蛋白 2）和 TFIIS（转录因子 IIS）。<sup>195,196</sup> 破坏 IWS1 与 LEDGF、HRP2 结合的突变，会导致转录延伸缺陷。<sup>195</sup> IWS1 与 RNA Pol II 的相互作用同样依赖 SPT6，<sup>197</sup> 提示 SPT6 将 IWS1 招募至 RNA Pol II。这些结果表明，SPT6–IWS1 相互作用构成了一个中心枢纽，可招募一系列调控转录延伸和 mRNA 运输的因子（图 5）。近期研究发现，SPT6、IWS1、PAF1C 和 RNA Pol II 可形成促进基因激活的核内凝聚体，<sup>198</sup> 提示 SPT6–IWS1 枢纽的功能涉及延伸因子的空间分隔与富集。

Figure 5. SPT6 recruits numerous elongation factors to RNA Pol II (Left) The interaction between the SPT6 C-terminal tSH2 domain and the phosphorylated RNA Pol II CTD linker domain is indicated in the 3D structure model of the RNA Pol II/DSIF/PAF1C/SPT6 complex (PDB: 6GMH<sup>20</sup>). (Right) IWS1 and the nucleosome are competitively associated with the N-terminal domain of SPT6. IWS1 interacts with many factors including LEDGF, TFIIS, ELOA, and HRP2. Dashed lines indicate competitive interactions of IWS1 with these factors. These interactions may serve the numerous functions of SPT6 to prevent cryptic initiation and promote productive elongation.

图 5｜SPT6 将多种延伸因子招募至 RNA Pol II。（左）RNA Pol II/DSIF/PAF1C/SPT6 复合物的三维结构模型（PDB：6GMH<sup>20</sup>）展示了 SPT6 C 端 tSH2 结构域与磷酸化 RNA Pol II CTD 连接区之间的相互作用。（右）IWS1 与核小体竞争结合 SPT6 的 N 端结构域。IWS1 可与 LEDGF、TFIIS、ELOA、HRP2 等多种因子相互作用，虚线表示这些因子与 IWS1 的竞争性相互作用。这些相互作用可能支持 SPT6 抑制隐性起始、促进有效延伸等多种功能。

In addition to IWS1, the N-terminal region of SPT6 also binds to histones.<sup>190,199,200</sup> Interactions between SPT6 and either histones or IWS1 are mutually exclusive,<sup>190</sup> implicating a regulatory mechanism of factor swapping between IWS1 and histones at the SPT6 N-terminal region. The SPT6-histone interaction has been associated with the function of SPT6 in repressing cryptic initiation at intragenic regions in yeast.<sup>201–206</sup> Further analysis in human cells has shown that long-term (but not rapid) depletion of SPT6 results in cryptic initiation.<sup>180</sup> When cryptic initiation occurs, intragenic binding of TFIIB (transcription factor IIB) and TBP (TATA-binding protein) increases and nucleosomal positioning patterns are altered.<sup>180,202</sup> Interestingly, mutations of the SPT6 tSH2 domain that disrupt binding to RNA Pol II also cause cryptic initiation in yeast.<sup>185</sup> Thus, repression of cryptic intragenic initiation requires both SPT6-histone and SPT6-RNA Pol II interactions. SPT6 also appears to have histone-related roles beyond transcription, maintaining the centromeric histone variant CENP-A (centromere protein A) through their direct interaction in flies.<sup>207</sup>

除 IWS1 外，SPT6 的 N 端也可结合组蛋白。<sup>190,199,200</sup> SPT6 与组蛋白或 IWS1 的相互作用相互排斥，<sup>190</sup> 提示其 N 端可能通过在两者之间交换结合伙伴实现调控。SPT6–组蛋白相互作用与 SPT6 在酵母中抑制基因内部隐性转录起始的功能有关。<sup>201–206</sup> 人细胞研究进一步发现，长期而非快速耗竭 SPT6 才会引起隐性起始。<sup>180</sup> 隐性起始发生时，基因内部的 TFIIB（转录因子 IIB）和 TBP（TATA 结合蛋白）结合增加，核小体定位模式也发生改变。<sup>180,202</sup> 在酵母中，破坏 SPT6 tSH2 结构域与 RNA Pol II 结合的突变，同样会引起隐性起始。<sup>185</sup> 因此，抑制基因内部隐性起始，需要 SPT6–组蛋白及 SPT6–RNA Pol II 两种相互作用。SPT6 似乎还有超出转录范畴的组蛋白相关功能：在果蝇中，它通过直接结合着丝粒组蛋白变体 CENP-A（着丝粒蛋白 A）来维持后者。<sup>207</sup>

Promoter-proximal pause/release and PAF1C recruitment by SPT6｜SPT6 介导的启动子近端暂停/释放和 PAF1C 的招募

Recently, SPT6 was found to regulate promoter-proximal pause/ release through the recruitment of the PAF1C to RNA Pol II.<sup>87</sup> Rapid depletion of SPT6 in human cells leads to the release of RNA Pol II from promoter-proximal regions and a defect in PAF1C recruitment to RNA Pol II.<sup>87</sup> This result is consistent with the previous finding that PAF1 loss leads to RNA Pol II release.<sup>56,163</sup> Interestingly, loss of either SPT6 or PAF1 also causes an observable elongation defect in long genes.<sup>87,164,165</sup> When PAF1C recruitment is impaired, NELF remains bound to RNA Pol II at gene bodies.<sup>87</sup> Thus, the swap of NELF for PAF1C by SPT6 is important for productive elongation in long genes. This result also suggests that NELF-bound RNA Pol II is transcription competent, which supports the idea that NELF is a positive elongation factor.

最近发现，SPT6 通过招募 PAF1C 至 RNA Pol II 来调节启动子近端暂停/释放。<sup>87</sup> 在人类细胞中快速耗竭 SPT6 会导致 RNA Pol II 从启动子近端区域释放，并且在 RNA Pol II 上招募 PAF1C 出现缺陷。<sup>87</sup> 这一结果与先前发现 PAF1 缺失会导致 RNA Pol II 释放一致。<sup>56,163</sup> 有趣的是，SPT6 或 PAF1 的缺失也会导致长基因中可观察到的延伸缺陷。<sup>87,164,165</sup> 当 PAF1C 招募受阻时，NELF 仍结合在基因体上的 RNA Pol II 上。<sup>87</sup> 因此，SPT6 通过将 NELF 替换为 PAF1C 对于长基因中的有效延伸至关重要。这一结果也表明，结合了 NELF 的 RNA Pol II 具有转录能力，这支持了 NELF 是一种正性延伸因子的观点。

Processivity and 3′ end control by SPT6, PAF1C, and CDK12/13｜SPT6、PAF1C 和 CDK12/13 对过程性及 3′ 端的调控

Elongation processivity, which is an ability of RNA Pol II to complete transcription for the entire gene length, and 3′ end RNA processing are functionally coupled. This is because processivity is substantially decreased when the nascent RNA is prematurely cleaved and polyadenylated via 3′ end processing factors, resulting in premature termination.<sup>208</sup> As we discussed earlier, generation of long transcripts requires PAF1C, SPT6, and CDK12/13 kinases, which strongly suggests the role for these factors in RNA Pol II processivity and 3′ end processing. It remains unclear how PAF1C, SPT6, and CDK12/13 cooperatively regulate these processes. SPT6 recruits PAF1C to RNA Pol II,<sup>87,178</sup> while PAF1C is required for CDK12 recruitment.<sup>71</sup> Interestingly, CDK12 inhibition using an analog-sensitive (as) mutant results in loss of SPT6 and PAF1C.<sup>209</sup> A reduction of Ser2P levels upon CDK12-as inhibition<sup>209</sup> may contribute to loss of SPT6, as SPT6 preferentially interacts with Ser2P CTD.<sup>183</sup> These observations raise the possibility that CDK12 plays a key role in a positive feedback system that facilitates processivity, where SPT6 and PAF1C recruits CDK12 and CDK12 supports recruitment of SPT6 and PAF1C. Likewise, regulation of the rate of elongation (or velocity), which requires at least SPT6 and PAF1C, may also involve such cooperative mechanism. This idea is consistent with the finding that SPT6 depletion results in decreased rate of elongation and concomitant loss of processivity.<sup>180</sup>

延伸过程性，即 RNA Pol II 完成整个基因转录的能力，与 RNA 的 3′ 端加工在功能上相互耦联。这是因为，一旦新生 RNA 被 3′ 端加工因子提前切割并多聚腺苷酸化，过程性便显著降低，导致过早终止。<sup>208</sup> 如前所述，长转录本的生成需要 PAF1C、SPT6 和 CDK12/13 激酶，强烈提示这些因子参与调控 RNA Pol II 的过程性及 3′ 端加工。目前仍不清楚它们如何协同调控这些过程。SPT6 将 PAF1C 招募至 RNA Pol II，<sup>87,178</sup> 而 CDK12 的招募需要 PAF1C。<sup>71</sup> 有趣的是，利用类似物敏感型（as）突变体抑制 CDK12，会导致 SPT6 和 PAF1C 丢失。<sup>209</sup> 抑制 CDK12-as 后 Ser2P 水平降低，<sup>209</sup> 可能促成 SPT6 丢失，因为 SPT6 优先与 Ser2P CTD 相互作用。<sup>183</sup> 这些观察提示，CDK12 可能在促进过程性的正反馈系统中发挥关键作用：SPT6 和 PAF1C 招募 CDK12，而 CDK12 又支持 SPT6 和 PAF1C 的招募。类似地，至少依赖 SPT6 和 PAF1C 的延伸速率调控，也可能涉及这种协作机制。SPT6 耗竭会降低延伸速率，并同时使过程性下降，<sup>180</sup> 与这一观点一致。

INTEGRATOR: A MULTIFUNCTIONAL REGULATOR OF RNA POL II TRANSCRIPTION｜Integrator：RNA Pol II 转录的多功能调节因子

Integrator is a gigantic multisubunit complex that directly interacts with transcribing RNA Pol II. Since its biochemical identification by Ramin Shiekhattar and colleagues,<sup>210</sup> Integrator has been shown to play various key roles in regulating transcription and RNA processing. Similar to NELF, Integrator is evolutionarily conserved only in metazoan.<sup>210</sup> In this chapter, we discuss mechanisms of RNA Pol II elongation regulated by two catalytic modules of Integrator: the RNA endonuclease module and the protein phosphatase module. For details on the structural insights and other functional modules, please refer to the recent reviews.<sup>211,212</sup>

Integrator 是一个直接与正在转录的 RNA Pol II 相互作用的巨大多亚基复合物。自 Ramin Shiekhattar 及其同事通过生化方法鉴定该复合物以来，<sup>210</sup> 研究表明它在转录和 RNA 加工调控中具有多种关键功能。与 NELF 类似，Integrator 仅在后生动物中具有进化保守性。<sup>210</sup> 本节讨论 Integrator 的两个催化模块——RNA 内切酶模块和蛋白磷酸酶模块——调控 RNA Pol II 延伸的机制。有关结构研究及其他功能模块的详细介绍，请参阅近期综述。<sup>211,212</sup>

Integrator-RNA Pol II CTD interaction｜Integrator-RNA Pol II CTD 相互作用

Integrator has a high affinity for the RNA Pol II CTD. While Integrator interacts with the unmodified CTD,<sup>210,213</sup> CTD phosphorylation at Tyr1, Ser2, and/or Ser7 strengthens this interaction.<sup>214–216</sup> In addition, Integrator also interacts with NELF, SPT5, and the surface of RNA Pol II,<sup>98,217,218</sup> forming a large, promoter-proximal paused RNA Pol II/Integrator complex. Consistent with these lines of structural and biochemical evidence, it has been shown that Integrator, RNA Pol II, NELF, and SPT5 all co-localize at promoter-proximal regions.<sup>218–220</sup> Integrator is also recruited to gene bodies<sup>220</sup> via the physical interaction with PAF1C.<sup>164,173</sup> SPT6, which recruits PAF1C to RNA Pol II,<sup>87,178</sup> was also shown to be required for Integrator recruitment to genes.<sup>221</sup> These results suggest that (1) at promoter-proximal regions, Integrator is associated with NELF, SPT5, RNA Pol II surface, and CTD, (2) in gene bodies, after NELF is replaced with PAF1, Integrator remains associated with RNA Pol II through the CTD and PAF1C. The Integrator’s high affinity to the CTD<sup>210,213–215</sup> may allow for retention of Integrator at RNA Pol II when the NELF-PAF1 exchange takes place.

Integrator 对 RNA Pol II CTD 具有高亲和力。它既能与未修饰的 CTD 相互作用，<sup>210,213</sup> CTD 的 Tyr1、Ser2 和/或 Ser7 磷酸化又可进一步增强这一结合。<sup>214–216</sup> Integrator 还与 NELF、SPT5 和 RNA Pol II 的表面相互作用，<sup>98,217,218</sup> 形成庞大的启动子近端暂停态 RNA Pol II/Integrator 复合物。与这些结构和生化证据一致，Integrator、RNA Pol II、NELF 和 SPT5 在启动子近端区域共定位。<sup>218–220</sup> Integrator 也被招募至基因体，<sup>220</sup> 这一过程涉及其与 PAF1C 的物理相互作用。<sup>164,173</sup> 将 PAF1C 招募至 RNA Pol II 的 SPT6，<sup>87,178</sup> 也被证实是 Integrator 招募至基因所必需的。<sup>221</sup> 这些结果提示：（1）在启动子近端，Integrator 与 NELF、SPT5、RNA Pol II 表面及 CTD 相联系；（2）进入基因体后，NELF 被 PAF1 置换，Integrator 则仍通过 CTD 和 PAF1C 与 RNA Pol II 结合。Integrator 对 CTD 的高亲和力，<sup>210,213–215</sup> 可能使其在 NELF–PAF1 交换过程中仍保留于 RNA Pol II 上。

RNA endonuclease module of Integrator｜Integrator 的 RNA 内切酶模块

The Integrator endonuclease module consists of INTS4 (Integrator complex subunit 4), INTS9, and the catalytic subunit INTS11.<sup>210,222</sup> The catalytically deficient mutation of INTS11 (E203Q in human) causes various defects in 3′ end processing of transcripts, including U small nuclear RNA,<sup>210</sup> mRNA,<sup>223,224</sup> eRNA,<sup>225</sup> and microRNA.<sup>226</sup> Thus, the endonuclease activity is broadly required for 3′ end processing. Notably, the INTS11 E203Q mutation results in readthrough transcription at 3′ end of mRNA genes.<sup>223,224</sup> This readthrough yields downstream-ofgene (DoG)-containing transcript, a type of long non-coding RNA associated with human diseases. For the details of DoG function, please refer to the recent review.<sup>227</sup>

Integrator 的内切酶模块由 INTS4（Integrator 复合物亚基 4）、INTS9 和催化亚基 INTS11 组成。<sup>210,222</sup> INTS11 的催化失活突变（人 INTS11 的 E203Q）可引起多类转录本的 3′ 端加工缺陷，包括 U 类小核 RNA、<sup>210</sup> mRNA、<sup>223,224</sup> eRNA<sup>225</sup> 和微小 RNA。<sup>226</sup> 因此，其内切酶活性广泛参与 3′ 端加工。INTS11 E203Q 突变会使 mRNA 基因 3′ 端发生转录通读，<sup>223,224</sup> 产生包含基因下游区域（DoG）的转录本；这是与人类疾病有关的一类长链非编码 RNA。有关 DoG 的详细功能，请参阅近期综述。<sup>227</sup>

Integrator also regulates transcription elongation at 5′ end of protein-coding genes via its endonuclease activity. When the catalytic subunit INTS11 is depleted or mutated, the level of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II is increased.<sup>219,228–231</sup> Two models are widely appreciated to explain how Integrator controls RNA Pol II pause/release. The turnover model proposes that Integrator can sense elongation-deficient RNA Pol II and remove it from promoters, thereby recruiting an elongation-competent RNA Pol II replacement and facilitating the transition of RNA Pol II to productive elongation.<sup>219,220</sup> Direct evidence for this model came from the fact that Integrator is required not only for maintaining steady-state transcription<sup>219,232</sup> but also for rapidly upregulating gene expression in response to the acute stimuli of growth factor EGF or heat shock.<sup>220</sup> In addition, Integrator interacts with the SEC,<sup>220</sup> which is also required for rapid gene activation.<sup>42,47</sup> Consistent with these results, rapid depletion of INTS11 was recently shown to induce pausing and reduce mRNA synthesis.<sup>230</sup> Thus, in the turnover model Integrator positively regulates gene expression by providing quality control for the RNA Pol II elongation machinery. However, how Integrator recognizes an elongation-deficient RNA Pol II remains largely unknown.

Integrator 还通过其内切酶活性调控蛋白编码基因 5′ 端的转录延伸。耗竭催化亚基 INTS11 或使其发生突变，均会提高启动子近端 RNA Pol II 水平。<sup>219,228–231</sup> 目前有两种得到广泛讨论的模型，解释 Integrator 如何控制暂停/释放。周转模型认为，Integrator 识别延伸能力不足的 RNA Pol II 并将其从启动子移除，从而使具有延伸能力的 RNA Pol II 替代它，促进向有效延伸的转变。<sup>219,220</sup> 直接支持这一模型的证据是，Integrator 不仅是维持稳态转录所必需的，<sup>219,232</sup> 也是响应 EGF 或热休克等急性刺激、快速上调基因表达所必需的。<sup>220</sup> 此外，Integrator 与 SEC 相互作用，<sup>220</sup> 而 SEC 同样参与快速基因激活。<sup>42,47</sup> 与此一致，近期研究发现快速耗竭 INTS11 会诱导暂停并减少 mRNA 合成。<sup>230</sup> 因而，在周转模型中，Integrator 通过对 RNA Pol II 延伸机器进行质量控制，正向调控基因表达；但它如何识别延伸能力不足的 RNA Pol II，仍不清楚。

Alternatively, the premature termination model proposes that Integrator removes promoter-proximal RNA Pol II, leading to attenuation of gene expression.<sup>228</sup> This model is supported by the finding that INTS11 depletion or mutation in fly cells results in gene upregulation.<sup>228,233</sup> Consistently, the rapid depletion of INTS11 in mouse embryonic stem cells also causes gene upregulation.<sup>229</sup> Notably, the upregulated genes are enriched in short genes.<sup>229</sup> It is likely that long genes are not upregulated upon INTS11 depletion due to a concomitant reduction in the elongation rate.<sup>229</sup> However, how Integrator regulates elongation rates remains largely unknown. PAF1C and SPT6 have been shown to promote Integrator recruitment to genes,<sup>164,173,221</sup> suggesting a possible interplay between Integrator and elongation factors.

另一种过早终止模型认为，Integrator 移除启动子近端 RNA Pol II，从而降低基因表达。<sup>228</sup> 支持这一模型的证据是，在果蝇细胞中耗竭 INTS11 或使其突变，可使基因表达上调。<sup>228,233</sup> 在小鼠胚胎干细胞中，快速耗竭 INTS11 同样使基因表达上调，<sup>229</sup> 且上调基因中富集了短基因。<sup>229</sup> 长基因可能由于延伸速率同时降低，而未表现出表达上调。<sup>229</sup> 但 Integrator 如何调控延伸速率，目前仍不清楚。PAF1C 和 SPT6 可促进 Integrator 向基因招募，<sup>164,173,221</sup> 提示 Integrator 与这些延伸因子之间可能存在协作。

Although these two models appear to make opposing claims, there are some biological concepts in common. First, the endonuclease activity of Integrator is required for the removal of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II in both models. Whether RNA cleavage by Integrator results in gene upregulation or downregulation may depend on the context of gene expression, such as rapid induction. Consistent with this idea, a recent study suggested that whether INTS11 loss promotes or attenuates productive elongation depends on the steady-state expression levels.<sup>231</sup> It remains unclear how RNA cleavage by Integrator could lead to RNA Pol II removal. Perhaps upon cleavage an exposed 5′ end of nascent RNA is captured by the exonuclease XRN2, and the subsequent RNA degradation leads to RNA Pol II eviction (please refer to the review concerning this ‘‘torpedo’’ model<sup>91</sup>). Second, Integrator is required for productive elongation in both models, at least in long genes.
