As we mentioned above, Integrator is functionally associated with various elongation factors including SEC, PAF1C, and SPT6. In addition, Integrator’s protein phosphatase module may play a key role in the elongation process (we will discuss this below).

尽管这两种模型看似提出了相反的主张，但它们之间存在一些共同的生物学概念。首先，在两种模型中，Integrator 的内切酶活性对于启动子近端 RNA Pol II 的去除都是必需的。Integrator 介导的 RNA 切割导致基因上调或下调可能取决于基因表达的背景，例如快速诱导。与此观点一致，最近的一项研究提出，INTS11 缺失促进还是减弱有效延伸取决于稳态表达水平。<sup>231</sup> 目前尚不清楚 Integrator 介导的 RNA 切割如何导致 RNA Pol II 的去除。也许在切割后，新生 RNA 的暴露 5′ 端被外切酶 XRN2 捕获，并随后的 RNA 降解导致 RNA Pol II 被驱逐（请参阅关于这一“鱼雷”模型的综述<sup>91</sup>）。其次，在两种模型中，Integrator 对于有效延伸都是必需的，至少在长基因中是如此。如上所述，Integrator 在功能上与多种延伸因子相关，包括 SEC、PAF1C 和 SPT6。此外，Integrator 的蛋白磷酸酶模块可能在延伸过程中发挥关键作用（我们将在下面讨论）。

Protein phosphatase module of Integrator｜Integrator 的蛋白磷酸酶模块

The recent identification of Integrator’s protein phosphatase activity<sup>132,234,235</sup> has dramatically expanded the scope of Integrator functions. The scaffold (A) and catalytic (C) subunits of PP2A associate together with the Integrator subunits INTS6 and INTS8 to form the protein phosphatase module of Integrator.<sup>132,234,235</sup> Depletion of INTS6 or INTS8 results in dissociation of the PP2A-A and PP2A-C subunits from the Integrator complex and actively transcribed genes,<sup>132,234,235</sup> suggesting that INTS6/8 recruit PP2A-A and PP2A-C to transcribing RNA Pol II. Several lines of evidence have revealed that the phosphatase and RNA endonuclease modules of Integrator are functionally distinct. Depletion of INTS6 or INTS8 does not affect the 3′ end processing of U snRNA transcripts,<sup>234,235</sup> suggesting that the RNA endonuclease module is still active without the phosphatase module. Consistently, the endonuclease module and scaffold subunits of Integrator can form a fully assembled complex without INTS6 or INTS8 subunits.<sup>235</sup> Notably, the phosphatase module retains its activity without INTS11, the catalytic subunit of the RNA endonuclease module.<sup>229</sup> Thus, the endonuclease and phosphatase modules of Integrator can be independently regulated during transcription.

近期发现 Integrator 具有蛋白磷酸酶活性，<sup>132,234,235</sup> 大幅拓展了我们对其功能的认识。PP2A 的支架亚基 A 和催化亚基 C，与 Integrator 亚基 INTS6、INTS8 一同组成蛋白磷酸酶模块。<sup>132,234,235</sup> 耗竭 INTS6 或 INTS8，会使 PP2A-A 和 PP2A-C 从 Integrator 复合物及活跃转录基因上解离，<sup>132,234,235</sup> 提示 INTS6/8 将这两个亚基招募至正在转录的 RNA Pol II。多项证据显示，磷酸酶模块与 RNA 内切酶模块在功能上相对独立。耗竭 INTS6 或 INTS8 不影响 U snRNA 转录本的 3′ 端加工，<sup>234,235</sup> 表明缺少磷酸酶模块时，RNA 内切酶模块仍有活性。与此一致，不含 INTS6 或 INTS8 时，内切酶模块与支架亚基仍能组装成完整复合物。<sup>235</sup> 而缺少 RNA 内切酶的催化亚基 INTS11 时，磷酸酶模块也保留活性。<sup>229</sup> 因此，Integrator 的内切酶和磷酸酶模块可在转录过程中独立受到调控。

The substrates of Integrator-PP2A include the RNA Pol II CTD (Ser2, Thr4, Ser5, and Ser7), SPT5 (Ser666 and Thr806), and other RNA-Pol-II-interacting factors.<sup>132,234,235</sup> Notably, phosphatase module substrates are also phosphorylated by CDK9, suggesting that Integrator-PP2A may counteract CDK9, and that small molecule activators of PP2A (SMAPs) could have the benefit of sensitizing cancers to CDK9 inhibition. Indeed, double treatment with the CDK9 inhibitor AZD-4573 and the PP2A activator DBK-1154 in a mouse xenograft model has shown synergistic anti-cancer activity in vivo.<sup>235</sup>

Integrator–PP2A 的底物包括 RNA Pol II CTD（Ser2、Thr4、Ser5、Ser7）、SPT5（Ser666、Thr806）及其他 RNA Pol II 相互作用因子。<sup>132,234,235</sup> 这些底物也受到 CDK9 磷酸化，提示 Integrator–PP2A 可能拮抗 CDK9，而 PP2A 小分子激活剂（SMAPs）可能提高癌症对 CDK9 抑制的敏感性。事实上，在小鼠异种移植模型中，联合使用 CDK9 抑制剂 AZD-4573 与 PP2A 激活剂 DBK-1154，已显示体内协同抗癌活性。<sup>235</sup>

Consistent with the fact that Integrator-PP2A counteracts CDK9-dependent phosphorylation, Integrator-PP2A negatively regulates RNA Pol II elongation. Depletion of INTS6 or INTS8 results in an increase in nascent mRNA and eRNA transcripts.<sup>132,235</sup> This is concomitant to an increase in elongation-associated phosphorylation of CTD Ser2 in both promoters and gene bodies.<sup>132,235</sup> INTS8 mutation that disrupts its association with PP2A results in the release of promoter-proximal paused RNA Pol II,<sup>132</sup> suggesting that PP2A plays a role in blocking RNA Pol II release at 5′ end of genes. Whether Integrator-PP2A regulates transcription at the 3′ end of genes remains largely unknown.

与其拮抗 CDK9 依赖性磷酸化的功能一致，Integrator–PP2A 对 RNA Pol II 延伸发挥负向调控作用。耗竭 INTS6 或 INTS8 会增加新生 mRNA 和 eRNA，<sup>132,235</sup> 同时使启动子和基因体内与延伸相关的 CTD Ser2 磷酸化增加。<sup>132,235</sup> 破坏 INTS8 与 PP2A 结合的突变，可促进启动子近端暂停的 RNA Pol II 释放，<sup>132</sup> 提示 PP2A 参与阻止基因 5′ 端的 RNA Pol II 释放。Integrator–PP2A 是否也调控基因 3′ 端的转录，目前仍不清楚。

BIOLOGICAL FUNCTIONS OF TRANSCRIPTION ELONGATION FACTORS｜转录延伸因子的生物学功能

In this section, we discuss the biological functions of RNA Pol II elongation factors and their role in pathogenesis of disease including developmental disorders, neurodegeneration, cancer, and aging. We highlight the functional link to these diseases beyond the detailed mechanisms of transcriptional elongation that we have discussed in the previous sections.

本节讨论 RNA Pol II 延伸因子的生物学功能，以及它们与发育障碍、神经退行性疾病、癌症和衰老等过程的关系。在前文详述转录延伸机制的基础上，这里重点介绍这些因子与相关疾病之间的功能联系。

Function of CDK9-containing complexes in cancers and development｜含 CDK9 的复合物在癌症与发育中的功能

In MLL-rearranged leukemia, studies have demonstrated that the protein fusion of MLL with an SEC subunit recruits SEC to MLL-fusion target genes, where SEC is required for aberrant transcriptional activation.<sup>47,48</sup> Rapid depletion of the SEC subunit ENL causes a loss of this aberrant SEC recruitment, attenuating leukemic growth.<sup>236</sup> It should be noted that the anti-cancer effect of ENL depletion may be due to disruption of either or both of the two distinct ENL-containing complexes, SEC and DOT1L complex (DotCom).<sup>47,48,237</sup> SEC is essential for transcription of the oncogene MYC and related genes.<sup>51,61</sup> The SEC scaffold subunit AFF4 was also found to be required for cell proliferation in pediatric brain cancer driven by the histone H3 lysine 27-methionine (H3K27M) mutation.<sup>238,239</sup> Together, these results led to the notion that the gene-specific function of SEC could be leveraged to downregulate oncogenic expression by targeted SEC inhibition, rather than by BRD4-CDK9 or total CDK9 inhibition, which globally attenuates gene expression. Disruption of the AFF4-cyclin T interaction using the peptidomimetic inhibitors KL1/2 resulted in growth inhibition in both MYCdependent cancer and H3K27M-dependent brain cancer.<sup>61,238</sup>

在 MLL 重排性白血病中，已有研究证明，MLL 与 SEC 亚基的蛋白融合会招募 SEC 至 MLL 融合靶基因位点，在那里 SEC 对于异常转录激活是必需的。<sup>47,48</sup> 快速耗竭 SEC 亚基 ENL 会导致这种异常 SEC 招募的丧失，从而减弱白血病生长。<sup>236</sup> 需要注意的是，ENL 耗竭的抗癌效应可能是由于破坏了两种不同的含 ENL 复合物之一或两者，即 SEC 复合物和 DOT1L 复合物（DotCom）。<sup>47,48,237</sup> SEC 对于癌基因 MYC 及相关基因的转录是必需的。<sup>51,61</sup> 同时发现，SEC 支架亚基 AFF4 在由组蛋白 H3 第 27 位赖氨酸替换为甲硫氨酸（H3K27M）的突变驱动的儿童脑癌中也对细胞增殖是必需的。<sup>238,239</sup> 综合这些结果，提出了这样一个概念：SEC 的基因特异性功能可以被利用来通过靶向 SEC 抑制而非 BRD4-CDK9 或总体 CDK9 抑制来下调致癌表达，因为后者会整体减弱基因表达。使用肽模拟抑制剂 KL1/2 破坏 AFF4-细胞周期蛋白 T 相互作用导致在 MYC 依赖性癌症和 H3K27M 依赖性脑癌中均出现生长抑制。<sup>61,238</sup>

SEC was also shown to be required for proper development in mammals. A chemical mutagenesis study in mice identified that a gain-of-function mutation in the N-terminal ALF (AF4/ LAF4/FMR2) domain of AFF1 causes neurodegeneration of the cerebellum.<sup>240</sup> In humans, gain-of-function mutations in the N-terminal ALF domain of AFF4 have been linked to a developmental disorder involving cognitive impairment called CHOPS (cognitive impairment, coarse facies, heart defects, obesity, pulmonary involvement, short stature, and skeletal dysplasia) syndrome.<sup>241</sup> Mutations in the N-terminal ALF domain of AFF3 were recently shown to be associated with another type of human developmental disorder,KINSSHIP(horseshoe kidney,Nievergelt/ Savarirayan type of mesomelic dysplasia,seizures,hypertrichosis, intellectual disability, and pulmonary involvement) syndrome.<sup>242</sup> Notably, these ALF domain mutations of mouse AFF1 and human AFF3 or AFF4 all block proteasomal degradation mediated by the E3 ligase SIAH1, resulting in stabilization of the mutant proteins.<sup>241–243</sup> Thus, tight regulation of the AFF1/3/4 SEC scaffold protein stability is essential during development and for normal brain function. Downregulation of AFF2 (also known as FMR2) through hypermethylated triplet nucleotide expansions was also shown to be associated with intellectual disability,<sup>244</sup> suggesting that dysregulation of SEC scaffold proteins plays a role in distinct developmental disorder etiologies.

SEC 也被证明对哺乳动物的正常发育是必需的。一项小鼠中的化学诱变研究发现，AFF1 N 端 ALF（AF4/LAF4/FMR2）结构域的功能获得性突变会导致小脑神经退行性病变。<sup>240</sup> 在人类中，AFF4 N 端 ALF 结构域的功能获得性突变与一种涉及认知障碍的发育障碍有关，称为 CHOPS（认知障碍、面容粗陋、心脏缺陷、肥胖、肺部受累、身材矮小和骨骼发育异常）综合征。<sup>241</sup> 最近发现，AFF3 N 端 ALF 结构域的突变与另一种人类发育障碍相关，即 KINSSHIP（马蹄肾、Nievergelt/Savarirayan 型肢体中段发育不良、癫痫、多毛症、智力障碍和肺部受累）综合征。<sup>242</sup> 值得注意的是，小鼠 AFF1 和人类 AFF3 或 AFF4 的这些 ALF 结构域突变均会阻断由 E3 连接酶 SIAH1 介导的蛋白酶体降解，导致突变蛋白稳定化。<sup>241–243</sup> 因此，在发育过程中以及正常脑功能中，对 AFF1/3/4 SEC 支架蛋白稳定性进行严格调控是至关重要的。通过高甲基化三核苷酸扩增下调 AFF2（也称为 FMR2）也被证明与智力障碍有关。<sup>244</sup> 这表明 SEC 支架蛋白的失调在不同的发育障碍病因中起着作用。

A recent study showed that the AFF1-containing SEC suppresses rapid response genes including ATF3 in undifferentiated human keratinocyte cells.<sup>245</sup> This result suggests an additional role for SEC in epithelial progenitor differentiation that involves reprogramming of SEC function in response to developmental cues.

最近的一项研究表明，含 AFF1 的 SEC 复合物在未分化的人角质形成细胞中抑制快速反应基因，包括 ATF3。<sup>245</sup> 这一结果提示 SEC 在上皮祖细胞分化中具有额外的作用，涉及 SEC 功能对发育信号的重编程。

In addition to the functions of the BRD4-CDK9 complex in cancers that we discussed earlier, BRD4 has also been shown to play an important role in neural differentiation.A human genetic analysis revealed that loss-of-function mutations of BRD4 are associated with the neurodevelopmental disorder called Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS).<sup>246</sup> In mice, BRD4 loss in neural crest cells results in a developmental defect that phenocopies loss of the cohesin loader protein NIPBL (nipped-B-like).<sup>247</sup> BRD4 physically interacts with NIPBL, which facilitates the cohesion-mediated process of chromatin loop extrusion.Importantly,loss of the cohesin antagonist WAPL (wings apart-like) can rescue the developmental defect observed in BRD4-deleted cells. These results suggest that BRD4 promotes neural differentiation through regulation of genome folding.

除前文讨论的 BRD4–CDK9 在癌症中的功能外，BRD4 还在神经分化中发挥重要作用。人类遗传学分析发现，BRD4 功能缺失突变与神经发育障碍 Cornelia de Lange 综合征（CdLS）有关。<sup>246</sup> 在小鼠神经嵴细胞中，BRD4 丢失引起的发育缺陷与黏连蛋白（cohesin）装载因子 NIPBL（nipped-B-like）缺失的表型相似。<sup>247</sup> BRD4 与 NIPBL 发生物理相互作用，而 NIPBL 促进 cohesin 介导的染色质环挤出过程。缺失 cohesin 的拮抗因子 WAPL（wings apart-like），可挽救 BRD4 缺失所致的发育缺陷。这些结果提示，BRD4 通过调控基因组折叠来促进神经分化。

Functions of CDK12 in cancers｜CDK12 在癌症中的功能

Recurrent somatic alterations of the CDK12 gene have been identified in many cancer types, including ovarian cancers.<sup>248</sup> Loss-of-function mutations of CDK12 observed in ovarian cancers are associated with genomic instability and sensitization to agents that induce DNA damage.<sup>68,249,250</sup> In breast cancers, amplifications of CDK12 are associated with splicing defects and invasiveness of cancer cells.<sup>66</sup> These observations led to the notion that dysregulation of CDK12’s function in transcriptional elongation control is involved in cancer pathogenesis, via various mechanisms depending on cancer type. The covalent CDK12/13 inhibitor THZ531 induces apoptotic cell death in leukemia cells.<sup>69</sup> The use of THZ531 in combination with other agents that inhibit DNA damage response or RNA processing could potentially help attenuate the growth of cancers that are ‘‘addicted’’ to CDK12’s effects on DNA damage response and RNA processing.

包括卵巢癌在内的多种癌症中，均发现反复出现的 CDK12 基因体细胞变异。<sup>248</sup> 卵巢癌中的 CDK12 功能缺失突变，与基因组不稳定及对 DNA 损伤诱导剂敏感性增加有关。<sup>68,249,250</sup> 在乳腺癌中，CDK12 扩增则与剪接缺陷及癌细胞侵袭性有关。<sup>66</sup> 这些观察提示，CDK12 转录延伸调控功能的失调参与癌症发生，但具体机制因癌症类型而异。共价 CDK12/13 抑制剂 THZ531 可诱导白血病细胞凋亡。<sup>69</sup> 将其与其他抑制 DNA 损伤应答或 RNA 加工的药物联合使用，可能有助于抑制那些依赖 CDK12 所调控的 DNA 损伤应答和 RNA 加工功能的癌症生长。

NELF’s function in development and cancers｜NELF 在发育和癌症中的功能

RNA Pol II undergoes widespread pausing at promoter-proximal regions in mouse and fly embryos,<sup>251,252</sup> mouse embryonic stem cells<sup>253</sup> and fly-embryo-derived cells.<sup>254</sup> In fly embryos, high levels of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II have been linked to the synchronous expression of developmental genes.<sup>255,256</sup> Numerous studies illustrate the importance of NELF to developmental gene activation. In flies, NELF-deficient embryos show decreased expression of developmental gene reporters,<sup>257</sup> and NELF knockdown impairs developmental hormone-induced gene activation.<sup>258</sup> In zebrafish, NELF-B knockout leads to an improper hematopoiesis.<sup>259</sup> In mice, NELF-B knockout causes early embryonic lethality,<sup>260</sup> an insensitivity to developmental FGF/ERK signaling<sup>82</sup> and defects in pluripotent epiblast state transitions.<sup>86</sup> Targeted degradation of NELF-B in mouse embryos at the pre-implantation stage impairs zygotic gene activation.<sup>261</sup> NELF-A may also function as a maternal factor to initiate zygotic gene expression, as it was shown to activate expression of the key developmental regulator gene Dux to drive the twocell-like state in mouse embryonic stem cells.<sup>262</sup> Together, these findings indicate a critical role for NELF in developmental gene activation.

RNA Pol II 在小鼠和果蝇胚胎<sup>251,252</sup>、小鼠胚胎干细胞<sup>253</sup>以及果蝇胚胎来源细胞<sup>254</sup>的启动子近端区域广泛暂停。在果蝇胚胎中，启动子近端 RNA Pol II 水平较高与发育基因的同步表达相关联<sup>255,256</sup>。大量研究表明 NELF 对发育基因激活具有重要意义。在果蝇中，缺乏 NELF 的胚胎表现出发育基因报告系统的表达下降<sup>257</sup>，而敲低 NELF 会损害发育激素诱导的基因激活<sup>258</sup>。在斑马鱼中，NELF-B 基因敲除导致造血功能异常<sup>259</sup>。在小鼠中，NELF-B 基因敲除导致早期胚胎致死<sup>260</sup>、对发育性 FGF/ERK 信号不敏感<sup>82</sup>以及多能上胚层状态转换缺陷<sup>86</sup>。在小鼠胚胎的植入前阶段靶向降解 NELF-B 会损害合子基因激活<sup>261</sup>。NELF-A 可能作为母源因子启动合子基因表达，因为它被证明能够激活关键发育调节基因 Dux 的表达以驱动小鼠胚胎干细胞中的二细胞样状态<sup>262</sup>。综上所述，这些发现表明 NELF 在发育基因激活中起着关键作用。

A recent study revealed a functional connection between NELF-E and the development of breast cancer.<sup>263</sup> Knockout of NELF-E in aggressive breast cancer cells results in selective downregulation of genes that promote tumorigenesis.<sup>263</sup> NELF-E regulates expression of these genes through interaction with the transcription factor SLUG and transcriptional activation of the acetyltransferase KAT2B.<sup>263</sup> These results suggest that breast cancer development may involve an alteration of gene expression that is mediated by NELF-E, SLUG, and KAT2B, and that targeting this pathway is a potential therapeutic strategy for breast cancer.

近期研究揭示了 NELF-E 与乳腺癌发生之间的功能联系。<sup>263</sup> 在侵袭性乳腺癌细胞中敲除 NELF-E，会选择性下调促进肿瘤发生的基因。<sup>263</sup> NELF-E 通过与转录因子 SLUG 相互作用，并在转录层面激活乙酰转移酶基因 KAT2B，调控这些基因的表达。<sup>263</sup> 这些结果提示，乳腺癌发生可能涉及 NELF-E、SLUG 和 KAT2B 介导的基因表达改变，靶向该通路可能成为一种治疗策略。

Functions of SPT5/SPT4 in cancers, aging, and neuronal development｜SPT5/SPT4 在癌症、衰老和神经发育中的功能

The oncogenic transcription factor MYC has been shown to regulate the interaction between SPT5 and RNA Pol II.<sup>114,264</sup> MYC directly interacts with the N-terminal region of SPT5, which contains the conserved NGN (NusG N-terminal homology) domain.<sup>114</sup> This MYC-SPT5 interaction can be disrupted by the activity of the CDK7 kinase, which assists handoff of SPT5 to RNA Pol II.<sup>114</sup> MYC may therefore increase the rate of elongation by facilitating CDK7mediated SPT5 loading onto RNA Pol II.<sup>114</sup> However, the high levels of MYC which are frequently observed in cancer suppress SPT5 loading onto RNA Pol II through the MYC-mediated sequestration of SPT5.<sup>114</sup> Furthermore, multimerization of MYC under stress conditions sequesters SPT5 away from actively transcribing RNA Pol II.<sup>264</sup> These results led to the notion that the sequestration of SPT5 by MYC may be a general mechanism underlying the transcriptional repression associated with aggressive cancers.Intriguingly, a cancer subtype that possesses SUPTH5 (SPT5) gene amplification does not exhibit MYC-mediated transcriptional repression,<sup>114</sup> suggesting that an excess supply of SPT5 can overcome sequestration by MYC and restore gene expression.

致癌转录因子 MYC 已被证明可以调节 SPT5 与 RNA Pol II 之间的相互作用<sup>114,264</sup>。MYC 直接与包含保守 NGN（NusG N 端同源性）结构域的 SPT5 氨基末端区域相互作用<sup>114</sup>。这种 MYC-SPT5 相互作用可通过 CDK7 激酶活性被破坏，该激酶有助于 SPT5 转移到 RNA Pol II 上<sup>114</sup>。因此，MYC 可能通过促进 CDK7 介导的 SPT5 加载到 RNA Pol II 上来增加延伸速率<sup>114</sup>。然而，在癌症中经常观察到的高 MYC 水平通过 MYC 介导的 SPT5 隔离来抑制 SPT5 加载到 RNA Pol II 上<sup>114</sup>。此外，在应激条件下，MYC 的多聚化会将 SPT5 从活跃转录的 RNA Pol II 上隔离出来<sup>264</sup>。这些结果导致了这样的概念：MYC 对 SPT5 的隔离可能是与侵袭性癌症相关的转录抑制的一般机制。有趣的是，具有 SUPTH5（SPT5）基因扩增的癌症亚型并未表现出 MYC 介导的转录抑制<sup>114</sup>，这表明过量供应的 SPT5 可以克服 MYC 的隔离并恢复基因表达。

SPT4 is required for elongation of the long trinucleotide (CAG) repeat-containing transcripts that encode polyglutamine (polyQ) stretches,which are a characteristic feature of proteins associated with Huntington’s disease(HD)and other neurological disorders,in yeast and human cells.<sup>265</sup> Knockdown of SPT4 reduced polyQ reporter protein expression and expression of the HTT (Huntingtin) protein, leading to an overall decrease in aggregation of polyQcontaining proteins.<sup>265</sup> Knockdown of SPT4 in the brain results in a reduction ofHtt expression, prolonged lifespan, and delay of motor impairment in a mouse HD model.<sup>266</sup> SPT4 is also required for transcription of the C9orf72 hexanucleotide (GGGGCC) repeats associated with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis(ALS) and frontotemporal dementia.<sup>267</sup> Knockdown of SPT4 in patient cells reduced expression of mRNA that contain this hexanucleotide repeat sequence and their resultant proteins.<sup>267</sup> These observations indicate SPT4 inhibition as a potential therapeutic approach to suppress the expression of proteins that contain toxic repeat sequences. Because rapid depletion of SPT4 does not cause RNA Pol II degradation,<sup>108</sup> SPT4 inhibition has the potential to selectively suppress transcription of pathogenic repeat sequences without affecting elongation at other genes. It will be necessary to develop potent compounds or other new SPT4-targeting approaches, both to suppress SPT4 function in patients and to advance the detailed mechanistic understanding of how SPT4 regulates the elongation of transcripts containing toxic repeat sequences.

在酵母和人细胞中，SPT4 是含有长三核苷酸 CAG 重复序列的转录本正常延伸所必需的。这些序列编码多聚谷氨酰胺（polyQ）片段，后者是亨廷顿病（HD）及其他神经系统疾病相关蛋白的特征。<sup>265</sup> 敲低 SPT4 可降低 polyQ 报告蛋白及 HTT（亨廷汀）蛋白的表达，减少含 polyQ 蛋白的总体聚集。<sup>265</sup> 在 HD 小鼠模型脑内敲低 SPT4，可降低 Htt 表达、延长寿命并延缓运动障碍出现。<sup>266</sup> SPT4 也是 C9orf72 六核苷酸 GGGGCC 重复序列转录所必需的，该重复序列与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）及额颞叶痴呆有关。<sup>267</sup> 在患者细胞中敲低 SPT4，可降低含此重复序列的 mRNA 及其编码蛋白的表达。<sup>267</sup> 这些观察提示，抑制 SPT4 可能用于降低含毒性重复序列的蛋白表达。由于快速耗竭 SPT4 不引起 RNA Pol II 降解，<sup>108</sup> 抑制它可能有望选择性抑制致病重复序列转录，而不影响其他基因的延伸。仍需开发强效化合物或其他新的靶向手段，既用于在患者中抑制 SPT4，也用于深入理解 SPT4 如何调控含毒性重复序列转录本的延伸。

SPT4 has been shown to promote aging in S. cerevisiae by controlling the length of ribosomal DNA (rDNA) repeats, which shortens as cells age.<sup>268</sup> Cells with SPT4 gene deletion exhibit stabilized rDNA repeats and decreased levels of non-coding RNA transcription from a promoter called E-pro within intergenic rDNA spacers.<sup>268</sup> Although this non-coding RNA is nearly entirely silenced in young cells, its transcription is strongly activated in older cells in an SPT4-dependent manner.<sup>268</sup> These observations suggest that non-coding RNA expression driven by SPT4 in older cells contributes to rDNA instability, thereby promoting cellular senescence, an irreversible state where cells can no longer divide.

SPT4 已被证明通过控制核糖体 DNA（rDNA）重复序列的长度在酿酒酵母中促进衰老，因为随着细胞老化，这些重复序列会缩短。<sup>268</sup> 缺失 SPT4 基因的细胞表现出 rDNA 重复序列稳定化，并且来自一个称为 E-pro 的启动子的非编码 RNA 转录水平降低，该启动子位于基因间 rDNA 间隔区。<sup>268</sup> 尽管这种非编码 RNA 在年轻细胞中几乎完全被沉默，但在老年细胞中其转录在 SPT4 依赖的方式下被强烈激活。<sup>268</sup> 这些观察结果表明，在老年细胞中由 SPT4 驱动的非编码 RNA 表达有助于 rDNA 不稳定，从而促进细胞衰老，即细胞无法再分裂的不可逆状态。

The zebrafish foggy (SPT5 homolog) mutant is lethal due to its disrupted neuronal development, which includes the failure to develop distinct dopaminergic and other neuronal classes.<sup>109</sup> The mutation responsible for the foggy phenotype is the substitution of Foggy/Spt5 valine 1012, located near the CTR, with aspartic acid (V1012D).<sup>109</sup> In vitro, the Foggy/Spt5 V1012D mutant protein results in an increased release of paused RNA Pol II when CTR-phosphorylating CDK9 is inactivated, while Foggy can function to stimulate the rate of elongation as efficiently as WT when CDK9 is active.<sup>109</sup> This phenotype resembles the induced release of promoter-proximal RNA Pol II observed in human cells with SPT5 CTR-TE mutations,<sup>125</sup> implicating a functional interaction between the V1012D mutation and CTR hyperphosphorylation. These observations suggest that Spt5-mediated maintenance of the pausing state is required for development of distinct neuronal classes in zebrafish. However, which genes are directly regulated by Spt5 during neuronal development has remained unclear. Now that new techniques including rapid depletion and single-cell transcriptomic analysis are available, future studies may be able to determine how SPT5 regulates neuronal development in multicellular organisms.

斑马鱼 foggy（SPT5 同源物）突变体由于其神经发育受损而致死，这包括无法发育出特定的多巴胺能和其他神经元类群。<sup>109</sup> 导致 foggy 表型的突变是位于 CTR 附近的 Foggy/Spt5 缬氨酸 1012 被天冬氨酸替代（V1012D）。<sup>109</sup> 在体外，当 CTR 磷酸化激酶 CDK9 失活时，Foggy/Spt5 V1012D 突变蛋白会导致暂停的 RNA Pol II 释放增加；而当 CDK9 处于活性状态时，Foggy 能够像野生型一样高效地刺激延伸速率。<sup>109</sup> 这种表型类似于在携带 SPT5 CTR-TE 突变的人类细胞中观察到的启动子近端 RNA Pol II 的诱导释放，<sup>125</sup> 表明 V1012D 突变与 CTR 过度磷酸化之间存在功能相互作用。这些观察结果表明，Spt5 介导的暂停状态维持对于斑马鱼中特定神经元类群的发育是必需的。然而，在神经发育过程中 Spt5 直接调控哪些基因仍然不清楚。随着快速耗竭和单细胞转录组分析等新技术的出现，未来研究或可确定 SPT5 如何在多细胞生物中调控神经发育。

The role of PAF1C in development and disease｜PAF1C 在发育和疾病中的作用

PAF1C has been shown to regulate developmental processes. For instance, the sunrise zebrafish mutant defective in the PAF1C subunit cdc73 gene was shown to exhibit severe developmental defects and embryonic lethality.<sup>167</sup> A null mutant of the PAF1C subunit gene rtf1 exhibited a similar morphological phenotype and embryonic lethality<sup>167,269</sup> and a null mutant of the PAF1C subunit leo1 showed defects in cardiac differentiation in zebrafish.<sup>270</sup> In Drosophila, a null mutation of the PAF1C subunit Ctr9 was shown to cause defects in nervous system development and embryonic lethality.<sup>271</sup>

PAF1C 已被证明能够调控发育过程。例如，sunrise 斑马鱼突变体由于 PAF1C 亚基基因 cdc73 发生缺陷，表现出严重的发育缺陷和胚胎致死。<sup>167</sup> PAF1C 亚基基因 rtf1 的功能缺失突变体也表现出类似的形态表型和胚胎致死<sup>167,269</sup>，而 PAF1C 亚基 leo1 的功能缺失突变体在斑马鱼中显示出心脏分化的缺陷。<sup>270</sup> 在果蝇中，PAF1C 亚基 Ctr9 的功能缺失突变体被证明会导致神经系统发育缺陷和胚胎致死。<sup>271</sup>

PAF1C is also associated with disease states including cancer. For example, overexpression of the PAF1 protein promotes tumor growth.<sup>138</sup> Inactivating mutations of the tumor-suppressor protein CDC73 have been observed in a subset of cancer types including parathyroid cancers.<sup>139</sup> Although the L64P CDC73 mutant found in these cancers can interact with PAF1 in the manner of WT CDC73,<sup>272</sup> it fails to inhibit cyclin D1 expression in both NIH3T3 and HEK293 cells.<sup>139</sup>

PAF1C 也与疾病状态相关，包括癌症。例如，PAF1 蛋白的过表达会促进肿瘤生长。<sup>138</sup> 在一部分癌症类型中，包括甲状旁腺癌，观察到了肿瘤抑制蛋白 CDC73 的失活突变。<sup>139</sup> 尽管在这些癌症中发现的 L64P CDC73 突变体能够以与野生型 CDC73 相同的方式与 PAF1 相互作用，<sup>272</sup> 但它无法在 NIH3T3 和 HEK293 细胞中抑制细胞周期蛋白 D1 的表达。<sup>139</sup>

A recent study revealed that PAF1C is critical to maintaining the survival of pancreatic cancers.<sup>273</sup> PAF1 depletion results in accumulation of non-coding RNAs, including eRNAs and PROMPTs, for which transcription is driven by oncogenic Kras mutations.<sup>273</sup> The accumulation of non-coding RNAs can cause DNA damage and cell death. These results suggest that pancreatic cancers are addicted to PAF1C-mediated suppression of non-coding RNA production. Recent advances in our understanding of how PAF1C functions in cancer development and stem cell maintenance have been summarized elsewhere.<sup>274</sup>

最近的一项研究揭示，PAF1C 对于维持胰腺癌的存活至关重要。<sup>273</sup> PAF1 的缺失会导致非编码 RNA 的积累，包括 eRNAs 和 PROMPTs，这些 RNA 的转录是由致癌性 Kras 突变驱动的。<sup>273</sup> 非编码 RNA 的积累可导致 DNA 损伤和细胞死亡。这些结果表明，胰腺癌对 PAF1C 介导的非编码 RNA 生成的抑制具有依赖性。关于 PAF1C 在癌症发展和干细胞维持中的功能的最新进展已在其他地方进行了总结。<sup>274</sup>

For infectious disease, PAF1C was shown to play a key role in antiviral response. The influenza viral protein NS1 (non-structural protein 1) directly interacts with PAF1C through its histone mimic sequence.<sup>275</sup> Through this interaction, NS1 hijacks RNA Pol II elongation of the host cells, resulting in downregulation of antiviral gene expression.<sup>275</sup> These results suggest that PAF1C activates antiviral gene expression, whereas NS1 suppresses this antiviral response through direct inhibition of PAF1C.

对于传染病而言，PAF1C 被证明在抗病毒反应中起关键作用。流感病毒蛋白 NS1（非结构蛋白 1）通过其组蛋白模拟序列直接与 PAF1C 相互作用。<sup>275</sup> 通过这种相互作用，NS1 劫持宿主细胞的 RNA Pol II 延伸过程，导致抗病毒基因表达下调。<sup>275</sup> 这些结果表明，PAF1C 激活抗病毒基因表达，而 NS1 则通过直接抑制 PAF1C 来抑制这一抗病毒反应。

A recent study developed a first-in-class inhibitor of PAF1C (iPAF1C) and demonstrated that PAF1 inhibition could be used as a therapeutic approach to enable clearance of immune cells with latent HIV-1 infection.<sup>276</sup> The general ‘‘shock and kill’’ strategy for HIV-1 treatment aims to trigger reactivation of transcriptionally silenced viral genes in HIV-1-infected immune cells, thereby achieving viral clearance in HIV-1 patients.<sup>277</sup> iPAF1C treatment impedes PAF1C recruitment through disruption of the PAF1-CTR9 interaction and stimulates RNA Pol II release, potentially triggering viral gene reactivation.<sup>276</sup> Importantly, treatment of HIV-1-patient cells with iPAF1C enhances reactivation of latent proviruses in ex vivo HIV-1 patient cells.<sup>276</sup>

近期研究开发了首个此类 PAF1C 抑制剂 iPAF1C，并提出抑制 PAF1 可能用于帮助清除潜伏感染 HIV-1 的免疫细胞。<sup>276</sup> HIV-1 治疗中的“唤醒并清除”（shock and kill）策略，旨在使感染免疫细胞中处于转录沉默状态的病毒基因重新激活，进而实现病毒清除。<sup>277</sup> iPAF1C 通过破坏 PAF1–CTR9 相互作用，阻碍 PAF1C 招募并促进 RNA Pol II 释放，可能触发病毒基因再激活。<sup>276</sup> 在离体的 HIV-1 患者细胞中，iPAF1C 确实增强了潜伏前病毒的再激活。<sup>276</sup>

SPT6’s functions in development and cancers｜SPT6 在发育和癌症中的功能

SPT6 mutant fly embryos have been shown to exhibit developmental arrests that cause lethality, presumably due to dysregulation of gene expression.<sup>182,278</sup> In humans, a recent study revealed that SPT6 functions to promote adult skin differentiation.<sup>279</sup> Depletion of SPT6 results in loss of differentiation and conversion of epidermal cells to an intestinal-like state, primarily due to loss of expression of the epidermal fate regulator P63.<sup>279</sup> These results suggest that SPT6-mediated elongation control is required for cell fate decisions during adult skin differentiation.

SPT6 突变果蝇胚胎已被证明会出现发育停滞并导致致死，这可能是因为基因表达失调所致。<sup>182,278</sup> 在人类中，最近的一项研究显示，SPT6 可促进成人皮肤分化。<sup>279</sup> SPT6 的耗竭会导致分化丧失，并使表皮细胞转化为肠样状态，这主要是由于表皮命运调节因子 P63 表达的丧失所致。<sup>279</sup> 这些结果表明，SPT6 介导的延伸控制对于成人皮肤分化过程中的细胞命运决定是必需的。

In mouse embryonic stem cells, SPT6 was shown to maintain pluripotency via transcriptional regulation.<sup>280</sup> Depletion of SPT6 results in selective downregulation of pluripotency factors including Nanog, with concomitant inactivation of super-enhancers associated with these pluripotency factor genes.<sup>280</sup> Mechanistically, SPT6 counteracts Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2) at super-enhancers through physical interaction with the PRC2 subunit Suz12.<sup>280</sup>

在小鼠胚胎干细胞中，SPT6 被证明通过转录调控维持多能性。<sup>280</sup> SPT6 的耗竭会导致包括 Nanog 在内的多能性因子的选择性下调，并伴随与这些多能性因子基因相关的超级增强子的失活。<sup>280</sup> 从机制上讲，SPT6 通过与 PRC2 亚基 Suz12 的物理相互作用，在超级增强子处对抗多梳抑制复合物 2 (PRC2)。<sup>280</sup>

In brain cancers, SPT6 was found to be critical for self-renewal of glioblastoma cancer-stem-like cells (GSCs).<sup>281</sup> Depletion of SPT6 in GSCs results in loss of the capacity to initiate cancers, primarily due to decreased expression of DNA damage response genes and greater genomic instability.<sup>281</sup> These results suggest that SPT6 functions to support survival of aggressive brain cancers through upregulation of DNA damage response pathways that maintain genomic stability.

在脑癌中，发现 SPT6 对于胶质母细胞瘤类癌干细胞（GSCs）的自我更新至关重要。<sup>281</sup> 在 GSCs 中耗竭 SPT6 会导致肿瘤起始能力的丧失，这主要是由于 DNA 损伤应答基因表达减少和基因组不稳定性增加所致。<sup>281</sup> 这些结果表明，SPT6 通过上调 DNA 损伤应答途径来维持基因组稳定性，从而支持侵袭性脑癌的存活。

Functions of Integrator in development and genomic stability｜Integrator 在发育和基因组稳定性中的功能

It has been shown that Integrator is required for the generation of cilia.<sup>282–284</sup> A recent human genetic study identified germline loss-of-function mutations of INTS13 in oral-facial-digital (OFD) syndromes, a subtype of developmental ciliopathies.<sup>285</sup> These INTS13 mutations disrupt Integrator complex assembly.<sup>285</sup> Depletion of INTS13 results in ciliogenesis defects in human cells and Xenopus embryos, suggesting a disease mechanism that involves INTS13 mutations.<sup>285</sup> INTS13 was also shown to be required for human myeloid differentiation and to function via enhancer activation.<sup>286</sup> While INTS13 is not required for the endonuclease activity of Integrator, INTS13 does act as a mediator of cell-lineage-determining transcription factors.<sup>286</sup> Another genetic study identified INTS1 and INTS8 mutations in human neurodevelopmental syndromes,<sup>287</sup> suggesting that Integrator functions in human brain development.

Integrator 是纤毛生成所必需的。<sup>282–284</sup> 近期一项人类遗传学研究，在发育性纤毛病的一种亚型——口-面-指（趾）（OFD）综合征中，鉴定出 INTS13 的生殖系功能缺失突变。<sup>285</sup> 这些突变破坏 Integrator 复合物的组装。<sup>285</sup> 耗竭 INTS13 会导致人细胞和非洲爪蟾胚胎的纤毛生成缺陷，为 INTS13 突变参与致病提供了机制线索。<sup>285</sup> INTS13 也参与人类髓系分化，并通过激活增强子发挥作用。<sup>286</sup> 虽然 Integrator 的内切酶活性不需要 INTS13，它却可作为决定细胞谱系的转录因子的作用中介。<sup>286</sup> 另一项遗传学研究在人类神经发育综合征中发现 INTS1 和 INTS8 突变，<sup>287</sup> 提示 Integrator 参与人类脑发育。

Integrator also plays a key role in genomic stability. A recent study revealed that Integrator physically interacts with the DNA damage sensor SOSS (sensor of single-stranded DNA) via the INTS3 subunit, and that the SOSS subunit SSB1 (singlestranded DNA-binding protein 1) forms condensates with Integrator.<sup>288</sup> Integrator loss results in increased formation of the DNA-RNA duplex R-loop structures that can induce genomic instability.<sup>288</sup> Thus, Integrator functions to protect cells from genomic instability through interaction with the DNA damage sensor and formation of nuclear condensates.

Integrator 还在维持基因组稳定性中发挥关键作用。近期研究发现，Integrator 通过 INTS3 亚基与 DNA 损伤感应复合物 SOSS（单链 DNA 感应因子）相互作用，而 SOSS 亚基 SSB1（单链 DNA 结合蛋白 1）可与 Integrator 形成凝聚体。<sup>288</sup> Integrator 丢失会增加可引起基因组不稳定的 DNA–RNA 杂交 R-loop 结构。<sup>288</sup> 因此，Integrator 通过与 DNA 损伤感应因子相互作用并形成核内凝聚体，保护基因组稳定性。

Mechanism of aging: Alteration of transcriptional elongation properties over a lifetime｜衰老机制：转录延伸特性随年龄的变化

The process of aging, a gradual loss of biological function throughout lifespan, has been linked to changes in the epigenetic landscape including altered levels and repositioning of DNA methylation and histone modifications.<sup>289</sup> Until recently, however, it was largely unclear whether the aging process might also involve alteration of RNA Pol II elongation. We briefly summarize recent findings regarding the relationship between transcriptional elongation and aging and provide some future perspective for studies looking at the aging process and the role of the elongation factors described above.

衰老是生物功能在生命过程中逐渐丧失的过程，与表观遗传状态的改变有关，包括 DNA 甲基化和组蛋白修饰水平及分布的变化。<sup>289</sup> 然而，直到最近，人们仍不清楚衰老是否也涉及 RNA Pol II 延伸的改变。下文简要总结转录延伸与衰老关系的近期发现，并对未来研究衰老过程及上述延伸因子的作用提出展望。

Figure 6. Alteration of RNA Pol II elongation over lifetime (A) Schematic of a saw-tooth pattern in intronic RNA-seq signal. (B) Changes in RNA Pol II elongation rates and the abundance of long transcripts over lifetime are indicated. Slowing down the RNA Pol II elongation rate results in extended lifespan.

图 6｜RNA Pol II 延伸随年龄的变化。（A）内含子 RNA-seq 信号的锯齿状模式示意图。（B）随年龄变化的 RNA Pol II 延伸速率及长转录本丰度。减慢 RNA Pol II 延伸速率可延长寿命。

A role for RNA Pol II elongation rate in the mechanism of aging｜RNA Pol II 延伸速率在衰老机制中的作用

A recent study provided a catalog of RNA Pol II elongation rates in both young and old model organisms.<sup>290</sup> High-throughput rate measurements were achieved simply using total RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) data,<sup>290</sup> based on the previous finding that intronic RNA-seq signal exhibits a saw-tooth pattern, the slope of which can be used to compute relative changes in RNA Pol II elongation rate (Figure 6A).<sup>21,291</sup> This study demonstrated that rates of RNA Pol II elongation increase upon aging in human, rat, mouse, fly, and worm.<sup>290</sup> Notably, flies and worms with ‘‘slow RNA Pol II’’ due to mutations in a RNA Pol II subunit exhibited an extended lifespan.<sup>290</sup> This genetic evidence strongly suggests that an elevated RNA Pol II elongation rate is not only a conserved feature of aging but also part of a conserved aging mechanism. It also suggests that lifespan could be extended by slowing down RNA Pol II in other species (Figure 6B). It remains unclear how a ‘‘fast RNA Pol II’’ could cause or worsen the effects of aging, but increasing RNA Pol II speed over lifespan is attributed in part to a partial loss of histone. Deprivation of nucleosome occupancy has been observed in aged organisms from yeast to human.<sup>292,293</sup> In yeast, histone loss upon aging resulted in gene upregulation<sup>294</sup> and overexpression of histone proteins extended lifespan.<sup>292</sup> Consistent with these precedent studies, overexpression of histone H3 was shown to reduce RNA Pol II elongation rates and suppress senescence in human cells and to extend lifespan in flies.<sup>290</sup> These results suggest an aging model in which (1) a decreasing supply of histone proteins causes partial loss of nucleosome occupancy, (2) rates of RNA Pol II elongation are increased as a result of loss of nucleosomal obstacles to transcription in gene bodies, and (3) increased RNA Pol II speed causes or worsens the effects of aging through unknown mechanisms. Given that RNA Pol II elongation rate is regulated by various elongation factors including SPT5, PAF1C, SPT6, and SEC, development and use of potent inhibitors targeting elongation factors will be a new direction of future studies aiming to address the challenge of slowing down aging processes. Increasing histone gene expression may also be an alternative way to slow down RNA Pol II to ‘‘slow down aging.’’

近期一项研究系统整理了年轻和老年模式生物中的 RNA Pol II 延伸速率。<sup>290</sup> 该研究仅利用总 RNA 测序（RNA-seq）数据便实现了高通量速率测量；<sup>290</sup> 其依据是此前的发现：内含子 RNA-seq 信号呈锯齿状分布，可根据斜率计算 RNA Pol II 延伸速率的相对变化（图 6A）。<sup>21,291</sup> 研究发现，在人、大鼠、小鼠、果蝇和线虫中，RNA Pol II 延伸速率均随衰老升高。<sup>290</sup> 尤其值得关注的是，因 RNA Pol II 亚基突变而具有“慢速 RNA Pol II”的果蝇和线虫，表现出寿命延长。<sup>290</sup> 这一遗传证据强烈提示，RNA Pol II 延伸加速不仅是衰老的保守特征，也是保守衰老机制的一部分；它还提示，减慢其他物种的 RNA Pol II 可能延长其寿命（图 6B）。目前仍不清楚“快速 RNA Pol II”如何引发或加剧衰老，但 RNA Pol II 速度随年龄升高，部分可归因于组蛋白丢失。从酵母到人类，衰老生物中均观察到核小体占据减少。<sup>292,293</sup> 酵母衰老时，组蛋白丢失引起基因表达上调，<sup>294</sup> 而过表达组蛋白可延长寿命。<sup>292</sup> 与这些早期研究一致，过表达组蛋白 H3 可降低人细胞中的 RNA Pol II 延伸速率并抑制细胞衰老，也可延长果蝇寿命。<sup>290</sup> 这些结果支持一种衰老模型：（1）组蛋白供应减少，导致部分核小体占据丢失；（2）基因体内核小体对转录的阻碍减少，使 RNA Pol II 延伸速率升高；（3）RNA Pol II 加速通过尚不清楚的机制引起或加剧衰老。由于 SPT5、PAF1C、SPT6 和 SEC 等多种延伸因子调控 RNA Pol II 的延伸速率，开发并应用针对这些因子的强效抑制剂，将是探索如何减缓衰老的新方向。提高组蛋白基因的表达，也可能是使 RNA Pol II 减速、进而“减缓衰老”的另一条途径。

Loss of long transcripts as you age｜随衰老出现的长转录本减少

On the other hand, a strong correlation between aging and lower abundance of ‘‘long transcripts’’ has recently been demonstrated (Figure 6B).<sup>295–297</sup> In an accelerated aging model, mice that possess mutations in the nucleotide excision DNA repair pathway exhibit a preferential loss of mRNA expression from long genes in liver tissues, while dietary restrictions that increase their lifespan rescue this length-associated downregulation.<sup>296</sup> Consistently, the aged mouse liver was shown to exhibit an approximately 1.5-fold reduction in total RNA synthesis.<sup>297</sup> Productive elongation declined and Ser2P-associated RNA Pol II occupancy also increased in a gene-length-dependent manner in the aged mouse liver,<sup>297</sup> suggesting that RNA Pol II becomes stalled in long genes upon aging. The mechanism of this lengthassociated RNA Pol II stalling can be explained by the stochasticity of DNA damage events in the genome: long genes statistically accumulate more DNA lesions, which pose obstacles to productive transcription, than short genes purely as a function of their greater length. Consistent with this model, the study showed that UV-induced DNA damage caused transcriptional stalling in long genes, and that the normally aged liver exhibited an activation of DNA repair pathway.<sup>297</sup> These results strongly suggest that aging is associated with RNA Pol II stalling in long genes, but it is currently unknown whether this association is causal, and if so whether RNA Pol II stalling in long genes is a cause or a consequence of aging. Therapeutic approaches to aging can vary depending on these conclusions. Although RNA Pol II elongation speed increases upon aging, it is unclear whether RNA Pol II stalling in long genes and a fast RNA Pol II can co-exist in aged animal. As one possible complication, slowing down RNA Pol II elongation rates to extend lifespan might affect the efficiency of the DNA damage repair mechanisms that are required for productive transcription in long genes, with increasing requirement as lifespan extends.

另一方面，近期研究发现，衰老与“长转录本”丰度降低高度相关（图 6B）。<sup>295–297</sup> 在加速衰老模型中，核苷酸切除修复通路存在突变的小鼠，其肝组织中长基因的 mRNA 表达优先下降；而能够延长其寿命的饮食限制可挽救这种与基因长度相关的下调。<sup>296</sup> 与此一致，衰老小鼠肝脏的总 RNA 合成量约降至原来的 1/1.5。<sup>297</sup> 有效延伸减少，同时，与 Ser2P 相关的 RNA Pol II 占据以依赖基因长度的方式增加，<sup>297</sup> 提示 RNA Pol II 在衰老过程中更易停滞于长基因。这种与基因长度相关的停滞，可由基因组中 DNA 损伤发生的随机性解释：仅仅因为长度更大，长基因就会在统计上积累比短基因更多的 DNA 损伤，从而形成更多阻碍有效转录的障碍。与该模型一致，研究发现紫外线诱导的 DNA 损伤可导致长基因转录停滞，而正常衰老的肝脏中 DNA 修复通路被激活。<sup>297</sup> 这些结果强烈提示，衰老与长基因中的 RNA Pol II 停滞有关，但目前仍不知道二者是否存在因果关系；即使存在，也不清楚停滞是衰老的原因还是结果。针对衰老的干预策略可能因这些问题的答案而不同。尽管 RNA Pol II 延伸速度随衰老升高，目前尚不清楚长基因中的停滞与快速 RNA Pol II 能否在老年动物中共存。一种可能的复杂情况是：为了延长寿命而减慢 RNA Pol II，可能影响 DNA 损伤修复机制的效率；而这些机制对于长基因的有效转录必不可少，且随着寿命延长，对其需求也会增加。

Contributions of RNA Pol II elongation factors to aging-related phenotypes｜RNA Pol II 延伸因子对衰老相关表型的贡献

The loss of long transcripts which is a hallmark of aged cells is reminiscent of the processivity defects observed in PAF1C, SPT6, or CDK12-deficient cells (please see the SPT6 section).

长转录本减少是衰老细胞的一个特征，这与 PAF1C、SPT6 或 CDK12 缺失细胞中观察到的过程性缺陷相似（参见 SPT6 一节）。

It is tempting to speculate that regulation of processivity by PAF1C, SPT6, or CDK12/13 might also be impaired upon aging. In this scenario, loss of long transcripts might be attributed not only to DNA lesions accumulated over time but also to processivity defects due to dysregulation of RNA Pol II elongation factors. It should be noted that these two causal processes are not mutually exclusive, as CDK12 inhibition results in the downregulation of DNA damage response genes and sensitization to DNA damage agents (please see the CDK9 section). Alternatively, RNA Pol II stalling in aged cells could also be explained by a loss of factors that rescue stalled RNA Pol II, such as TFIIS. The combination of spt6 mutation and TFIIS gene deletion results in synthetic lethality in yeast cells, and SPT6 recruits TFIIS through interaction with IWS1 in human cells (please see the SPT6 section). These observations suggest a conserved mechanism that might prevent RNA Pol II stalling through the cooperative function of SPT6 and TFIIS. If the functions of SPT6, IWS1, or TFIIS became impaired over the course of a lifetime, such impairment could lead to RNA Pol II stalling similar to that observed in aged cells. Going forward, it will be necessary to characterize the functions of RNA Pol II elongation factors in aged versus young cells and to assess the potential contributions of elongation factors to aging-related transcriptional alterations.

据此可以推测，PAF1C、SPT6 或 CDK12/13 对过程性的调控，也可能在衰老过程中受损。若如此，长转录本减少可能既源于随时间积累的 DNA 损伤，也源于 RNA Pol II 延伸因子失调导致的过程性缺陷。这两类原因并不相互排斥：抑制 CDK12 会下调 DNA 损伤应答基因，并增加细胞对 DNA 损伤剂的敏感性（参见 CDK9 一节）。另一种可能是，衰老细胞丢失了 TFIIS 等能够挽救停滞 RNA Pol II 的因子。在酵母中，spt6 突变与 TFIIS 基因删除可导致合成致死；在人细胞中，SPT6 通过与 IWS1 相互作用招募 TFIIS（参见 SPT6 一节）。这些观察提示，SPT6 与 TFIIS 可能通过一种保守的协作机制防止 RNA Pol II 停滞。如果 SPT6、IWS1 或 TFIIS 的功能随年龄受损，就可能引起类似衰老细胞中的 RNA Pol II 停滞。未来需要比较延伸因子在衰老与年轻细胞中的功能，并评估其对衰老相关转录变化的潜在贡献。

CONCLUDING REMARKS｜结语

We published in 1996 the first link between transcriptional elongation control and human cancer,<sup>1</sup> demonstrating that the elongation stage of transcription is a key regulatory step in development and its dysregulation can drive disease pathogenesis. Since then, we have demonstrated that diverse translocation within the MLL gene causing leukemia is into many subunits of the SEC,regulating transcriptional elongation control and pause release and its misregulation causing cancer.<sup>2,3</sup> Collectively,our studies and that of colleagues in the field as described in this review have demonstrated the importance of transcription elongation control not only in developmental regulation of gene expression, but also during disease pathogenesis and in aging.

我们于 1996 年首次报道了转录延伸控制与人类癌症之间的联系，<sup>1</sup> 表明转录延伸是发育过程中的关键调控步骤，其失调能够驱动疾病发生。此后，我们发现，导致白血病的多种 MLL 易位涉及 SEC 的多个亚基；SEC 调控转录延伸和暂停释放，其异常调控可致癌。<sup>2,3</sup> 如本综述所述，我们及同行的研究共同表明，转录延伸控制不仅对发育中的基因表达调控重要，也参与疾病发生及衰老。

In this review, we present a current understanding of the molecular mechanisms involved in RNA Pol II elongation control. These mechanisms include recruitment of elongation factors to RNA Pol II, swapping of elongation factors, allosteric regulation of RNA Pol II processivity and RNA Pol II stabilization. We have discussed the biochemical and mechanistic details of elongation factor function that have recently emerged thanks to the development of advanced techniques such as rapid depletion, nascent RNA-seq, and cryo-EM analysis of protein complex structure. We have also attempted to reconcile several discrepancies between recent in vivo findings and earlier in vitro biochemical evidence regarding promoter-proximal pause release and elongation processivity. Finally, we have highlighted the functional link between dysregulation of transcriptional elongation and various human diseases.

本综述介绍了目前对 RNA Pol II 延伸调控分子机制的认识，包括延伸因子向 RNA Pol II 的招募、延伸因子交换、RNA Pol II 过程性的变构调控，以及 RNA Pol II 的稳定。快速耗竭、新生 RNA-seq 和蛋白复合物冷冻电镜结构分析等技术的发展，揭示了延伸因子作用的新生化与机制细节。我们还尝试协调近期体内发现与早期体外生化证据之间，关于启动子近端暂停释放及延伸过程性的一些分歧。最后，我们强调了转录延伸失调与多种人类疾病之间的功能联系。

Dysregulated transcriptional elongation has long been associated both with developmental defects and with pathological processes including cancer and infectious disease.Now,accumulating evidence suggests a critical involvement of dysregulated RNA Pol II elongation in the aging process, underscoring the importance of transcriptional elongation control in life. Notably, it has been demonstrated that slowing down the RNA Pol II elongation rate results in extended lifespan in model systems.However, it is entirely unknown how changes to the RNA Pol II rate might affect macro aging processes, whether the function of elongation factors might change over the course of a lifetime, or which specific tissues might play a role in the macro aging processes regulated by RNA Pol II elongation rates. Although aging is also associated with the loss of long transcripts, the existence or direction of the causal relationship between the two remains unclear. Nonetheless, achieving precise control of RNA Pol II dynamics will be crucial to the development of therapeutic approaches to extend lifespan and transcriptional elongation control might be the holy grail for aging. Precise control of the process would require modulation of RNA Pol II rate while also maintaining processivity in difficult sequence environments to avoid significant loss of long transcripts. Future studies that solidify a fundamental understanding of transcriptional elongation regulation are therefore the key to successful development not only of anti-cancer drugs but also of safe and feasible therapies to potentially slow or ease the aging process.

长期以来，转录延伸失调一直与发育缺陷、癌症和感染性疾病等病理过程有关。如今，越来越多证据提示 RNA Pol II 延伸失调也深度参与衰老，进一步凸显了转录延伸控制在生命过程中的重要性。研究已表明，减慢 RNA Pol II 延伸速率可延长模式系统的寿命。然而，RNA Pol II 速率的变化如何影响机体层面的衰老，延伸因子的功能是否随年龄变化，以及哪些特定组织参与由延伸速率调控的机体衰老过程，目前均不清楚。虽然衰老也伴随长转录本减少，但两者之间是否存在因果关系及其方向仍待确定。尽管如此，精确控制 RNA Pol II 动态，将是开发延寿干预的重要环节；转录延伸控制或许是衰老研究长期追寻的“圣杯”。要实现这种精确控制，需要在调节 RNA Pol II 速率的同时，维持其在难以转录的序列环境中的过程性，以避免长转录本大量丢失。因此，未来对转录延伸调控基本机制的深入研究，不仅是成功开发抗癌药物的关键，也关系到能否开发出安全、可行、可能延缓或减轻衰老的疗法。

item.title: NELF Regulates a Promoter-Proximal Step Distinct from RNA Pol II Pause-Release
item.description: 通过急性耗竭 NELF，区分启动子近端两步暂停、P-TEFb 依赖的有效延伸与帽结合复合物招募。
item.content:encoded:
NELF Regulates a Promoter-Proximal Step Distinct from RNA Pol II Pause-Release

NELF 调控与 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停-释放不同的启动子附近步骤

原论文

Authors ｜作者

Yuki Aoi, Edwin R. Smith, Avani P. Shah,..., Fei X. Chen, Ramin Shiekhattar, Ali Shilatifard Correspondence ash@northwestern.edu

Yuki Aoi, Edwin R. Smith, Avani P. Shah,..., Fei X. Chen, Ramin Shiekhattar, Ali Shilatifard 通讯作者 ash@northwestern.edu

In Brief ｜简要介绍

Metazoan RNA Pol II-transcribed genes exhibit post-initiation regulation called pausing. Aoi et al. find that loss of the protein complex thought to maintain pausing, NELF, does not result in global release of RNA Pol II but instead may regulate other promoter-proximal regulatory steps such as 5′ mRNA cap stability.

后生动物 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录基因表现出一种称为暂停的转录起始后调控机制。Aoi 等人发现，被认为维持暂停状态的蛋白质复合物 NELF 的缺失并不会导致 RNA 聚合酶 II 的全局释放，而是可能调节其他启动子附近的调控步骤，例如 5' mRNA 帽结构的稳定性。

Highlights ｜主要发现

  • Acute NELF depletion reveals 2-step pausing of RNA Pol II at promoters.

  • The 1st-to-2nd pausing transition is independent of P-TEFb/SEC activity.

  • The heat shock response remains intact in the absence of NELF.

  • NELF recruits the cap-binding complex with modest effects on 5′ cap stability.

  • 急性耗竭 NELF 揭示启动子处 RNA Pol II 的两步暂停。

  • 从第一暂停区域向第二暂停区域的转移不依赖 P-TEFb/SEC 活性。

  • 缺失 NELF 时，热休克反应仍保持完整。

  • NELF 招募帽结合复合物，对 5′ 帽稳定性的影响较为有限。

Author affiliations ｜作者单位

Yuki Aoi,<sup>1,2</sup> Edwin R. Smith,<sup>1,2</sup> Avani P. Shah,<sup>1,2</sup> Emily J. Rendleman,<sup>1,2</sup> Stacy A. Marshall,<sup>1,2</sup> Ashley R. Woodfin,<sup>1,2</sup> Fei X. Yuki Aoi,<sup>1,2</sup> Edwin R. Smith,<sup>1,2</sup> Avani P. Shah,<sup>1,2</sup> Emily J. Rendleman,<sup>1,2</sup> Stacy A. Marshall,<sup>1,2</sup> Ashley R. Woodfin,<sup>1,2</sup> Fei X. Chen,<sup>1,2</sup> Ramin Shiekhattar,<sup>3</sup> 和 Ali Shilatifard<sup>1,2,4,</sup> _ 1Simpson Querrey 中心表观遗传学，西北大学费恩伯格医学院，美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥 60611 2 生物化学与分子遗传学系，西北大学费恩伯格医学院，美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥 60611 3 人类遗传学系，迈阿密米勒医学院综合癌症中心，美国佛罗里达州迈阿密 33136 4 通讯作者 _ 通讯地址：ash@northwestern.edu https://doi.org/10.1016/j.molcel.2020.02.014

SUMMARY ｜摘要

RNA polymerase II (RNA Pol II) is generally paused at promoter-proximal regions in most metazoans, and based on in vitro studies, this function has been attributed to the negative elongation factor (NELF). Here, we show that upon rapid depletion of NELF, RNA Pol II fails to be released into gene bodies, stopping instead around the +1 nucleosomal dyad-associated region. The transition to the 2nd pause region is independent of positive transcription elongation factor P-TEFb. During the heat shock response, RNA Pol II is rapidly released from pausing at heat shock-induced genes, while most genes are paused and transcriptionally downregulated. Both of these aspects of the heat shock response remain intact upon NELF loss. We find that NELF depletion results in global loss of cap-binding complex from chromatin without global reduction of nascent transcript 5′ cap stability. Thus, our studies implicate NELF functioning in early elongation complexes distinct from RNA Pol II pause-release.

在大多数后生动物中，RNA 聚合酶 II (RNA Pol II) 通常在启动子附近区域暂停，根据体外研究，这一功能被认为是由负向延伸因子 (NELF) 所介导。在此，我们显示，在快速耗尽 NELF 后，RNA Pol II 无法进入基因体，而是在 +1 核小体 dyad 相关区域停止。向第二个暂停区域的转换与正向转录延伸因子 P-TEFb 无关。在热休克反应期间，RNA Pol II 快速从热休克诱导基因的暂停状态中释放出来，而大多数基因则处于暂停状态并被转录下调。在 NELF 缺失的情况下，热休克反应的这两个方面均保持完整。我们发现，NELF 耗尽导致帽结合复合物从染色质上全局性丢失，但新生转录本 5′ 帽结构稳定性并未全局降低。因此，我们的研究指出了 NELF 在不同于 RNA Pol II 暂停-释放的早期延伸复合物中的功能。

INTRODUCTION ｜引言

In most metazoans, most genes exhibit RNA polymerase II (RNA Pol II) pausing at promoter-proximal regions. Release of the paused RNA Pol II into the productive elongation state is thought to be a key regulatory step in response to environmental and developmental signals, while misregulation of RNA Pol II pause-release is associated with oncogenesis such as pediatric leukemia and MYC-driven solid tumors (Chen et al., 2018). Using in vitro reconstitution assays of transcription and in vivo screens, many studies have identified protein complexes required for RNA Pol II pausing, including negative elongation factor (NELF) (Wada et al., 1998), DRB sensitivity-inducible factor (DSIF) (Yamaguchi et al., 1999), RNA Pol II-associated factor 1 (PAF1) (Chen et al., 2015a, 2017), and even the nucleosome, the basic structural unit of chromatin. Nucleosomes can serve as a molecular barrier for RNA Pol II transcription (Kujirai et al., 2018; Lai and Pugh, 2017; Weber et al., 2014). Positive elongation factor b (P-TEFb), which is a complex of cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 9 and Cyclin T, is required for release of RNA Pol II from pausing (Marshall and Price, 1995). P-TEFb is catalytically activated by the super elongation complex (SEC) (Lin et al., 2010) or BRD4 (Jang et al., 2005; Yang et al., 2005) but inactivated by the HEXIM-7SK small nuclear ribonucleoprotein particle (snRNP) complex (Nguyen et al., 2001; Yang et al., 2001). How these factors and the nucleosome work together or separately to regulate promoter-proximal pausing of RNA Pol II remains poorly understood.

在大多数后生动物中，大多数基因在启动子附近区域表现出 RNA 聚合酶 II（RNA Pol II）暂停。释放暂停的 RNA Pol II 进入有效的延伸状态被认为是响应环境和发育信号的关键调节步骤，而 RNA Pol II 暂停-释放的失调与致癌作用相关，例如儿童白血病和 MYC 驱动的实体瘤（Chen 等，2018）。通过体外转录重建实验和体内筛选，许多研究已经鉴定出维持 RNA Pol II 暂停所需的蛋白质复合物，包括负延伸因子（NELF）（Wada 等，1998），DRB 敏感性诱导因子（DSIF）（Yamaguchi 等，1999），RNA Pol II 相关因子 1（PAF1）（Chen 等，2015a, 2017），甚至核小体，染色质的基本结构单位。核小体可以作为 RNA Pol II 转录的分子屏障（Kujirai 等，2018；Lai 和 Pugh，2017；Weber 等，2014）。正延伸因子 b（P-TEFb）是一个由细胞周期依赖性激酶（CDK）9 和 Cyclin T 组成的复合物，对于释放 RNA Pol II 的暂停状态是必需的（Marshall 和 Price，1995）。P-TEFb 通过超级延伸复合物（SEC）（Lin 等，2010）或 BRD4（Jang 等，2005；Yang 等，2005）被催化激活，但被 HEXIM-7SK 小核核糖核蛋白颗粒（snRNP）复合物（Nguyen 等，2001；Yang 等，2001）失活。这些因子和核小体如何共同或单独调节 RNA Pol II 在启动子附近区域的暂停仍然不甚了解。

5′ Capping of mRNA ｜ mRNA 的 5'帽结构

Despite the pervasiveness of promoter-proximal pausing in metazoans and the abundant evidence that this is a highly regulated process, why this regulatory step is needed is still debated. Although polymerase poised at the promoter waiting for an activation signal was thought to facilitate rapid transcriptional response (Nechaev and Adelman, 2011), rapid transcription can occur in the absence of promoter-proximal pausing (Lin et al., 2011). Pausing has also been proposed to facilitate synchronous gene activation in response to developmental cues (Boettiger and Levine, 2009; Lin et al., 2011). Another idea is that promoter-proximal pausing acts as a checkpoint for cotranscriptional processes, such as to ensure mRNA capping (Sims et al., 2004). Eukaryotic mRNA contains a conserved 5′ m7G cap modification, thereby ensuring mRNA integrity partially through prevention of RNA degradation from its 5′ end (Ramanathan et al., 2016). Capping takes place cotranscriptionally upon �20 nt RNA synthesis by RNA Pol II in vitro and in vivo, indicating that the 5′ end of nascent RNA can be capped when it emerges from the RNA exit tunnel of RNA Pol II (Mandal et al., 2004; Martinez-Rucobo et al., 2015; Rasmussen and Lis, 1993). RNA Pol II is paused at promoter-proximal regions after transcribing 20–120 nt RNA (Chen et al., 2018). These studies have suggested that most nascent RNA that is associated with paused RNA Pol II is capped. Decapping enzymes can be localized to promoters, along with the 5′-3′ RNA exonuclease XRN2, which has been proposed to function as a torpedo for promoterproximal termination (Brannan et al., 2012), suggesting that the 5′ cap modification can be reversible at promoters. The 5′ cap is further protected by the cap-binding complex (CBC) (Ramanathan et al., 2016). Interestingly, NELF has been shown to directly bind to CBC and to regulate 3′ end processing for histone mRNAs (Narita et al., 2007; Schulze and Cusack, 2017). However, a connection between CBC and promoter-proximal pausing has not been investigated.

尽管后生动物中启动子附近区域的暂停普遍存在，并且有大量证据表明这是一个高度调控的过程，但为何需要这一调节步骤仍存在争议。虽然认为在启动子处等待激活信号的聚合酶有助于快速转录反应（Nechaev 和 Adelman，2011），但在没有启动子附近暂停的情况下也可以发生快速转录（Lin 等，2011）。暂停也被提出可以促进对发育线索的同步基因激活（Boettiger 和 Levine，2009；Lin 等，2011）。另一种观点是，启动子附近暂停作为共转录过程的检查点，例如确保 mRNA 帽结构的形成（Sims 等，2004）。真核生物的 mRNA 含有保守的 5' m7G 帽修饰，从而通过防止从其 5'端的 RNA 降解部分保证 mRNA 的完整性（Ramanathan 等，2016）。帽结构在 RNA Pol II 体外和体内转录约 20 nt RNA 后共转录地发生，表明当新生 RNA 从 RNA Pol II 的 RNA 出口隧道中出现时，其 5'端可以被帽化（Mandal 等，2004；Martinez-Rucobo 等，2015；Rasmussen 和 Lis，1993）。在转录 20–120 nt RNA 后，RNA Pol II 在启动子附近区域暂停（Chen 等，2018）。这些研究表明，与暂停的 RNA Pol II 相关的大多数新生 RNA 都被帽化。脱帽酶可以定位于启动子，连同 5'–3' RNA 外切酶 XRN2，后者被认为作为启动子附近终止的鱼雷发挥作用（Brannan 等，2012），这表明在启动子处帽修饰可能是可逆的。帽结构进一步被帽结合复合物（CBC）保护（）。（Ramanathan 等，2016）。有趣的是，NELF 已被证明可以直接结合 CBC 并调节组蛋白 mRNA 的 3'端加工（Narita 等，2007；Schulze 和 Cusack，2017）。然而，CBC 与启动子附近暂停之间的联系尚未被研究。

Mechanism of Pausing Regulation by NELF In Vitro and In Vivo ｜ NELF 调控暂停的机制：体外与体内

An inhibitory function of NELF for RNA Pol II transcription has been extensively studied in vitro using reconstituted transcription systems. NELF was initially isolated from human nuclear extract as a complex that prevents RNA Pol II transcription on a naked DNA template in vitro (Yamaguchi et al., 1999). Four distinct subunits, NELF-A, NELF-B, NELF-C/D (alternative translation isoforms of the NELFCD gene), and NELF-E, form the NELF complex, which is conserved among most metazoans, including human, mouse, and fly (Narita et al., 2003; Vos et al., 2016; Wu et al., 2005). The cryo-electron microscopy structure of RNA Pol II with NELF and DSIF has further suggested how NELF tentacles could restrain RNA Pol II mobility (Vos et al., 2018b).

NELF 对 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录的抑制功能已在体外使用重建的转录系统中得到广泛研究。NELF 最初是从人核提取物中分离出的一个复合物，该复合物可在裸露的 DNA 模板上抑制 RNA 聚合酶 II 的转录（Yamaguchi 等，1999）。四个不同的亚基，即 NELF-A、NELF-B、NELF-C/D（NELFCD 基因的替代翻译异构体）和 NELF-E，构成了 NELF 复合物。该复合物在大多数后生动物中是保守的，包括人类、小鼠和果蝇（Narita 等，2003；Vos 等，2016；Wu 等，2005）。冷冻电子显微镜下 RNA 聚合酶 II 与 NELF 和 DSIF 的结构进一步揭示了 NELF 的“触手”如何限制 RNA 聚合酶 II 的移动（Vos 等，2018b）。”

NELF is proposed to be required for the establishment of pausing by RNA Pol II for key biological events, including the heat shock response (Wu et al., 2003), estrogen signaling (Aiyar et al., 2004), interleukin-6 (IL-6) signaling (Aida et al., 2006), the inflammatory response (Adelman et al., 2009), fibroblast growth factor (FGF)/extracellular signal-regulated kinases (ERK) signaling (Williams et al., 2015), cell growth (Sun et al., 2011; Williams et al., 2015), and early embryonic development (Amleh et al., 2009; Williams et al., 2015), thus highlighting the physiological significance of NELF. However, reconciling in vitro studies of NELF with in vivo studies has been challenging. Unlike an essential role of NELF for pausing in vitro, NELF-depleted cells exhibited limited reduction of paused RNA Pol II at promoters, with few genes upregulated and many genes downregulated at the mRNA level, and reduced RNA Pol II occupancy in the gene body of many genes (Chen et al., 2015b; Core et al., 2012; Gilchrist et al., 2008, 2010; Muse et al., 2007; Rahl et al., 2010; Stadelmayer et al., 2014; Sun and Li, 2010; Sun et al., 2011; Williams et al., 2015; Yamamoto et al., 2014). These results have revealed a significant gap in our understanding of in vitro and in vivo pausing.

据推测，NELF 对于 RNA 聚合酶 II 在关键生物事件中建立暂停是必需的，包括热休克反应（Wu 等，2003）、雌激素信号传导（Aiyar 等，2004）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）信号传导（Aida 等，2006）、炎症反应（Adelman 等，2009）、成纤维细胞生长因子（FGF）/细胞外信号调节激酶（ERK）信号传导（Williams 等，2015）、细胞生长（Sun 等，2011；Williams 等，2015）以及早期胚胎发育（Amleh 等，2009；Williams 等，2015），从而突显了 NELF 的生理学意义。然而，将体外对 NELF 的研究与体内研究相协调一直具有挑战性。不同于 NELF 在体外对暂停的必要作用，NELF 耗竭细胞中启动子附近暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 仅出现有限减少，少数基因在 mRNA 水平上上调，而许多基因下调，并且许多基因的基因体中 RNA 聚合酶 II 的占据显著减少（Chen 等，2015b；Core 等，2012；Gilchrist 等，2008, 2010；Muse 等，2007；Rahl 等，2010；Stadelmayer 等，2014；Sun 和 Li，2010；Sun 等，2011；Williams 等，2015；Yamamoto 等，2014）。这些结果揭示了我们对体外与体内暂停机制理解中的显著差距。”

The recent emergence of rapid degradation strategies holds great promise for dissecting cellular mechanisms. Therefore, to examine NELF functions on RNA Pol II pausing in human cells, we have established rapid NELF depletion in cells using the auxin-inducible degron (AID) (Natsume et al., 2016). We find that promoter-proximal pausing is largely intact in the absence of NELF, leading us to propose that NELF functions at a promoter-proximal step distinct from regulating the release of RNA Pol II from pausing.

近期快速降解策略的出现为解析细胞机制带来了巨大希望。因此，为了在人类细胞中研究 NELF 对 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停的功能，我们利用生长素诱导降解子（AID）建立了细胞中快速的 NELF 耗竭方法（Natsume 等，2016）。我们发现，在缺乏 NELF 的情况下，启动子附近的暂停基本保持完整，这促使我们提出 NELF 在启动子附近的一个不同于调控 RNA 聚合酶 II 从暂停状态释放的步骤中发挥作用。”

中文: 图 1 ｜急性降解 NELF-C-AID 导致染色质上的 NELF 复合物丢失。（A）生长素诱导 NELF-C-AID 降解的示意图（上）。NELF-C-AID 或亲本 DLD-1 细胞经生长素处理指定时间后的全细胞提取物免疫印迹（下）。处理 1 h 后 NELF-C 显著耗竭。同时检测 NELF-E 和 DSIF 亚基 SPT5 以供比较。Tubulin 为上样对照，三角形表示提取物用量递增。（B）未处理或经生长素处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞生长曲线（下）。通过结晶紫染色测定相对细胞数。数据为均值 ± 标准差，n = 3。上图为 96 h 时的代表性细胞染色。（C）NELF-C-AID 细胞经生长素处理或未处理 2 h 后，NELF-C、NELF-E 和 SPT5 的 ChIP-seq 基因组浏览器轨迹示例。NELF-C 丢失伴随染色质上 NELF-E 的丢失，而 SPT5 占据仅部分减少。Y 轴为每百万读段归一化读数。（D）以 RNA Pol II 暂停区域为中心，展示未处理或经生长素处理 2 h 的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中 NELF-C、NELF-E 和 SPT5 平均占据情况的 ChIP-seq 聚合曲线。N = 6,531 个在对照条件下具有 PRO-seq 信号的基因（见 STAR Methods）。Y 轴为每百万读段归一化读数（rpm）。

We employed the AID system (Natsume et al., 2016) to rapidly deplete cells of NELF. The endogenous NELFC gene was tagged with the mini-AID cassette at its C terminus in human DLD-1 cells that constitutively express the AID adaptor protein OsTIR1 (Figure 1A; STAR Methods). �90% of NELF-C-AID protein disappeared within 1 h of auxin treatment in NELF-C-AID cells (Figure 1A). NELF-C protein was stable in auxin-treated parental cells (Figure 1A), confirming that NELF-C-AID is degraded in an AID-tag-dependent manner. Notably, the NELF-E subunit was stable for up to 4 h of auxin treatment in NELF-C-AID cells, but it began to disappear at later time points (Figure 1A). These interdependences of NELF subunits for stability are consistent with previous studies (Narita et al., 2007; Sun et al., 2008; Williams et al., 2015). Long-term NELF-C-AID loss led to a severe growth defect (Figure 1B), which could lead to indirect effects on transcription. Therefore, we chose % 4 h of auxin treatment for further experiments to ensure loss of NELF while minimizing indirect effects of NELF loss on RNA Pol II transcription.

我们采用了 AID 系统（Natsume 等，2016）来快速耗竭细胞中的 NELF。在持续表达 AID 适配蛋白 OsTIR1 的人类 DLD-1 细胞中，内源性 NELFC 基因在其 C 端被 mini-AID 盒标记（图 1A；STAR 方法）。在 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，生长素处理 1 小时后，90%的 NELF-C-AID 蛋白消失（图 1A）。在生长素处理的亲本细胞中，NELF-C 蛋白稳定（图 1A），证实了 NELF-C-AID 是以 AID 标签依赖的方式被降解。值得注意的是，在 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，NELF-E 亚基在生长素处理 4 小时内保持稳定，但在较晚时间点开始消失（图 1A）。这些 NELF 亚基之间对稳定性的相互依赖性与之前的研究一致（Narita 等，2007；Sun 等，2008；Williams 等，2015）。长期缺失 NELF-C-AID 导致严重的生长缺陷（图 1B），这可能导致对转录的间接影响。因此，我们选择了 4 小时的生长素处理进行进一步实验，以确保缺失 NELF 的同时尽量减少 NELF 缺失对 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录的间接影响。

Loss of NELF Complex on Chromatin upon NELF-C-AID Depletion ｜ NELF-C-AID 耗竭后染色质上 NELF 复合物的丢失

We carried out chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) experiments to test whether NELF-C-AID degradation reduces NELF-C-AID protein on chromatin. In the absence of auxin, ChIP-seq for NELF-C, NELF-E, and a DSIF subunit, SPT5, showed that their peaks were colocalized at promoter regions (Figures 1C and S1A). This result indicates that the AID-tagged NELF-C protein is properly incorporated into the NELF-DSIF-Pol II pausing complex at promoters. When NELFC-AID cells were treated with auxin for 2 h, NELF-C ChIP-seq peaks disappeared (Figure 1C). NELF-E ChIP-seq peaks simultaneously disappeared upon NELF-C-AID degradation (Figure 1C), despite NELF-E still being present in cells at this time point (Figure 1A). These results indicate that depletion of NELF-C-AID results in the loss of the NELF complex on chromatin. However, SPT5 ChIP-seq peaks largely remained upon NELF loss (Figure 1C), consistent with the NELF-independent binding of SPT5 to RNA Pol II seen in vitro (Missra and Gilmour, 2010; Yamaguchi et al., 2002). Genome-wide analysis of ChIPseq data showed global reduction of NELF-C-AID and NELF-E occupancy at RNA Pol II pause regions upon auxin treatment, while SPT5 largely remained (Figure 1D). Altogether, our data indicate that rapid NELF-C-AID degradation leads to loss of the NELF complex from chromatin.

我们进行了染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）实验，以检测 NELF-C-AID 降解是否会导致 NELF-C-AID 蛋白在染色质上的减少。在没有生长素的情况下，针对 NELF-C、NELF-E 和 DSIF 亚基 SPT5 的 ChIP-seq 显示，它们的峰值在启动子区域共定位（图 1C 和 S1A）。这一结果表明，AID 标记的 NELF-C 蛋白被正确地整合到启动子附近的 NELF-DSIF-RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停复合物中。当 NELFC-AID 细胞用生长素处理 2 h 后，NELF-C ChIP-seq 峰值消失（图 1C）。尽管在该时间点 NELF-E 仍存在于细胞中（图 1A），但在 NELF-C-AID 降解的同时，NELF-E ChIP-seq 峰值也消失了（图 1C）。这些结果表明，NELF-C-AID 的耗竭导致了染色质上 NELF 复合物的丢失。然而，在失去 NELF 的情况下，SPT5 ChIP-seq 峰值大部分仍然存在（图 1C），这与体外观察到的 SPT5 独立于 NELF 结合 RNA 聚合酶 II 的现象一致（Missra 和 Gilmour, 2010；Yamaguchi 等, 2002）。对 ChIPseq 数据进行全基因组分析显示，在生长素处理后，NELF-C-AID 和 NELF-E 在 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停区域的占据显著减少，而 SPT5 则基本保持不变（图 1D）。综上所述，我们的数据表明，快速的 NELF-C-AID 降解导致了 NELF 复合物从染色质上的丢失。

To precisely explore functions of NELF in RNA Pol II transcription, we determined the genome-wide distribution of active RNA Pol II with precision nuclear run-on sequencing (PRO-seq) (Kwak et al., 2013). PRO-seq track examples show that transcriptionally active RNA Pol II is paused at the promoter regions in the untreated condition (Figure 2A). The distribution of RNA Pol II shows a modest shift downstream at 1 and 4 h of auxin treatment in NELF-C-AID cells (Figure 2A). To analyze this RNA Pol II shift genome-wide, we defined the original pause region at each active gene: the nucleotide with the maximum PRO-seq signal at the promoter-proximal region in untreated NELF-C-AID cells was defined as the location of the 1st pause region, while the maximum in NELF-C-AID cells treated with auxin for 1 h was defined as the location of the 2nd pause region (see STAR Methods). Metaplot analysis of the PRO-seq signal centered on 1st pause regions showed that the PRO-seq signal at 1st pause regions decreased upon NELF loss, whereas an increased PRO-seq peak corresponding to the 2nd pause region occurred around 50 bp downstream of the 1st pause region upon NELF loss (Figure 2B). The histogram showed that the median distance between the 1st and the 2nd pause regions is 49 bp and most (81.7%) transcribing genes have a distance no longer than 150 bp (Figure 2C). These results suggest that RNA Pol II undergoes 2-step pausing and NELF loss results in transitioning of paused RNA Pol II to 2nd pause regions.

为了精确探讨 NELF 在 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录中的功能，我们使用精确核运行测序（PRO-seq）确定了活性 RNA 聚合酶 II 的全基因组分布（Kwak 等, 2013）。PRO-seq 轨迹示例显示，在未处理条件下，转录活跃的 RNA 聚合酶 II 在启动子区域处于暂停状态（图 2A）。在 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，生长素处理 1 h 和 4 h 后，RNA 聚合酶 II 的分布显示出适度的下游偏移（图 2A）。为了对这一 RNA 聚合酶 II 的偏移进行全基因组分析，我们定义了每个活跃基因的原始暂停区域：在未处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，启动子附近区域 PRO-seq 信号最大的核苷酸被定义为第一暂停区域的位置；而在生长素处理 1 h 后的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，PRO-seq 信号最大的位置则被定义为第二暂停区域的位置（见 STAR Methods）。以第一个暂停区域为中心的 PRO-seq 信号元图谱分析显示，在 NELF 缺失时，第一个暂停区域的 PRO-seq 信号减少，而在 NELF 缺失时，对应于第二个暂停区域的 PRO-seq 峰出现在第一个暂停区域下游约 50 bp 处（图 2B）。直方图显示第一个和第二个暂停区域之间的中位距离为 49 bp，且大多数（81.7%）转录基因的距离不超过 150 bp（图 2C）。这些结果表明 RNA 聚合酶 II 经历两步暂停，而 NELF 缺失导致暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 转移到第二个暂停区域。

To test whether NELF loss leads to release of paused RNA Pol II to productive elongation, we generated heatmaps of PRO-seq log2 fold change at gene bodies. NELF-C ChIP-seq peaks overlapped 1st pause regions (Figure 2D), confirming that the RNA Pol II-NELF pausing complex occupies 1st pause regions. Upon NELF loss at 1 and 4 h of auxin treatment, the PRO-seq signal in gene bodies was uniformly and significantly decreased (Figures 2D and 2E). The PRO-seq signal was significantly decreased at 1st pause regions and significantly increased at 2nd pause regions upon NELF loss (Figures 2D and 2E). These data suggest that the paused RNA Pol II at 2nd pause regions is not able to enter productive elongation despite NELF loss.

为了测试 NELF 缺失是否导致暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 进入生产性延伸，我们生成了基因体中 PRO-seq 对数倍变化的热图。NELF-C ChIP-seq 峰与第一个暂停区域重叠（图 2D），确认 RNA 聚合酶 II-NELF 暂停复合物占据第一个暂停区域。在生长素处理 1 和 4 h 后 NELF 缺失时，基因体中的 PRO-seq 信号均匀且显著减少（图 2D 和 2E）。在 NELF 缺失时，第一个暂停区域的 PRO-seq 信号显著减少，而第二个暂停区域的 PRO-seq 峰显著增加（图 2D 和 2E）。这些数据表明，尽管 NELF 缺失，第二个暂停区域的暂停 RNA 聚合酶 II 仍无法进入生产性延伸。

Given this observation, we also examined the effects of longterm depletion of NELF. At 24 h of auxin treatment, the PRO-seq signal was significantly decreased at promoters and gene bodies. Given the discrepancy between the results with NELF loss within 1 to 4 h and those within 24 h, we propose that the global loss of the PRO-seq signal throughout active genes after 24 h of NELF loss may result from indirect effects of NELF loss, because we observed a severe growth defect at this time point. The effect of 24 h NELF depletion with the AID system closely resembles what has been seen in studies depleting NELF with short hairpin RNA (shRNA) treatment over several days (Sun and Li, 2010).

鉴于这一观察结果，我们还研究了 NELF 长期耗竭的影响。在生长素处理 24 h 后，启动子和基因体中的 PRO-seq 信号显著减少。鉴于在 1 至 4 h 内 NELF 缺失与 24 h 内 NELF 缺失结果之间的差异，我们提出在 NELF 缺失 24 h 后整个活跃基因中 PRO-seq 信号的全局丢失可能是由 NELF 缺失的间接效应引起的，因为在此时间点我们观察到严重的生长缺陷。使用 AID 系统进行 24 h NELF 耗竭的效果与用短发夹 RNA（shRNA）处理数天后 NELF 耗竭研究中所见的结果非常相似（Sun 和 Li, 2010）。

NELF-E-AID Depletion Also Showed 2-Step Pausing ｜ NELF-E-AID 的耗竭也显示了两步暂停

To test the effects of depleting another NELF subunit, we generated NELF-E-AID cells. Western blotting showed that R80% of NELF-E-AID proteins were degraded within 1 h of auxin treatment (Figure S1B). ChIP-seq for NELF-C, NELF-E, and SPT5 in NELF-E-AID cells showed that NELF-E-AID degradation resulted in loss of NELF-C and NELF-E peaks, while SPT5 peaks were not reduced as much as NELF subunits (Figures S1C and S1D). Metaplot analysis of PRO-seq showed accumulation of the PRO-seq signal around 50 bp downstream of 1st pause regions (Figure S2A). These results suggest that NELF-E-AID degradation leads to loss of the NELF complex on chromatin and leads to RNA Pol II accumulation at 2nd pause regions, consistent with results in NELF-C-AID cells. Importantly, parental DLD-1 cells did not display PRO-seq signal accumulation downstream of 1st pause regions upon auxin treatment (Figure S2B), excluding the possibility that this effect results from an off-target effect of auxin treatment causing RNA Pol II to accumulate at 2nd pause regions.

为了测试耗竭另一种 NELF 亚基的效果，我们生成了 NELF-E-AID 细胞。Western blotting 显示，在生长素处理后 1 小时内，约 80% 的 NELF-E-AID 蛋白质被降解（图 S1B）。在 NELF-E-AID 细胞中对 NELF-C、NELF-E 和 SPT5 进行的 ChIP-seq 显示，NELF-E-AID 的降解导致了 NELF-C 和 NELF-E 峰的丢失，而 SPT5 峰并未像 NELF 亚基那样显著减少（图 S1C 和 S1D）。PRO-seq 的 metaplot 分析显示，在第一个暂停区域下游约 50 bp 处累积了 PRO-seq 信号（图 S2A）。这些结果表明，NELF-E-AID 降解导致染色质上 NELF 复合物的丢失，并导致 RNA 聚合酶 II 在第二暂停区域的累积，这与 NELF-C-AID 细胞中的结果一致。重要的是，亲本 DLD-1 细胞在生长素处理后并未在第一暂停区域下游显示出 PRO-seq 信号的累积（图 S2B），排除了这种效应是由生长素处理引起的脱靶效应导致 RNA 聚合酶 II 在第二暂停区域累积的可能性。

中文: 图 3 ｜第二暂停区域与 +1 核小体相关。（A）生长素处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中的 PRO-seq 信号热图（每百万读段归一化读数），与 DLD-1 细胞的 H3K4me3 ChIP-seq 和 MNase-seq 信号并列展示。热图以启动子近端暂停区域为中心，按至第二暂停区域的距离排序，展示范围为暂停点 ±500 bp。同时展示 PRO-seq 相对于 0 h 的 log₂ 倍数变化。MNase-seq 数据来自 Yamashita 等（2011），SRA：DRX000003。N = 6,531，其中 5,338 个基因具有近端第二暂停区域，1,193 个基因具有远端第二暂停区域。（B）以第一暂停区域为中心的 MNase-seq 平均信号聚合曲线（每百万读段数）。N = 5,338 个具有近端第二暂停区域的基因。（C）生长素处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，以 +1 核小体二重对称轴（dyad）为中心的 PRO-seq 平均信号聚合曲线（每百万读段归一化读数）。浅绿色阴影表示由 MNase-seq 确定的 +1 核小体位置（+1 dyad ±75 bp）。N = 1,843 个基因，为具有近端第二暂停区域且 +1 核小体定位明确的基因（见 STAR Methods）。

We next examined whether the 2nd pause regions are associated with nucleosomes. First, we ordered heatmaps of the PRO-seq signal by the distance to the 2nd pause region, and then we aligned them to heatmaps of histone H3 lysine 4 trimethylation (H3K4me3) ChIP-seq and the micrococcal nuclease sequencing (MNase-seq) signal (Figure 3A). The MNase-seq heatmap centered on 1st pause regions showed nucleosome phasing, consistent with a recent study (Tome et al., 2018). Two patterns of nucleosome phasing were associated with distinct polymerase profiles: proximal 2nd pause genes with % 150 bp of distance to the 2nd pause region and distal 2nd pause genes with >150 bp to the 2nd pause region. Proximal 2nd pause genes showed good +1, +2, and +3 nucleosome phasing, while distal 2nd pause genes showed relatively poor nucleosome phasing (Figures 3A and 3B).

我们接下来检查了第二个暂停区域是否与核小体相关。首先，我们将 PRO-seq 信号的热图按到第二个暂停区域的距离排序，然后将其与组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸 4 三甲基化（H3K4me3）ChIP-seq 和微球菌核酸酶测序（MNase-seq）信号的热图对齐（图 3A）。以第一个暂停区域为中心的 MNase-seq 热图显示了核小体相位，这与最近的一项研究一致（Tome 等，2018）。与不同聚合酶谱型相关的两种核小体相位模式：启动子附近第二个暂停基因与第二个暂停区域距离% 150 bp，远端第二个暂停基因与第二个暂停区域距离>150 bp。具有启动子附近第二个暂停的基因显示出良好的+1、+2 和+3 核小体相位，而具有远端第二个暂停的基因显示出相对较差的核小体相位（图 3A 和 3B）。

We next examined how 1st pause regions and 2nd pause regions are distributed around the +1 nucleosome. We re-aligned the PRO-seq signal of proximal 2nd pause genes centered on the 1st nucleosomal dyad (Figure 3C; STAR Methods). The peaks of 1st pause regions were observed around 60 bp upstream of the +1 dyad (Figure 3C), indicating that the RNA Pol II-NELF complex is paused at the entrance of the +1 nucleosome. Upon NELF loss, PRO-seq peaks corresponding to the 2nd pause regions were observed at the region between the 1st pause regions and the +1 dyad (Figure 3C). This accumulation of the PRO-seq signal up to the +1 dyad was also observed in auxin-treated NELF-E-AID cells (Figure S3A), but it was not observed in parental DLD-1 cells (Figure S3B). These results suggest that NELF loss results in transitioning of paused RNA Pol II up to the +1 dyad. In distal 2nd pause genes, 2nd pause regions tend to be associated with the +2 or +3 nucleosome (Figure 3A). The ability to bypass the +1 dyad may result from the lower stability of the +1 nucleosome at these genes (Figure 3B).

我们接下来检查了第 1 次暂停区域和第 2 次暂停区域在+1 核小体周围的分布情况。我们将靠近第 1 次暂停基因的 PRO-seq 信号重新对齐，以第 1 个核小体二重对称轴为中心（图 3C；STAR 方法）。观察到第 1 次暂停区域的峰值位于+1 核小体二重对称轴上游约 60 bp 处（图 3C），这表明 RNA 聚合酶 II-NELF 复合物在+1 核小体入口处暂停。在 NELF 缺失后，观察到对应于第 2 次暂停区域的 PRO-seq 峰值出现在第 1 次暂停区域和+1 核小体二重对称轴之间的区域（图 3C）。这种 PRO-seq 信号在+1 核小体二重对称轴处的积累也在生长素处理的 NELF-E-AID 细胞中被观察到（图 S3A），但在亲本 DLD-1 细胞中未观察到（图 S3B）。这些结果表明，NELF 缺失导致暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 向+1 核小体二重对称轴迁移。在远离第 2 次暂停基因中，第 2 次暂停区域倾向于与+2 或+3 核小体相关（图 3A）。能够绕过+1 核小体二重对称轴可能源于这些基因中+1 核小体的稳定性较低（图 3B）。

中文: 图 4 ｜向第二暂停区域的转移不依赖 P-TEFb。（A）NELF-C-AID 细胞经生长素处理或未处理 2 h 后，以暂停区域为中心的 RNA Pol II CTD Ser2 或 Ser5 磷酸化 ChIP-seq 信号聚合曲线（每百万读段归一化读数，rpm）。N = 6,531。（B）用于（C）和（D）的实验设计示意图。NELF-C-AID 细胞先经 P-TEFb 抑制剂 FP 处理 1 h，随后用生长素处理 2 h，以耗竭染色质上的 NELF。（C）PRO-seq 信号（每百万读段归一化读数）相对于 DMSO 对照的 log₂ 倍数变化热图。上方面板的虚线表示转录终止位点，各行按基因长度排序。N = 6,531。（D）经 FP 和生长素处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中，以 +1 核小体二重对称轴为中心的 PRO-seq 平均信号聚合曲线（每百万读段归一化读数）。浅绿色阴影表示由 MNase-seq 确定的 +1 核小体位置（+1 dyad ±75 bp）。N = 1,843 个具有近端第二暂停区域且 +1 核小体定位明确的基因（见 STAR Methods）。（E）提出的 RNA Pol II 启动子暂停机制。（a）NELF 与 +1 核小体协同调控暂停。NELF 从物理上抑制 RNA Pol II 转录，而 +1 核小体（或与之相关的因子）可能提供另一种暂停机制。（b）NELF 耗竭允许 RNA Pol II 不依赖 P-TEFb 而向前推进至 +1 dyad；RNA Pol II 穿越核小体并进入有效延伸则需要 P-TEFb 活性。RNA Pol II 穿越核小体进行转录的结构改编自 Kujirai 等（2018），PDB：6A5P、6A5T。RNA Pol II–NELF 复合物结构改编自 Vos 等（2018b），PDB：6GML。

The phosphorylation states of the RNA Pol II C-terminal domain (CTD) have been shown to regulate RNA Pol II throughout the transcription cycle by a series of CDKs, including initiation, when CDK7 phosphorylates the CTD on serine 5, and promoter-proximal pause-release, which is associated with serine 2 phosphorylation by CDK9-Cyclin T (P-TEFb) (Chen et al., 2018). Accordingly, phospho-Ser5 is enriched at promoters, while phospho-Ser2 occupancy increases along gene bodies. We tested whether NELF loss affects CTD phosphorylation states. Metaplot analysis of ChIP-seq for phospho-Ser2 and phospho-Ser5 of RNA Pol II CTD showed that both phosphorylation levels at promoters were maintained upon NELF loss. Notably, these phosphorylation peaks shifted slightly downstream of pause regions (Figure 4A), corresponding to the transition of paused RNA Pol II to 2nd pause regions. These results suggest that NELF loss does not result in alteration of CTD phosphorylation states and therefore that the transition of paused RNA Pol II to the 2nd pause region can occur without changes in CTD phosphorylation.

RNA 聚合酶 II C 端结构域（CTD）的磷酸化状态已被证明通过一系列 CDKs 调控整个转录周期中的 RNA 聚合酶 II，包括起始阶段，此时 CDK7 在丝氨酸 5 上磷酸化 CTD，以及启动子附近暂停-释放阶段，这与 CDK9-Cyclin T（P-TEFb）介导的丝氨酸 2 磷酸化相关（Chen 等，2018）。因此，磷酸化丝氨酸 5 在启动子处富集，而磷酸化丝氨酸 2 的占据程度沿基因体增加。我们检测了 NELF 缺失是否影响 CTD 磷酸化状态。对 RNA 聚合酶 II CTD 磷酸化丝氨酸 2 和丝氨酸 5 的 ChIP-seq 进行元图分析显示，在 NELF 缺失后，启动子处的两种磷酸化水平均得以维持。值得注意的是，这些磷酸化峰值略微向下游移动至暂停区域（图 4A），对应于暂停 RNA 聚合酶 II 向第 2 次暂停区域的转变。这些结果表明，NELF 缺失不会导致 CTD 磷酸化状态的改变，因此暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 向第 2 次暂停区域的转变可以在不改变 CTD 磷酸化的情况下发生。

The Transition of Paused RNA Pol II to the +1 Dyad Is Independent of P-TEFb Activity ｜暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 向+1 核小体二重对称轴的转变独立于 P-TEFb 活性

Release from promoter-proximal pausing relies on the activity of the Cdk9-Cyclin T complex known as P-TEFb and may involve phosphorylation of DSIF and NELF, in addition to Ser2 of the RNA Pol II CTD (Chen et al., 2018). Given that NELF loss does not affect phospho-Ser2 levels, we examined whether the transition of paused RNA Pol II to 2nd pause regions depends on P-TEFb activity. We treated NELF-C-AID cells with the P-TEFb inhibitor flavopiridol (FP), followed by auxin treatment to deplete NELF (Figure 4B). Heatmaps of PRO-seq log2 fold change showed that FP treatment greatly induced pausing at 1st pause regions when NELF was present (Figure 4C). Depleting NELF with auxin treatment canceled the FP-induced 1st region of pausing, indicating that transition of paused RNA Pol II upon NELF loss is independent of P-TEFb (Figure 4C). To examine 2nd pause positions at the +1 nucleosome, we generated PRO-seq metaplots centered on the +1 dyad as described for Figure 3C. The metaplot analysis showed that FP-induced pausing occurred at the entrance of the +1 nucleosome, while PRO-seq peaks in the FP + auxin condition were observed at the region between 1st pause regions and the +1 dyad, similar to PRO-seq peaks in the auxin-alone condition (Figure 4D). Because there was no increase in RNA Pol II occupancy at the 2nd pause region after FP treatment in the absence of NELF, this suggests that NELF is generally needed for the establishment of pausing. To exclude potential off-target effects of FP, we also tested the effects of NVP-2, a highly selective P-TEFb inhibitor with sub-nanomolar potency (Olson et al., 2018). Consistent with our results with FP treatment, NVP-2-induced pausing occurred at the 1st pause region in the presence of NELF and shifted to the 2nd pause region upon NELF depletion (Figure S4). These data demonstrate that RNA Pol II can be paused at the entrance of the +1 nucleosome in a NELF-dependent manner (Figure 4E(a)) and that RNA Pol II can resume transcription toward the +1 dyad upon NELF loss without P-TEFb activity (Figure 4E(b)) (see Discussion).

从启动子附近的暂停状态中释放依赖于 Cdk9-Cyclin T 复合物，即 P-TEFb 的活性，并且可能涉及 DSIF 和 NELF 的磷酸化，以及 RNA 聚合酶 II C 端结构域（CTD）的 Ser2 磷酸化（Chen 等，2018）。鉴于 NELF 缺失不影响磷酸化的 Ser2 水平，我们检测了暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 向第二暂停区域的转变是否依赖于 P-TEFb 活性。我们对 NELF-C-AID 细胞使用 P-TEFb 抑制剂 flavopiridol（FP）处理，随后使用生长素处理以耗尽 NELF（图 4B）。PRO-seq 对数倍变化的热图显示，在存在 NELF 时，FP 处理显著诱导了第一暂停区域的暂停（图 4C）。通过生长素处理耗尽 NELF 消除了 FP 诱导的第一暂停区域的暂停，表明在 NELF 缺失时暂停 RNA 聚合酶 II 的转变独立于 P-TEFb（图 4C）。为了检测+1 核小体处第二暂停位置，我们生成了以+1 二元轴为中心的 PRO-seq 元图谱，如图 3C 所述。元图谱分析显示，FP 诱导的暂停发生在+1 核小体的入口处，而在 FP + 生长素条件下，PRO-seq 峰出现在第一暂停区域和+1 二元轴之间的区域，类似于单独生长素处理条件下的 PRO-seq 峰（图 4D）。由于在没有 NELF 的情况下，FP 处理后第二暂停区域的 RNA 聚合酶 II 占有率没有增加，这表明 NELF 通常对于暂停的建立是必需的。为了排除 FP 潜在的脱靶效应，我们还测试了 NVP-2 的作用，这是一种高选择性的 P-TEFb 抑制剂，具有亚纳摩尔效力（Olson 等，2018）。与我们使用 FP 处理的结果一致，NVP-2 诱导的暂停在存在 NELF 时发生在第一暂停区域，并且在 NELF 耗尽后转移到第二暂停区域（图 S4）。这些数据表明 RNA 聚合酶 II 可以在+1 核小体入口处以 NELF 依赖的方式暂停（图 4E(a)），并且在 NELF 缺失时，RNA 聚合酶 II 可以在没有 P-TEFb 活性的情况下恢复转录至+1 二元轴（图 4E(b)）（见讨论）。
