In mammalian cells, the heat shock response has been demonstrated to result in the upregulation of a small subset of genes through release from the paused state while downregulating most genes through increased promoter-proximal pausing (Chen et al., 2017; Mahat et al., 2016a). To test whether acute loss of NELF is required for the heat shock response, we treated NELF-C-AID cells with auxin for 2 h, followed by heat shock treatment at 42<sup>�</sup> C for 1 h (Figure 5A). We defined heat shock-upregulated genes and heat shock-downregulated genes based on PRO-seq density at gene bodies (see STAR Methods).

在哺乳动物细胞中，热休克反应已被证明通过从暂停状态中释放来上调一小部分基因，而通过增加启动子附近的暂停来下调大多数基因（Chen 等，2017；Mahat 等，2016a）。为了测试 NELF 的急性缺失是否是热休克反应所必需的，我们对 NELF-C-AID 细胞进行 2 小时的生长素处理，随后在 42°C 下进行 1 小时的热休克处理（图 5A）。我们根据基因体上的 PRO-seq 密度定义了热休克上调基因和热休克下调基因（见 STAR 方法）。

PRO-seq tracks demonstrate that transcriptional upregulation upon heat shock appeared normal in the absence of NELF (Figure S5A). Genome-wide analysis of heat shock-upregulated genes showed that PRO-seq density in gene bodies at 42<sup>�</sup> C in the absence of NELF is not significantly different from what is seen in the presence of NELF (Figures 5B and 5C). These results suggest that transcriptional induction upon heat shock is robust in the absence of NELF. For heat shock-downregulated genes, PRO-seq tracks showed that transcriptional downregulation upon heat shock also appeared relatively normal in the absence of NELF (Figure S5B). PRO-seq density was reduced in gene bodies at 42<sup>�</sup> C, with an even slightly lower PRO-seq signal, in the absence of NELF (Figures 5D and 5E).

PRO-seq 轨迹表明，在没有 NELF 的情况下，热休克引起的转录上调似乎正常（图 S5A）。对热休克上调基因的全基因组分析显示，在没有 NELF 的情况下，42°C 时基因体上的 PRO-seq 密度与存在 NELF 时相比并无显著差异（图 5B 和 5C）。这些结果表明，在没有 NELF 的情况下，热休克引起的转录诱导是稳健的。对于热休克下调基因，PRO-seq 轨迹显示，在没有 NELF 的情况下，热休克引起的转录下调也相对正常（图 S5B）。在 42°C 下，基因体中的 PRO-seq 密度降低，且在没有 NELF 的情况下，PRO-seq 信号甚至略有下降（图 5D 和 5E）。

Heat shock in the presence of NELF resulted in an increased PRO-seq signal at 1st pause regions (Figure 5D), confirming that heat shock induces canonical pausing (Chen et al., 2017; Mahat et al., 2016a). Surprisingly, in the absence of NELF, the PRO-seq signal at the 2nd pause regions increased upon heat shock, while the PRO-seq signal at the 1st pause regions was not increased. Metaplot analysis of PRO-seq showed that the PRO-seq signal at the entrance of the +1 nucleosome increased upon heat shock in the presence of NELF, while the PRO-seq signal around the +1 dyad increased upon heat shock in the absence of NELF (Figure 5F). These results demonstrate that both gene upregulation and gene downregulation upon heat shock are intact in the absence of NELF and that nucleosomeassociated pausing can serve as a complementary step for pausing in heat shock-downregulated genes.

在存在 NELF 的情况下进行热休克处理，导致第一暂停区域的 PRO-seq 信号增加（图 5D），这证实了热休克能够诱导典型的暂停（Chen 等，2017；Mahat 等，2016a）。令人惊讶的是，在没有 NELF 的情况下，热休克处理后第二暂停区域的 PRO-seq 信号增加，而第一暂停区域的 PRO-seq 信号并未增加。对 PRO-seq 的元图谱分析显示，在存在 NELF 的情况下，热休克处理后+1 核小体入口处的 PRO-seq 信号增加；而在没有 NELF 的情况下，热休克处理后+1 核小体二重对称轴周围的 PRO-seq 信号增加（图 5F）。这些结果表明，在缺乏 NELF 的情况下，热休克诱导的基因上调和下调均保持完整，并且核小体相关的暂停可以作为热休克下调基因中暂停的补充步骤。

NELF Is Required for Recruitment of CBC to Promoters ｜ NELF 是将 CBC 招募至启动子所必需的

Next, we addressed the significance of NELF-dependent pausing for nascent RNA stability. The cap-binding complex (CBC) has been shown to directly bind to NELF (Narita et al., 2007; Schulze and Cusack, 2017). The binding affinity between CBC and NELF can be increased 8-fold by the 5′ cap analog m7GTP (Schulze and Cusack, 2017), suggesting that CBC could be efficiently targeted to the RNA Pol II-NELF complex upon completion of the capping reaction. However, the molecular function of NELF-CBC binding at promoters has not been determined. We first characterized genome-wide occupancies of CBP80, a subunit of CBC. ChIP-seq peak analysis showed that most CBP80 peaks highly overlap NELF-C peaks (Figure 6A). Annotation of ChIP-seq peaks demonstrated that CBP80 and NELF co-occupy promoters, while NELF peaks without CBP80 peaks are enriched in intron and intergenic regions (Figure S6A). A scatterplot of NELF-C peak intensity versus CBP80 peak intensity at promoters showed significant positive correlation between them(Figure 6B,Spearman correlation coefficient R<sup>2</sup> = 0.81). These results demonstrate a genome-wide association between CBP80 and NELF at promoters.

接下来，我们考察了 NELF 依赖性暂停对新生 RNA 稳定性的意义。帽结合复合物（CBC）已被证明可直接结合 NELF（Narita 等，2007；Schulze 和 Cusack，2017）。5′ 帽类似物 m7GTP 可使 CBC 与 NELF 的结合亲和力提高 8 倍（Schulze 和 Cusack，2017），提示加帽反应完成后，CBC 可被有效招募至 RNA Pol II–NELF 复合物。然而，启动子处 NELF–CBC 结合的分子功能尚未明确。我们首先分析了 CBC 亚基 CBP80 的全基因组占据情况。ChIP-seq 峰分析显示，大多数 CBP80 峰与 NELF-C 峰高度重叠（图 6A）。峰注释表明，CBP80 与 NELF 共同占据启动子，而不伴随 CBP80 峰的 NELF 峰则富集于内含子和基因间区（图 S6A）。启动子处 NELF-C 与 CBP80 峰强度的散点图显示两者显著正相关（图 6B，原文标注 Spearman 相关系数 R² = 0.81）。这些结果表明，CBP80 与 NELF 在全基因组启动子处存在关联。

The CBP80 protein level was stable upon NELF loss, as assayed by western blotting (Figure 6C), but CBP80 ChIP-seq in auxintreated NELF-C-AID cells showed that most CBP80 peaks disappeared upon NELF loss (Figure 6D). Metaplot analysis of the CBP80 ChIP-seq signal demonstrated substantial reduction of CBP80 at pause regions upon NELF loss (Figure 6E). Heatmap analysis showed that CBP80 occupies the 1st pause regions with RNA Pol II, while the residual CBP80 in NELF-depleted cells colocalized with RNA Pol II at 2nd pause regions (Figure S6B). This suggests that although a large fraction of CBP80 is dissociated from chromatin upon NELF loss, CBP80 may be weakly recruited to RNA Pol II paused at the +1 dyad.

在 NELF 缺失的情况下，通过 Western blotting 检测到的 CBP80 蛋白水平保持稳定（图 6C），但在生长素处理的 NELF-C-AID 细胞中进行的 CBP80 染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）显示，大多数 CBP80 峰值在 NELF 缺失时消失（图 6D）。对 CBP80 ChIP-seq 信号的元图谱分析表明，在 NELF 缺失时，暂停区域的 CBP80 显著减少（图 6E）。热图分析显示，CBP80 占据 RNA 聚合酶 II 所在的第一个暂停区域，而在 NELF 耗尽细胞中残留的 CBP80 与 RNA 聚合酶 II 在第二个暂停区域共定位（图 S6B）。这表明尽管在 NELF 缺失时大部分 CBP80 从染色质上解离，但 CBP80 可能仍弱招募到位于+1 核小体二重对称轴处的 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停位点。

Cap-binding proteins protect the 5′ cap from decapping enzymes (Gonatopoulos-Pournatzis and Cowling, 2014). Given that NELF loss impairs CBC recruitment, we considered the possibility that 5′ capping might be unstable. Therefore, we performed the PRO-seq variant PRO-cap (Kwak et al., 2013) to map the 5′ end of capped nascent transcripts in the presence and absence of NELF. We identified �90,000 transcription start sites (TSSs) (de novo TSSs), with �15,000 having a significantly increased PRO-cap signal (cap up) and �6,000 having a decreased PRO-cap signal (cap down) in the absence of NELF (Figure 7A). Metaplot analysis of the PRO-cap and PRO-seq signals showed that cap-up TSSs were associated with RNA Pol II maintaining pausing but transitioning from 1st to 2nd pause regions (Figure 7B). In contrast, cap-down TSS were characterized by a decreased PRO-seq signal (Figure 7C). The precise locations of TSSs identified by PRO-cap were unchanged after NELF depletion (Figure S7A), suggesting that the observed transitioning of RNA Pol II from the 1st to 2nd pause region did not result from changes in TSS usage.

帽结合蛋白保护 5'帽结构免受去帽酶的影响（Gonatopoulos-Pournatzis 和 Cowling，2014）。鉴于 NELF 缺失会损害 CBC 的招募，我们考虑了 5'帽结构可能不稳定的可能性。因此，我们进行了 PRO-seq 变体 PRO-cap（Kwak 等，2013）以在有无 NELF 存在的情况下绘制帽结构新生转录本的 5'端。我们鉴定出约 90,000 个转录起始位点（TSSs）（从头 TSSs），其中约 15,000 个在缺失 NELF 时 PRO-cap 信号显著增加（帽上调），约 6,000 个在缺失 NELF 时 PRO-cap 信号减少（帽下调）（图 7A）。对 PRO-cap 和 PRO-seq 信号的元图谱分析显示，帽上调 TSS 与 RNA 聚合酶 II 维持暂停但从第一到第二暂停区域转变相关（图 7B）。相比之下，帽下调 TSS 则表现为 PRO-seq 信号下降（图 7C）。通过 PRO-cap 鉴定出的 TSS 精确位置在 NELF 耗尽后未发生变化（图 S7A），这表明观察到的 RNA 聚合酶 II 从第一暂停区域向第二暂停区域的转变并非由于 TSS 使用的变化所致。

Both cap-up and cap-down TSSs showed similar decreases in NELF and CBP80 occupancy after NELF depletion (Figure 7D). However, cap-up and cap-down promoters showed different nucleosome profiles, with cap-up TSSs exhibiting better nucleosome phasing (Figure 7D). Because NELF loss leads to loss of protection of the cap by CBC, we looked at the occupancy of decapping factor DCP2 and 5′-3′ exonuclease XRN2, which had previously been implicated in promoter-proximal early termination of RNA Pol II (Brannan et al., 2012; Davidson et al., 2012). ChIP-seq shows a pronounced increase of XRN2 and DCP2 at some cap-down genes (Figure S7B). However, metaplot analysis shows similar increases of XRN2 and DCP2 at cap-up and capdown TSSs upon NELF depletion, suggesting that additional contextual information, such as promoter and/or chromatin structure, could underlie the differential stability of cap-up and cap-down TSSs.

cap-up 和 cap-down 转录起始位点均在 NELF 耗尽后显示出 NELF 和 CBP80 占有度的类似下降（图 7D）。然而，cap-up 和 cap-down 启动子表现出不同的核小体谱型，其中 cap-up TSS 显示出更好的核小体相位性（图 7D）。由于 NELF 的丢失导致 CBC 对帽结构的保护丧失，我们研究了脱帽因子 DCP2 和 5′-3′ 核酸外切酶 XRN2 的占有度，这些因子此前已被认为参与 RNA 聚合酶 II 启动子附近早期终止（Brannan 等，2012；Davidson 等，2012）。染色质免疫沉淀测序显示某些 cap-down 基因处 XRN2 和 DCP2 显著增加（图 S7B）。然而，平均图分析显示在 NELF 耗尽后，cap-up 和 cap-down TSS 处 XRN2 和 DCP2 的增加相似，这表明额外的上下文信息，如启动子和/或染色质结构，可能决定了 cap-up 和 cap-down TSS 的不同稳定性。

DISCUSSION ｜讨论

The Function of the NELF-CBC Interaction ｜ NELF-CBC 相互作用的功能

Using rapid depletion of NELF, we have dissected in vivo functions of NELF in human cells. NELF loss substantially reduces CBC, alters cap stability, and increases occupancies of XRN2 and DCP2 at TSSs. Here, we propose that NELF has primary roles in modulating cap stability through CBC recruitment, which sets up a regulatory mechanism for promoter-proximal early termination of RNA Pol II (Figure 7E, discussed later).

通过快速消耗 NELF，我们解析了 NELF 在人类细胞中体内功能。NELF 缺失显著降低了 CBC，改变了帽结构稳定性，并增加了 XRN2 和 DCP2 在启动子附近区域（TSSs）的占据。在此，我们提出 NELF 主要通过 CBC 募集来调节帽结构稳定性，从而建立一种调控机制，用于启动子附近早期终止 RNA 聚合酶 II（见图 7E，后续讨论）。

Following NELF depletion, we found a decreased PRO-cap signal at a subset of TSSs that also exhibited a decreased PRO-seq signal, rather than the typical transitioning to a 2nd pause region (Figure 7, cap-down TSSs). This raises the possibility that these transcripts were susceptible to early termination: at these TSSs, loss of CBC, and increased DCP2, may promote the removal of unprotected 5′ cap, and increased XRN2 may stimulate 5′-3′ exonucleolytic degradation, which could lead to early termination of RNA Pol II by the torpedo mechanism (Proudfoot, 2016). Because XRN2 coimmunoprecipitates with DCP2 (Brannan et al., 2012), their recruitment upon NELF loss may be cooperatively regulated.

在 NELF 消耗后，我们发现一部分 TSS 处的 PRO-cap 信号减少，这些 TSS 同时也表现出 PRO-seq 信号减少，而不是典型的向第二个暂停区域转变（图 7，cap-down TSSs）。这提示这些转录本易发生早期终止：在这些 TSS 处，CBC 缺失以及 DCP2 增加可能促进未受保护的 5'帽结构被移除，而 XRN2 增加则可能刺激 5'-3'外切核酸酶降解，这可能导致 RNA 聚合酶 II 通过鱼雷机制（torpedo mechanism）发生早期终止（Proudfoot, 2016）。由于 XRN2 可与 DCP2 共免疫沉淀（Brannan 等，2012），NELF 缺失后两者的招募可能受到协同调控。

However, despite a general increase in DCP2 and XRN2 occupancy after NELF depletion, our PRO-cap analysis showed no corresponding global loss of capping at most TSSs following short periods of NELF depletion. Cap-down TSSs showed a distinct nucleosome profile from TSSs with a 2nd pause region (cap-up TSSs), although we are unable to determine whether this difference is a cause or a consequence of these genes preferentially requiring NELF. It is also not clear why the 5′ cap remains stable at many TSSs even though XRN2 and DCP2 recruitment is increased. Future studies will be needed to better understand the relationship between 5′ cap protection and RNA Pol II pausing.

然而，尽管在 NELF 耗尽后 DCP2 和 XRN2 的占据总体增加，我们的 PRO-cap 分析显示，在短时间 NELF 耗尽后，大多数启动子附近转录起始位点（TSS）上并未出现相应的全局帽结构丢失。cap-down TSSs 与具有第二暂停区域的 TSSs（cap-up TSSs）显示出不同的核小体谱型，尽管我们无法确定这种差异是这些基因优先需要 NELF 的原因还是结果。同样不清楚的是，为什么在 XRN2 和 DCP2 招募增加的情况下，许多 TSS 上的 5'帽结构仍然保持稳定。未来的研究将有助于更好地理解 5'帽保护与 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停之间的关系。

Function of Nucleosome-Associated Pausing in the Heat Shock Response ｜热休克反应中与核小体相关的暂停功能

We have found that both upregulation and downregulation of gene expression during the heat shock response are robust in the absence of NELF in human cells (Figure 7). NELF has previously been shown to be dispensable for heat shock-induced gene upregulation in Drosophila cells (Ghosh et al., 2011), which is consistent with our findings. It has also been previously shown that gene downregulation upon heat shock is associated with pausing (Aprile-Garcia et al., 2019; Chen et al., 2017; Mahat et al., 2016a). We found that upon heat shock, RNA Pol II is paused at 1st pause regions for the downregulated genes, consistent with these studies. Importantly, our results have demonstrated that RNA Pol II is also paused at the 2nd pause regions in the absence of NELF (Figure 7), indicating that pausing can be NELF independent, with the canonical region of pausing dependent on NELF pausing.

我们发现，在人类细胞中缺失 NELF 时，热休克反应期间基因表达的上调和下调均是稳健的（图 7）。先前已有研究表明，在果蝇细胞中，NELF 对于热休克诱导的基因上调是可有可无的（Ghosh 等，2011），这与我们的发现一致。此前还表明，热休克引起的基因下调与暂停相关（Aprile-Garcia 等，2019；Chen 等，2017；Mahat 等，2016a）。我们发现，在热休克下，RNA 聚合酶 II 在下调基因的第 1 暂停区域发生暂停，这与这些研究一致。重要的是，我们的结果表明，在缺失 NELF 的情况下，RNA 聚合酶 II 也在第 2 暂停区域发生暂停（图 7），这表明暂停可以不依赖于 NELF，而经典的暂停区域则依赖于 NELF 的暂停。

RNA Pol II Pausing Associated with the +1 Nucleosome ｜与+1 核小体相关的 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停

Although the +1 nucleosome is a widely conserved structure of eukaryotic promoters (Lai and Pugh, 2017), whether the +1 nucleosome is required for promoter-proximal pausing in metazoans has not been answered. Cryo-electron microscopy structure studies have shown that transcribing RNA Pol II can be paused at superhelical locations SHL(�6), SHL(�5), SHL(�2), and SHL(�1) of the nucleosome (Kujirai et al., 2018) and that the nucleosome can be accommodated on the NELF-Pol II-DSIF pausing complex (Farnung et al., 2018). Consistent with these studies, our data suggested that RNA Pol II is paused �60 bp upstream of the +1 dyad, which corresponds to SHL(�6), in a NELF-dependent manner. In Drosophila, RNA Pol II pause regions have been shown to be associated with the �60 bp site of the promoter-proximal nucleosome (Weber et al., 2014) or even upstream of the +1 nucleosome (Kwak et al., 2013). Therefore, the RNA Pol II-NELF complex paused around SHL(�6) may be a primary feature of promoter-proximal pausing among metazoans. Future structural analyses could uncover how NELF determines 1st pause regions for RNA Pol II in the context of chromatin.

尽管+1 核小体是真核启动子中广泛保守的结构（Lai 和 Pugh，2017），但在后生动物中+1 核小体是否对于启动子附近暂停是必需的尚未得到回答。冷冻电子显微镜结构研究表明，转录中的 RNA 聚合酶 II 可以在核小体的超螺旋位置 SHL(�6)、SHL(�5)、SHL(�2)和 SHL(�1)处暂停（Kujirai 等，2018），并且核小体可以容纳在 NELF-Pol II-DSIF 暂停复合物上（Farnung 等，2018）。与这些研究一致，我们的数据表明 RNA 聚合酶 II 在+1 核小体二重对称轴上游约 60 bp 处暂停，对应于 SHL(�6)，且依赖于 NELF。在果蝇中，已显示 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停区域与启动子附近核小体的-60 bp 位点相关（Weber 等，2014），甚至位于+1 核小体上游（Kwak 等，2013）。因此，在后生动物中，RNA 聚合酶 II-NELF 复合物在 SHL(�6)处暂停可能是启动子附近暂停的主要特征。未来的结构分析可能会揭示 NELF 如何在染色质背景下决定 RNA 聚合酶 II 的首个暂停区域。

We found that in the absence of NELF, RNA Pol II is found at 2nd pause regions, which are associated with regions between the 1st pause regions and the +1 dyad. These pause regions may be SHL(�5), SHL(�2), and SHL(�1) of the 1st nucleosome.

我们发现，在缺乏 NELF 的情况下，RNA 聚合酶 II 出现在第二暂停区域，这些区域与第一暂停区域和+1 核小体二重对称轴之间的区域相关。这些暂停区域可能是第一核小体的 SHL(�5)、SHL(�2)和 SHL(�1)位点。

The elongation factors Elf1 and DSIF have been shown to cooperatively prevent RNA Pol II pausing at SHL(�6), SHL(�5), and SHL(�2) (Ehara et al., 2019). Recruitment of these elongation factors to RNA Pol II may facilitate effective release of paused RNA Pol II into productive elongation. It remains possible that the 2nd pause region is associated with unknown factors other than the nucleosome. Future in vivo studies will determine the mechanistic details for 2nd pausing of RNA Pol II upon NELF loss.

已知延伸因子 Elf1 和 DSIF 协同阻止 RNA 聚合酶 II 在 SHL(�6)、SHL(�5)和 SHL(�2)处暂停（Ehara 等，2019）。这些延伸因子被招募到 RNA 聚合酶 II 上可能有助于有效释放暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 进入有效的延伸阶段。也有可能第二暂停区域与核小体以外未知因素相关。未来的体内研究将确定在失去 NELF 后 RNA 聚合酶 II 第二暂停的机制细节。

Reconciling In Vitro and In Vivo Roles of NELF ｜整合体外和体内 NELF 的作用

We find that acute loss of NELF does not release RNA Pol II from promoter-proximal pausing in living cells (Figure 2). Rather, RNA Pol II is found at the +1 dyad-associated regions in the absence of NELF. This means that NELF’s function in CBC recruitment can be functionally distinct from regulation of RNA Pol II pause-release. Consistent with this in vivo finding is that the C-terminal tentacle domain of the NELF-E subunit, which has an RNA recognition motif (RRM) and CBC binding domain, is not required for pausing in vitro (Missra and Gilmour, 2010; Vos et al., 2018b). In vivo, the NELF-E RRM may capture nascent RNA to facilitate its binding to CBC.

我们发现，NELF 的急性缺失并不会使 RNA 聚合酶 II 从启动子附近的暂停状态中释放出来（图 2）。相反，在缺乏 NELF 的情况下，RNA 聚合酶 II 存在于+1 dyad 相关区域。这意味着 NELF 在帽结合复合物（CBC）招募中的功能可能与调控 RNA 聚合酶 II 暂停-释放的功能不同。与此体内发现一致的是，NELF-E 亚基的 C 端伸展结构域，该结构域具有 RNA 识别基序（RRM）和 CBC 结合结构域，在体外暂停过程中并非必需（Missra 和 Gilmour，2010；Vos 等，2018b）。在体内，NELF-E RRM 可能捕捉新生 RNA 以促进其与 CBC 的结合。

The transition of paused RNA Pol II to 2nd pause regions in the absence of NELF occurs in a P-TEFb-independent manner (Figure 4), further demonstrating that NELF functions at a step distinct from pause-release. We reconcile the in vitro requirement of NELF for P-TEFb-dependent pause-release with our in vivo findings as follows. In an initial in vitro transcription system, NELF, when bound to RNA Pol II with DSIF, was shown to possess an intrinsic ability to inhibit RNA Pol II, and this could be relieved by P-TEFb (Yamaguchi et al., 1999). However, when a minimal transcription system with recombinant proteins was used, P-TEFb alone was unable to relieve this RNA Pol II inhibition (Vos et al., 2018a; Wada et al., 2000), suggesting that P-TEFb phosphorylation of NELF, DSIF, and Pol II CTD is not sufficient for RNA Pol II release in vitro. In cells, inhibition of RNA Pol II by NELF and DSIF at the entrance of the +1 nucleosome could allow time for NELF to recruit CBC. CBC binding could in turn help activate P-TEFb (Lenasi et al., 2011). Because P-TEFb phosphorylation of NELF, DSIF, and Pol II CTD was not sufficient for release from pausing in vitro, we propose that P-TEFbdependent phosphorylation of unknown factors could be required for RNA Pol II to traverse the +1 nucleosome into productive elongation.

在缺乏 NELF 的情况下，暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 向第二个暂停区域的转变是不依赖 P-TEFb 的方式进行的（图 4），进一步表明 NELF 的功能步骤与暂停释放不同。我们对体外需要 NELF 参与 P-TEFb 依赖性暂停释放的现象与我们的体内发现进行统一解释如下。在最初的体外转录系统中，当 NELF 与 RNA 聚合酶 II 结合并被 DSIF 所捕获时，显示其具有内在抑制 RNA 聚合酶 II 的能力，并且这种抑制可以通过 P-TEFb 解除（Yamaguchi 等，1999）。然而，在使用重组蛋白的最小转录系统中，仅 P-TEFb 无法解除这种 RNA 聚合酶 II 的抑制（Vos 等，2018a；Wada 等，2000），这表明 P-TEFb 对 NELF、DSIF 和 RNA 聚合酶 II C 端结构域（CTD）的磷酸化不足以在体外实现 RNA 聚合酶 II 的释放。在细胞中，NELF 和 DSIF 在+1 核小体入口处对 RNA 聚合酶 II 的抑制可能为 NELF 招募 CBC 留出时间。CBC 结合反过来有助于激活 P-TEFb（Lenasi 等，2011）。由于 P-TEFb 对 NELF、DSIF 和 RNA 聚合酶 II CTD 的磷酸化在体外不足以实现暂停释放，我们提出，RNA 聚合酶 II 穿越+1 核小体进入有效延伸阶段可能需要 P-TEFb 依赖性磷酸化的未知因子。

The broad presence of NELF across metazoans raises the possibility that it is part of an added layer of transcriptional regulation needed for these more complex genomes and developmental programs. Recently, another metazoan complex, Integrator, was shown to mediate early termination of gene expression through its intrinsic endonuclease activity (Tatomer et al., 2019) (Elrod et al., 2019). Therefore, multiple early termination mechanisms could be used to achieve greater diversity of gene regulatory mechanisms, especially during critical differentiation decisions. Future studies, including expanding the use of acute depletion techniques, can be used to further explore and deconvolve the numerous gene regulatory mechanisms as they occur in their natural chromatin environment in vivo.

NELF 在后生动物中的广泛存在提示它可能是复杂基因组和发育程序所需的额外转录调控层的一部分。最近，另一个后生动物复合物 Integrator 被证明通过其内在的内切酶活性介导基因表达的早期终止（Tatomer 等，2019）（Elrod 等，2019）。因此，多种早期终止机制可能被用于实现更广泛的基因调控机制，特别是在关键分化决策期间。未来的研究，包括扩展急性耗竭技术的应用，可用于进一步探索并解析在体内自然染色质环境中发生的众多基因调控机制。

《分子细胞》第 78 卷，第 261–274 页，2020 年 4 月 16 日，第 271 页
